亚伯拉罕在别是巴栽上一棵垂丝柳树，又在那里求告耶和华 ─ 永生神的名。
亚伯拉罕在非利士人的地寄居了多日。

22.zh: 这些事以后，神要试验亚伯拉罕，就呼叫他说：亚伯拉罕！他说：我在这里。
22.en: Some time later God tested Abraham. He said to him, "Abraham!" "Here I am," he replied.

22.zh: 神说：你带著你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，你所爱的以撒，往摩利亚地去，在我所要指示你的山上，把他献为燔祭。
22.en: Then God said, "Take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go to the region of Moriah. Sacrifice him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains I will tell you about."

22.zh: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，备上驴，带著两个仆人和他儿子以撒，也劈好了燔祭的柴，就起身往神所指示他的地方去了。
22.en: Early the next morning Abraham got up and saddled his donkey. He took with him two of his servants and his son Isaac. When he had cut enough wood for the burnt offering, he set out for the place God had told him about.

22.zh: 到了第三日，亚伯拉罕举目远远的看见那地方。
22.en: On the third day Abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.

22.zh: 亚伯拉罕对他的仆人说：你们和驴在此等候，我与童子往那里去拜一拜，就回到你们这里来。
22.en: He said to his servants, "Stay here with the donkey while I and the boy go over there. We will worship and then we will come back to you."

22.zh: 亚伯拉罕把燔祭的柴放在他儿子以撒身上，自己手里拿著火与刀；于是二人同行。
22.en: Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and placed it on his son Isaac, and he himself carried the fire and the knife. As the two of them went on together,

22.zh: 以撒对他父亲亚伯拉罕说：父亲哪！亚伯拉罕说：我儿，我在这里。以撒说：请看，火与柴都有了，但燔祭的羊羔在那里呢？
22.en: Isaac spoke up and said to his father Abraham, "Father?" "Yes, my son?" Abraham replied. "The fire and wood are here," Isaac said, "but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?"

22.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：我儿，神必自己预备作燔祭的羊羔。于是二人同行。
22.en: Abraham answered, "God himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son." And the two of them went on together.

22.zh: 他们到了神所指示的地方，亚伯拉罕在那里筑坛，把柴摆好，捆绑他的儿子以撒，放在坛的柴上。
22.en: When they reached the place God had told him about, Abraham built an altar there and arranged the wood on it. He bound his son Isaac and laid him on the altar, on top of the wood.

22.zh: 亚伯拉罕就伸手拿刀，要杀他的儿子。
22.en: Then he reached out his hand and took the knife to slay his son.

22.zh: 耶和华的使者从天上呼叫他说：亚伯拉罕！亚伯拉罕！他说：我在这里。
22.en: But the angel of the Lord called out to him from heaven, "Abraham! Abraham!" "Here I am," he replied.

22.zh: 天使说：你不可在这童子身上下手。一点不可害他！现在我知道你是敬畏神的了；因为你没有将你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，留下不给我。
22.en: "Do not lay a hand on the boy," he said. "Do not do anything to him. Now I know that you fear God, because you have not withheld from me your son, your only son."

22.zh: 亚伯拉罕举目观看，不料，有一只公羊，两角扣在稠密的小树中，亚伯拉罕就取了那只公羊来，献为燔祭，代替他的儿子。
22.en: Abraham looked up and there in a thicket he saw a ram caught by its horns. He went over and took the ram and sacrificed it as a burnt offering instead of his son.

22.zh: 亚伯拉罕给那地方起名叫耶和华以勒 ( 意思就是耶和华必预备的意思 ) ，直到今日人还说：在耶和华的山上必有预备。
22.en: So Abraham called that place The Lord Will Provide. And to this day it is said, "On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided."

22.zh: 耶和华的使者第二次从天上呼叫亚伯拉罕说：
22.en: The angel of the Lord called to Abraham from heaven a second time

22.zh: 耶和华说：你既行了这事，不留下你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，我便指著自己起誓说：
22.en: and said, "I swear by myself, declares the Lord , that because you have done this and have not withheld your son, your only son,

22.zh: 论福，我必赐大福给你；论子孙，我必叫你的子孙多起来，如同天上的星，海边的沙。你子孙必得著仇敌的城门，
22.en: I will surely bless you and make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as the sand on the seashore. Your descendants will take possession of the cities of their enemies,

22.zh: 并且地上万国都必因你的后裔得福，因为你听从了我的话。
22.en: and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed me."

22.zh: 于是亚伯拉罕回到他仆人那里，他们一同起身往别是巴去，亚伯拉罕就住在别是巴。
22.en: Then Abraham returned to his servants, and they set off together for Beersheba. And Abraham stayed in Beersheba.

22.zh: 这事以后，有人告诉亚伯拉罕说：密迦给你兄弟拿鹤生了几个儿子，
22.en: Some time later Abraham was told, "Milcah is also a mother; she has borne sons to your brother Nahor:

22.zh: 长子是乌斯，他的兄弟是布斯和亚兰的父亲基母利，
22.en: Uz the firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel (the father of Aram),

22.zh: 并基薛 、 哈琐 、 必达 、 益拉 、 彼土利（彼土利生利百加）。
22.en: Kesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph and Bethuel."

22.zh: 这八个人都是密迦给亚伯拉罕的兄弟拿鹤生的。
22.en: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. Milcah bore these eight sons to Abraham's brother Nahor.

22.zh: 拿鹤的妾名叫流玛，生了提八 、 迦含 、 他辖，和玛迦。
22.en: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also had sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash and Maacah.

23.zh: 撒拉享寿一百二十七岁，这是撒拉一生的岁数。
23.en: Sarah lived to be a hundred andtwenty-seven years old.

23.zh: 撒拉死在迦南地的基列亚巴，就是希伯仑。亚伯拉罕为他哀恸哭号。
23.en: She died at Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went to mourn for Sarah and to weep over her.

23.zh: 后来亚伯拉罕从死人面前起来，对赫人说：
23.en: Then Abraham rose from beside his dead wife and spoke to the Hittites. He said,

23.zh: 我在你们中间是外人，是寄居的。求你们在这里给我一块地，我好埋葬我的死人，使他不在我眼前。
23.en: "I am an alien and a stranger among you. Sell me some property for a burial site here so I can bury my dead."

23.zh: 赫人回答亚伯拉罕说：
23.en: The Hittites replied to Abraham,

23.zh: 我主请听。你在我们中间是一位尊大的王子，只管在我们最好的坟地里埋葬你的死人；我们没有一人不容你在他的坟地里埋葬你的死人。
23.en: "Sir, listen to us. You are a mighty prince among us. Bury your dead in the choicest of our tombs. None of us will refuse you his tomb for burying your dead."

23.zh: 亚伯拉罕就起来，向那地的赫人下拜，
23.en: Then Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.

23.zh: 对他们说：你们若有意叫我埋葬我的死人，使他不在我眼前，就请听我的话，为我求琐辖的儿子以弗仑，
23.en: He said to them, "If you are willing to let me bury my dead, then listen to me and intercede with Ephron son of Zohar on my behalf

23.zh: 把田头上那麦比拉洞给我；他可以按著足价卖给我，作我在你们中间的坟地。
23.en: so he will sell me the cave of Machpelah, which belongs to him and is at the end of his field. Ask him to sell it to me for the full price as a burial site among you."

23.zh: 当时以弗仑正坐在赫人中间。于是，赫人以弗仑在城门出入的赫人面前对亚伯拉罕说：
23.en: Ephron the Hittite was sitting among his people and he replied to Abraham in the hearing of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.

23.zh: 不然，我主请听。我送给你这块田，连田间的洞也送给你，在我同族的人面前都给你，可以埋葬你的死人。
23.en: "No, my lord," he said. "Listen to me; I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. I give it to you in the presence of my people. Bury your dead."

23.zh: 亚伯拉罕就在那地的人民面前下拜，
23.en: Again Abraham bowed down before the people of the land

23.zh: 在他们面前对以弗仑说：你若应允，请听我的话。我要把田价给你，求你收下，我就在那里埋葬我的死人。
23.en: and he said to Ephron in their hearing, "Listen to me, if you will. I will pay the price of the field. Accept it from me so I can bury my dead there."

23.zh: 以弗仑回答亚伯拉罕说：
23.en: Ephron answered Abraham,

23.zh: 我主请听。值四百舍客勒银子的一块田，在你我中间还算甚么呢？只管埋葬你的死人罢！
23.en: "Listen to me, my lord; the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between me and you? Bury your dead."

23.zh: 亚伯拉罕听从了以弗仑，照著他在赫人面前所说的话，把买卖通用的银子平了四百舍客勒给以弗仑。
23.en: Abraham agreed to Ephron's terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the weight current among the merchants.

23.zh: 于是，麦比拉 、 幔利前 、 以弗仑的那块田和其中的洞，并田间四围的树木，
23.en: So Ephron's field in Machpelah near Mamre- both the field and the cave in it, and all the trees within the borders of the field-was deeded

23.zh: 都定准归与亚伯拉罕，乃是他在赫人面前并城门出入的人面前买妥的。
23.en: to Abraham as his property in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of the city.

23.zh: 此后，亚伯拉罕把他妻子撒拉埋葬在迦南地幔利前的麦比拉田间的洞里。 〈 幔利就是希伯仑 〉 。
23.en: Afterward Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave in the field of Machpelah near Mamre (which is at Hebron) in the land of Canaan.

23.zh: 从此，那块田和田间的洞就藉著赫人定准归与亚伯拉罕作坟地。
23.en: So the field and the cave in it were deeded to Abraham by the Hittites as a burial site.

24.zh: 亚伯拉罕年纪老迈，向来在一切事上耶和华都赐福给他。
24.en: Abraham was now old and well advanced in years, and the Lord had blessed him in every way.

24.zh: 亚伯拉罕对管理他全业最老的仆人说：请你把手放在我大腿底下。
24.en: He said to the chief servant in his household, the one in charge of all that he had, "Put your hand under my thigh.

24.zh: 我要叫你指著耶和华 ─ 天地的主起誓，不要为我儿子娶这迦南地中的女子为妻。
24.en: I want you to swear by the Lord , the God of heaven and the God of earth, that you will not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I am living,

24.zh: 你要往我本地本族去，为我的儿子以撒娶一个妻子。
24.en: but will go to my country and my own relatives and get a wife for my son Isaac."

24.zh: 仆人对他说：倘若女子不肯跟我到这地方来，我必须将你的儿子带回你原出之地么？
24.en: The servant asked him, "What if the woman is unwilling to come back with me to this land? Shall I then take your son back to the country you came from?"

24.zh: 亚伯拉罕对他说：你要谨慎，不要带我的儿子回那里去。
24.en: "Make sure that you do not take my son back there," Abraham said.

24.zh: 耶和华 ─ 天上的主曾带领我离开父家和本族的地，对我说话，向我起誓说：我要将这地赐给你的后裔。他必差遣使者在你面前，你就可以从那里为我儿子娶一个妻子。
24.en: "The Lord , the God of heaven, who brought me out of my father's household and my native land and who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, 'To your offspring I will give this land'-he will send his angel before you so that you can get a wife for my son from there.

24.zh: 倘若女子不肯跟你来，我使你起的誓就与你无干了，只是不可带我的儿子回那里去。
24.en: If the woman is unwilling to come back with you, then you will be released from this oath of mine. Only do not take my son back there."

24.zh: 仆人就把手放在他主人亚伯拉罕的大腿底下，为这事向他起誓。
24.en: So the servant put his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter.

24.zh: 那仆人从他主人的骆驼里取了十匹骆驼，并带些他主人各样的财物，起身往米所波大米去，到了拿鹤的城。
24.en: Then the servant took ten of his master's camels and left, taking with him all kinds of good things from his master. He set out for Aram Naharaim and made his way to the town of Nahor.

24.zh: 天将晚，众女子出来打水的时候，他便叫骆驼跪在城外的水井那里。
24.en: He had the camels kneel down near the well outside the town; it was toward evening, the time the women go out to draw water.

24.zh: 他说：耶和华 ─ 我主人亚伯拉罕的神阿，求你施恩给我主人亚伯拉罕，使我今日遇见好机会。
24.en: Then he prayed, "O Lord , God of my master Abraham, give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

24.zh: 我现今站在井旁，城内居民的女子们正出来打水。
24.en: See, I am standing beside this spring, and the daughters of the townspeople are coming out to draw water.

24.zh: 我向那一个女子说：请你拿下水瓶来，给我水喝，他若说：请喝！我也给你的骆驼喝，愿那女子就作你所预定给你仆人以撒的妻。这样，我便知道你施恩给我主人了。
24.en: May it be that when I say to a girl, 'Please let down your jar that I may have a drink,' and she says, 'Drink, and I'll water your camels too'-let her be the one you have chosen for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master."

24.zh: 话还没有说完，不料，利百加肩头上扛著水瓶出来。利百加是彼土利所生的；彼土利是亚伯拉罕兄弟拿鹤妻子密迦的儿子。
24.en: Before he had finished praying, Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder. She was the daughter of Bethuel son of Milcah, who was the wife of Abraham's brother Nahor.

24.zh: 那女子容貌极其俊美，还是处女，也未曾有人亲近他。他下到井旁，打满了瓶，又上来。
24.en: The girl was very beautiful, a virgin; no man had ever lain with her. She went down to the spring, filled her jar and came up again.

24.zh: 仆人跑上前去迎著他，说：求你将瓶里的水给我一点喝。
24.en: The servant hurried to meet her and said, "Please give me a little water from your jar."

24.zh: 女子说：我主请喝！就急忙拿下瓶来，托在手上给他喝。
24.en: "Drink, my lord," she said, and quickly lowered the jar to her hands and gave him a drink.

24.zh: 女子给他喝了，就说：我再为你的骆驼打水，叫骆驼也喝足。
24.en: After she had given him a drink, she said, "I'll draw water for your camels too, until they have finished drinking."

24.zh: 他就急忙把瓶里的水倒在槽里，又跑到井旁打水，就为所有的骆驼打上水来。
24.en: So she quickly emptied her jar into the trough, ran back to the well to draw more water, and drew enough for all his camels.

24.zh: 那人定睛看他，一句话也不说，要晓得耶和华赐他通达的道路没有。
24.en: Without saying a word, the man watched her closely to learn whether or not the Lord had made his journey successful.

24.zh: 骆驼喝足了，那人就拿一个金环，重半舍客勒，两个金镯，重十舍客勒，给了那女子，
24.en: When the camels had finished drinking, the man took out a gold nose ring weighing a beka and two gold bracelets weighing ten shekels.

24.zh: 说：请告诉我，你是谁的女儿？你父亲家里有我们住宿的地方没有？
24.en: Then he asked, "Whose daughter are you? Please tell me, is there room in your father's house for us to spend the night?"

24.zh: 女子说：我是密迦与拿鹤之子彼土利的女儿；
24.en: She answered him, "I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son that Milcah bore to Nahor."

24.zh: 又说：我们家里足有粮草，也有住宿的地方。
24.en: And she added, "We have plenty of straw and fodder, as well as room for you to spend the night."

24.zh: 那人就低头向耶和华下拜，
24.en: Then the man bowed down and worshiped the Lord ,

24.zh: 说：耶和华 ─ 我主人亚伯拉罕的神是应当称颂的，因他不断地以慈爱诚实待我主人。至于我，耶和华在路上引领我，直走到我主人的兄弟家里。
24.en: saying, "Praise be to the Lord , the God of my master Abraham, who has not abandoned his kindness and faithfulness to my master. As for me, the Lord has led me on the journey to the house of my master's relatives."

24.zh: 女子跑回去，照著这些话告诉他母亲和他家里的人。
24.en: The girl ran and told her mother's household about these things.

24.zh: 利百加有一个哥哥，名叫拉班，看见金环，又看见金镯在他妹子的手上，并听见他妹子利百加的话，说那人对我如此如此说。拉班就跑出来往井旁去，到那人跟前，见他仍站在骆驼旁边的井旁那里，
24.en: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he hurried out to the man at the spring.

24.zh: a
24.en: As soon as he had seen the nose ring, and the bracelets on his sister's arms, and had heard Rebekah tell what the man said to her, he went out to the man and found him standing by the camels near the spring.

24.zh: 便对他说：你这蒙耶和华赐福的，请进来，为甚么站在外边？我已经收拾了房屋，也为骆驼预备了地方。
24.en: "Come, you who are blessed by the Lord ," he said. "Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels."

24.zh: 那人就进了拉班的家。拉班卸了骆驼，用草料喂上，拿水给那人和跟随的人洗脚，
24.en: So the man went to the house, and the camels were unloaded. Straw and fodder were brought for the camels, and water for him and his men to wash their feet.

24.zh: 把饭摆在他面前，叫他吃，他却说：我不吃，等我说明白我的事情再吃。拉班说：请说。
24.en: Then food was set before him, but he said, "I will not eat until I have told you what I have to say." "Then tell us," Laban said.

24.zh: 他说：我是亚伯拉罕的仆人。
24.en: So he said, "I am Abraham's servant.

24.zh: 耶和华大大地赐福给我主人，使他昌大，又赐给他羊群 、 牛群 、 金银 、 仆婢 、 骆驼，和驴。
24.en: The Lord has blessed my master abundantly, and he has become wealthy. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, menservants and maidservants, and camels and donkeys.

24.zh: 我主人的妻子撒拉年老的时候给我主人生了一个儿子；我主人也将一切所有的都给了这个儿子。
24.en: My master's wife Sarah has borne him a son in her old age, and he has given him everything he owns.

24.zh: 我主人叫我起誓说：你不要为我儿子娶迦南地的女子为妻。
24.en: And my master made me swear an oath, and said, 'You must not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

24.zh: 你要往我父家 、 我本族那里去，为我的儿子娶一个妻子。
24.en: but go to my father's family and to my own clan, and get a wife for my son.'

24.zh: 我对我主人说：恐怕女子不肯跟我来。
24.en: "Then I asked my master, 'What if the woman will not come back with me?'

24.zh: 他就说：我所事奉的耶和华必要差遣他的使者与你同去，叫你的道路通达，你就得以在我父家 、 我本族那里，给我的儿子娶一个妻子。
24.en: "He replied, 'The Lord , before whom I have walked, will send his angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you can get a wife for my son from my own clan and from my father's family.

24.zh: 只要你到了我本族那里，我使你起的誓就与你无干。他们若不把女子交给你，我使你起的誓也与你无干。
24.en: Then, when you go to my clan, you will be released from my oath even if they refuse to give her to you-you will be released from my oath.'

24.zh: 我今日到了井旁，便说：耶和华 ─ 我主人亚伯拉罕的神阿，愿你叫我所行的道路通达。
24.en: "When I came to the spring today, I said, 'O Lord , God of my master Abraham, if you will, please grant success to the journey on which I have come.

24.zh: 我如今站在井旁，对那一个出来打水的女子说：请你把你瓶里的水给我一点喝；
24.en: See, I am standing beside this spring; if a maiden comes out to draw water and I say to her, "Please let me drink a little water from your jar,"

24.zh: 他若说：你只管喝，我也为你的骆驼打水；愿那女子就作耶和华给我主人儿子所预定的妻。
24.en: and if she says to me, "Drink, and I'll draw water for your camels too," let her be the one the Lord has chosen for my master's son.'

24.zh: 我心里的话还没有说完，利百加就出来，肩头上扛著水瓶，下到井旁打水。我便对他说：请你给我水喝。
24.en: "Before I finished praying in my heart, Rebekah came out, with her jar on her shoulder. She went down to the spring and drew water, and I said to her, 'Please give me a drink.'

24.zh: 他就急忙从肩头上拿下瓶来，说：请喝！我也给你的骆驼喝。我便喝了；他又给我的骆驼喝了。
24.en: "She quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said, 'Drink, and I'll water your camels too.' So I drank, and she watered the camels also.

24.zh: 我问他说：你是谁的女儿？他说：我是密迦与拿鹤之子彼土利的女儿。我就把环子戴在他鼻子上，把镯子戴在他两手上。
24.en: "I asked her, 'Whose daughter are you?' "She said, 'The daughter of Bethuel son of Nahor, whom Milcah bore to him.' "Then I put the ring in her nose and the bracelets on her arms,

24.zh: 随后我低头向耶和华下拜，称颂耶和华 ─ 我主人亚伯拉罕的神；因为他引导我走合式的道路，使我得著我主人兄弟的孙女，给我主人的儿子为妻。
24.en: and I bowed down and worshiped the Lord . I praised the Lord , the God of my master Abraham, who had led me on the right road to get the granddaughter of my master's brother for his son.

24.zh: 现在你们若愿以慈爱诚实待我主人，就告诉我；若不然，也告诉我，使我可以或向左，或向右。
24.en: Now if you will show kindness and faithfulness to my master, tell me; and if not, tell me, so I may know which way to turn."

24.zh: 拉班和彼土利回答说：这事乃出于耶和华，我们不能向你说好说歹。
24.en: Laban and Bethuel answered, "This is from the Lord ; we can say nothing to you one way or the other.

24.zh: 看哪，利百加在你面前，可以将他带去，照著耶和华所说的，给你主人的儿子为妻。
24.en: Here is Rebekah; take her and go, and let her become the wife of your master's son, as the Lord has directed."

24.zh: 亚伯拉罕的仆人听见他们这话，就向耶和华俯伏在地。
24.en: When Abraham's servant heard what they said, he bowed down to the ground before the Lord .

24.zh: 当下仆人拿出金器 、 银器，和衣服送给利百加，又将宝物送给他哥哥和他母亲。
24.en: Then the servant brought out gold and silver jewelry and articles of clothing and gave them to Rebekah; he also gave costly gifts to her brother and to her mother.

24.zh: 仆人和跟从他的人吃了喝了，住了一夜。早晨起来，仆人就说：请打发我回我主人那里去罢。
24.en: Then he and the men who were with him ate and drank and spent the night there. When they got up the next morning, he said, "Send me on my way to my master."

24.zh: 利百加的哥哥和他母亲说：让女子同我们再住几天，至少十天，然后他可以去。
24.en: But her brother and her mother replied, "Let the girl remain with us ten days or so; then you may go."

24.zh: 仆人说：耶和华既赐给我通达的道路，你们不要耽误我，请打发我走，回我主人那里去罢。
24.en: But he said to them, "Do not detain me, now that the Lord has granted success to my journey. Send me on my way so I may go to my master."

24.zh: 他们说：我们把女子叫来问问他，
24.en: Then they said, "Let's call the girl and ask her about it."

24.zh: 就叫了利百加来，问他说：你和这人同去么？利百加说：我去。
24.en: So they called Rebekah and asked her, "Will you go with this man?" "I will go," she said.

24.zh: 于是他们打发妹子利百加和他的乳母，同亚伯拉罕的仆人，并跟从仆人的，都走了。
24.en: So they sent their sister Rebekah on her way, along with her nurse and Abraham's servant and his men.

24.zh: 他们就给利百加祝福说：我们的妹子阿，愿你作千万人的母！愿你的后裔得著仇敌的城门！
24.en: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, "Our sister, may you increase to thousands upon thousands; may your offspring possess the gates of their enemies."

24.zh: 利百加和他的使女们起来，骑上骆驼，跟著那仆人，仆人就带著利百加走了。
24.en: Then Rebekah and her maids got ready and mounted their camels and went back with the man. So the servant took Rebekah and left.

24.zh: 那时，以撒住在南地，刚从庇耳 • 拉海 • 莱回来。
24.en: Now Isaac had come from Beer Lahai Roi, for he was living in the Negev.

24.zh: 天将晚，以撒出来在田间默想，举目一看，见来了些骆驼。
24.en: He went out to the field one evening to meditate, and as he looked up, he saw camels approaching.

24.zh: 利百加举目看见以撒，就急忙下了骆驼，
24.en: Rebekah also looked up and saw Isaac. She got down from her camel

24.zh: 问那仆人说：这田间走来迎接我们的是谁？仆人说：是我的主人。利百加就拿帕子蒙上脸。
24.en: and asked the servant, "Who is that man in the field coming to meet us?" "He is my master," the servant answered. So she took her veil and covered herself.

24.zh: 仆人就将所办的一切事都告诉以撒。
24.en: Then the servant told Isaac all he had done.

24.zh: 以撒便领利百加进了他母亲撒拉的帐棚，娶了他为妻，并且爱他。以撒自从他母亲不在了，这才得了安慰。
24.en: Isaac brought her into the tent of his mother Sarah, and he married Rebekah. So she became his wife, and he loved her; and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.

25.zh: 亚伯拉罕又娶了一妻，名叫基土拉。
25.en: Abraham took another wife,whose name was Keturah.

25.zh: 基土拉给他生了心兰 、 约珊 、 米但 、 米甸 、 伊施巴，和书亚。
25.en: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah.

25.zh: 约珊生了示巴和底但。底但的子孙是亚书利族 、 利都是族，和利乌米族。
25.en: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan; the descendants of Dedan were the Asshurites, the Letushites and the Leummites.

25.zh: 米甸的儿子是以法 、 以弗 、 哈诺 、 亚比大，和以勒大。这都是基土拉的子孙。
25.en: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.

25.zh: 亚伯拉罕将一切所有的都给了以撒。
25.en: Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac.

25.zh: 亚伯拉罕把财物分给他庶出的众子，趁著自己还在世的时候打发他们离开他的儿子以撒，往东方去。
25.en: But while he was still living, he gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac to the land of the east.

25.zh: 亚伯拉罕一生的年日是一百七十五岁。
25.en: Altogether, Abraham lived a hundred and seventy-five years.

25.zh: 亚伯拉罕寿高年迈，气绝而死，归到他列祖 ( 原文作本民 ) 那里。
25.en: Then Abraham breathed his last and died at a good old age, an old man and full of years; and he was gathered to his people.

25.zh: 他两个儿子以撒 、 以实玛利把他埋葬在麦比拉洞里。这洞在幔利前 、 赫人琐辖的儿子以弗仑的田中，
25.en: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite,

25.zh: 就是亚伯拉罕向赫人买的那块田。亚伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉都葬在那里。
25.en: the field Abraham had bought from the Hittites. There Abraham was buried with his wife Sarah.

25.zh: 亚伯拉罕死了以后，神赐福给他的儿子以撒。以撒靠近庇耳拉海莱居住。
25.en: After Abraham's death, God blessed his son Isaac, who then lived near Beer Lahai Roi.

25.zh: 撒拉的使女埃及人夏甲给亚伯拉罕所生的儿子是以实玛利。
25.en: This is the account of Abraham's son Ishmael, whom Sarah's maidservant, Hagar the Egyptian, bore to Abraham.

25.zh: 以实玛利儿子们的名字，按著他们的家谱记在下面。以实玛利的长子是尼拜约，又有基达 、 亚德别 、 米比衫 、
25.en: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, listed in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

25.zh: 米施玛 、 度玛 、 玛撒 、
25.en: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

25.zh: 哈大 、 提玛 、 伊突 、 拿非施 、 基底玛。
25.en: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah.

25.zh: 这是以实玛利众子的名字，照著他们的村庄 、 营寨，作了十二族的族长。
25.en: These were the sons of Ishmael, and these are the names of the twelve tribal rulers according to their settlements and camps.

25.zh: 以实玛利享寿一百三十七岁，气绝而死，归到他列祖 ( 原文作本民 ) 那里。
25.en: Altogether, Ishmael lived a hundred and thirty-seven years. He breathed his last and died, and he was gathered to his people.

25.zh: 他子孙的住处在他众弟兄东边，从哈腓拉直到埃及前的书珥，正在亚述的道上。
25.en: His descendants settled in the area from Havilah to Shur, near the border of Egypt, as you go toward Asshur. And they lived in hostility toward all their brothers.

25.zh: 亚伯拉罕的儿子以撒的后代记在下面。亚伯拉罕生以撒。
25.en: This is the account of Abraham's son Isaac. Abraham became the father of Isaac,

25.zh: 以撒娶利百加为妻的时候正四十岁。利百加是巴旦亚兰地的亚兰人彼土利的女儿，是亚兰人拉班的妹子。
25.en: and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan Aram and sister of Laban the Aramean.

25.zh: 以撒因他妻子不生育，就为他祈求耶和华；耶和华应允他的祈求，他的妻子利百加就怀了孕。
25.en: Isaac prayed to the Lord on behalf of his wife, because she was barren. The Lord answered his prayer, and his wife Rebekah became pregnant.

25.zh: 孩子们在他腹中彼此相争，他就说：若是这样，我为甚么活著呢 ( 或作我为甚么如此呢 ) ？他就去求问耶和华。
25.en: The babies jostled each other within her, and she said, "Why is this happening to me?" So she went to inquire of the Lord .

25.zh: 耶和华对他说：两国在你腹内；两族要从你身上出来。这族必强于那族；将来大的要服事小的。
25.en: The Lord said to her, "Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be separated; one people will be stronger than the other, and the older will serve the younger."

25.zh: 生产的日子到了，腹中果然是双子。
25.en: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.

25.zh: 先产的身体发红，浑身有毛，如同皮衣，他们就给他起名叫以扫 ( 就是有毛的意思 ) 。
25.en: The first to come out was red, and his whole body was like a hairy garment; so they named him Esau.

25.zh: 随后又生了以扫的兄弟，手抓住以扫的脚跟，因此给他起名叫雅各 ( 就是抓住的意思 ) 。利百加生下两个儿子的时候，以撒年正六十岁。
25.en: After this, his brother came out, with his hand grasping Esau's heel; so he was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when Rebekah gave birth to them.

25.zh: 两个孩子渐渐长大，以扫善于打猎，常在田野；雅各为人安静，常住在帐棚里。
25.en: The boys grew up, and Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the open country, while Jacob was a quiet man, staying among the tents.

25.zh: 以撒爱以扫，因为常吃他的野味；利百加却爱雅各。
25.en: Isaac, who had a taste for wild game, loved Esau, but Rebekah loved Jacob.

25.zh: 有一天，雅各熬汤，以扫从田野回来累昏了。
25.en: Once when Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came in from the open country, famished.

25.zh: 以扫对雅各说：我累昏了，求你把这红汤给我喝。因此以扫又叫以东 ( 就是红的意思 ) 。
25.en: He said to Jacob, "Quick, let me have some of that red stew! I'm famished!" (That is why he was also called Edom. )

25.zh: 雅各说：你今日把长子的名分卖给我罢。
25.en: Jacob replied, "First sell me your birthright."

25.zh: 以扫说：我将要死，这长子的名分于我有甚么益处呢？
25.en: "Look, I am about to die," Esau said. "What good is the birthright to me?"

25.zh: 雅各说：你今日对我起誓罢。以扫就对他起了誓，把长子的名分卖给雅各。
25.en: But Jacob said, "Swear to me first." So he swore an oath to him, selling his birthright to Jacob.

25.zh: 于是雅各将饼和红豆汤给了以扫，以扫吃了喝了，便起来走了。这就是以扫轻看了他长子的名分。
25.en: Then Jacob gave Esau some bread and some lentil stew. He ate and drank, and then got up and left. So Esau despised his birthright.

26.zh: 在亚伯拉罕的日子，那地有一次饥荒；这时又有饥荒，以撒就往基拉耳去，到非利士人的王亚比米勒那里。
26.en: Now there was a famine in the land-besides the earlier famine of Abraham's time-and Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines in Gerar.

26.zh: 耶和华向以撒显现，说：你不要下去，要住在我所指示你的地。
26.en: The Lord appeared to Isaac and said, "Do not go down to Egypt; live in the land where I tell you to live.

26.zh: 你寄居在这地，我必与你同在，赐福给你，因为我要将这些地都赐给你和你的后裔。我必坚定我向你父亚伯拉罕所起的誓。
26.en: Stay in this land for a while, and I will be with you and will bless you. For to you and your descendants I will give all these lands and will confirm the oath I swore to your father Abraham.

26.zh: 我要加增你的后裔，像天上的星那样多，又要将这些地都赐给你的后裔。并且地上万国必因你的后裔得福 ─
26.en: I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and will give them all these lands, and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed,

26.zh: 都因亚伯拉罕听从我的话，遵守我的吩咐和我的命令 、 律例 、 法度。
26.en: because Abraham obeyed me and kept my requirements, my commands, my decrees and my laws."

26.zh: 以撒就住在基拉耳。
26.en: So Isaac stayed in Gerar.

26.zh: 那地方的人问到他的妻子，他便说：那是我的妹子。原来他怕说：是我的妻子；他心里想：恐怕这地方的人为利百加的缘故杀我，因为他容貌俊美。
26.en: When the men of that place asked him about his wife, he said, "She is my sister," because he was afraid to say, "She is my wife." He thought, "The men of this place might kill me on account of Rebekah, because she is beautiful."

26.zh: 他在那里住了许久。有一天，非利士人的王亚比米勒从窗户里往外观看，见以撒和他的妻子利百加戏玩。
26.en: When Isaac had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked down from a window and saw Isaac caressing his wife Rebekah.

26.zh: 亚比米勒召了以撒来，对他说：他实在是你的妻子，你怎么说他是你的妹子？以撒说：我心里想，恐怕我因他而死。
26.en: So Abimelech summoned Isaac and said, "She is really your wife! Why did you say, 'She is my sister'?" Isaac answered him, "Because I thought I might lose my life on account of her."

26.zh: 亚比米勒说：你向我们做的是甚么事呢？民中险些有人和你的妻同寝，把我们陷在罪里。
26.en: Then Abimelech said, "What is this you have done to us? One of the men might well have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us."

26.zh: 于是亚比米勒晓谕众民说：凡沾著这个人，或是他妻子的，定要把他治死。
26.en: So Abimelech gave orders to all the people: "Anyone who molests this man or his wife shall surely be put to death."

26.zh: 以撒在那地耕种，那一年有百倍的收成。耶和华赐福给他，
26.en: Isaac planted crops in that land and the same year reaped a hundredfold, because the Lord blessed him.

26.zh: 他就昌大，日增月盛，成了大富户。
26.en: The man became rich, and his wealth continued to grow until he became very wealthy.

26.zh: 他有羊群牛群，又有许多仆人，非利士人就嫉妒他。
26.en: He had so many flocks and herds and servants that the Philistines envied him.

26.zh: 当他父亲亚伯拉罕在世的日子，他父亲的仆人所挖的井，非利士人全都塞住，填满了土。
26.en: So all the wells that his father's servants had dug in the time of his father Abraham, the Philistines stopped up, filling them with earth.

26.zh: 亚比米勒对以撒说：你离开我们去罢。因为你比我们强盛得多。
26.en: Then Abimelech said to Isaac, "Move away from us; you have become too powerful for us."

26.zh: 以撒就离开那里，在基拉耳谷支搭帐棚，住在那里。
26.en: So Isaac moved away from there and encamped in the Valley of Gerar and settled there.

26.zh: 当他父亲亚伯拉罕在世之日所挖的水井因非利士人在亚伯拉罕死后塞住了，以撒就重新挖出来，仍照他父亲所叫的叫那些井的名字。
26.en: Isaac reopened the wells that had been dug in the time of his father Abraham, which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham died, and he gave them the same names his father had given them.

26.zh: 以撒的仆人在谷中挖井，便得了一口活水井。
26.en: Isaac's servants dug in the valley and discovered a well of fresh water there.

26.zh: 基拉耳的牧人与以撒的牧人争竞，说：这水是我们的。以撒就给那井起名叫埃色 ( 就是相争的意思 ) ，因为他们和他相争。
26.en: But the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac's herdsmen and said, "The water is ours!" So he named the well Esek, because they disputed with him.

26.zh: 以撒的仆人又挖了一口井，他们又为这井争竞，因此以撒给这井起名叫西提拿 ( 就是为敌的意思 ) 。
26.en: Then they dug another well, but they quarreled over that one also; so he named it Sitnah.

26.zh: 以撒离开那里，又挖了一口井，他们不为这井争竞了，他就给那井起名叫利河伯 ( 就是宽阔的意思 ) 。他说：耶和华现在给我们宽阔之地，我们必在这地昌盛。
26.en: He moved on from there and dug another well, and no one quarreled over it. He named it Rehoboth, saying, "Now the Lord has given us room and we will flourish in the land."

26.zh: 以撒从那里上别是巴去。
26.en: From there he went up to Beersheba.

26.zh: 当夜耶和华向他显现，说：我是你父亲亚伯拉罕的神，不要惧怕！因为我与你同在，要赐福给你，并要为我仆人亚伯拉罕的缘故，使你的后裔繁多。
26.en: That night the Lord appeared to him and said, "I am the God of your father Abraham. Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bless you and will increase the number of your descendants for the sake of my servant Abraham."

26.zh: 以撒就在那里筑了一座坛，求告耶和华的名，并且支搭帐棚；他的仆人便在那里挖了一口井。
26.en: Isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the Lord . There he pitched his tent, and there his servants dug a well.

26.zh: 亚比米勒，同他的朋友亚户撒和他的军长非各，从基拉耳来见以撒。
26.en: Meanwhile, Abimelech had come to him from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his personal adviser and Phicol the commander of his forces.

26.zh: 以撒对他们说：你们既然恨我，打发我走了，为甚么到我这里来呢？
26.en: Isaac asked them, "Why have you come to me, since you were hostile to me and sent me away?"

26.zh: 他们说：我们明明的看见耶和华与你同在，便说，不如我们两下彼此起誓，彼此立约，
26.en: They answered, "We saw clearly that the Lord was with you; so we said, 'There ought to be a sworn agreement between us'-between us and you. Let us make a treaty with you

26.zh: 使你不害我们，正如我们未曾害你，一味的厚待你，并且打发你平平安安的走。你是蒙耶和华赐福的了。
26.en: that you will do us no harm, just as we did not molest you but always treated you well and sent you away in peace. And now you are blessed by the Lord ."

26.zh: 以撒就为他们设摆筵席，他们便吃了喝了。
26.en: Isaac then made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.

26.zh: 他们清早起来彼此起誓。以撒打发他们走，他们就平平安安的离开他走了。
26.en: Early the next morning the men swore an oath to each other. Then Isaac sent them on their way, and they left him in peace.

26.zh: 那一天，以撒的仆人来，将挖井的事告诉他说：我们得了水了。
26.en: That day Isaac's servants came and told him about the well they had dug. They said, "We've found water!"

26.zh: 他就给那井起名叫示巴；因此那城叫做别是巴，直到今日。
26.en: He called it Shibah, and to this day the name of the town has been Beersheba.

26.zh: 以扫四十岁的时候娶了赫人比利的女儿犹滴，与赫人以伦的女儿巴实抹为妻。
26.en: When Esau was forty years old, he married Judith daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and also Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite.

26.zh: 他们常使以撒和利百加心里愁烦。
26.en: They were a source of grief to Isaac and Rebekah.

27.zh: 以撒年老，眼睛昏花，不能看见，就叫了他大儿子以扫来，说：我儿。以扫说：我在这里。
27.en: When Isaac was old and his eyes were so weak that he could no longer see, he called for Esau his older son and said to him, "My son." "Here I am," he answered.

27.zh: 他说：我如今老了，不知道那一天死。
27.en: Isaac said, "I am now an old man and don't know the day of my death.

27.zh: 现在拿你的器械，就是箭囊和弓，往田野去为我打猎，
27.en: Now then, get your weapons-your quiver and bow-and go out to the open country to hunt some wild game for me.

27.zh: 照我所爱的做成美味，拿来给我吃，使我在未死之先给你祝福。
27.en: Prepare me the kind of tasty food I like and bring it to me to eat, so that I may give you my blessing before I die."

27.zh: 以撒对他儿子以扫说话，利百加也听见了。以扫往田野去打猎，要得野味带来。
27.en: Now Rebekah was listening as Isaac spoke to his son Esau. When Esau left for the open country to hunt game and bring it back,

27.zh: 利百加就对他儿子雅各说：我听见你父亲对你哥哥以扫说：
27.en: Rebekah said to her son Jacob, "Look, I overheard your father say to your brother Esau,

27.zh: 你去把野兽带来，做成美味给我吃，我好在未死之先，在耶和华面前给你祝福。
27.en: 'Bring me some game and prepare me some tasty food to eat, so that I may give you my blessing in the presence of the Lord before I die.'

27.zh: 现在，我儿，你要照著我所吩咐你的，听从我的话。
27.en: Now, my son, listen carefully and do what I tell you:

27.zh: 你到羊群里去，给我拿两只肥山羊羔来，我便照你父亲所爱的给他做成美味。
27.en: Go out to the flock and bring me two choice young goats, so I can prepare some tasty food for your father, just the way he likes it.

27.zh: 你拿到你父亲那里给他吃，使他在未死之先给你祝福。
27.en: Then take it to your father to eat, so that he may give you his blessing before he dies."

27.zh: 雅各对他母亲利百加说：我哥哥以扫浑身是有毛的，我身上是光滑的；
27.en: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, "But my brother Esau is a hairy man, and I'm a man with smooth skin.

27.zh: 倘若我父亲摸著我，必以我为欺哄人的，我就招咒诅，不得祝福。
27.en: What if my father touches me? I would appear to be tricking him and would bring down a curse on myself rather than a blessing."

27.zh: 他母亲对他说：我儿，你招的咒诅归到我身上；你只管听我的话，去把羊羔给我拿来。
27.en: His mother said to him, "My son, let the curse fall on me. Just do what I say; go and get them for me."

27.zh: 他便去拿来，交给他母亲；他母亲就照他父亲所爱的做成美味。
27.en: So he went and got them and brought them to his mother, and she prepared some tasty food, just the way his father liked it.

27.zh: 利百加又把家里所存大儿子以扫上好的衣服给他小儿子雅各穿上，
27.en: Then Rebekah took the best clothes of Esau her older son, which she had in the house, and put them on her younger son Jacob.

27.zh: 又用山羊羔皮包在雅各的手上和颈项的光滑处，
27.en: She also covered his hands and the smooth part of his neck with the goatskins.

27.zh: 就把所做的美味和饼交在他儿子雅各的手里。
27.en: Then she handed to her son Jacob the tasty food and the bread she had made.

27.zh: 雅各到他父亲那里说：我父亲！他说：我在这里。我儿，你是谁？
27.en: He went to his father and said, "My father." "Yes, my son," he answered. "Who is it?"

27.zh: 雅各对他父亲说：我是你的长子以扫；我已照你所吩咐我的行了。请起来坐著，吃我的野味，好给我祝福。
27.en: Jacob said to his father, "I am Esau your firstborn. I have done as you told me. Please sit up and eat some of my game so that you may give me your blessing."

27.zh: 以撒对他儿子说：我儿，你如何找得这么快呢？他说：因为耶和华 ─ 你的神使我遇见好机会得著的。
27.en: Isaac asked his son, "How did you find it so quickly, my son?" "The Lord your God gave me success," he replied.

27.zh: 以撒对雅各说：我儿，你近前来，我摸摸你，知道你真是我的儿子以扫不是？
27.en: Then Isaac said to Jacob, "Come near so I can touch you, my son, to know whether you really are my son Esau or not."

27.zh: 雅各就挨近他父亲以撒。以撒摸著他，说：声音是雅各的声音，手却是以扫的手。
27.en: Jacob went close to his father Isaac, who touched him and said, "The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau."

27.zh: 以撒就辨不出他来；因为他手上有毛，像他哥哥以扫的手一样，就给他祝福；
27.en: He did not recognize him, for his hands were hairy like those of his brother Esau; so he blessed him.

27.zh: 又说：你真是我儿子以扫么？他说：我是。
27.en: "Are you really my son Esau?" he asked. "I am," he replied.

27.zh: 以撒说：你递给我，我好吃我儿子的野味，给你祝福。雅各就递给他，他便吃了，又拿酒给他，他也喝了。
27.en: Then he said, "My son, bring me some of your game to eat, so that I may give you my blessing." Jacob brought it to him and he ate; and he brought some wine and he drank.

27.zh: 他父亲以撒对他说：我儿，你上前来与我亲嘴。
27.en: Then his father Isaac said to him, "Come here, my son, and kiss me."

27.zh: 他就上前与父亲亲嘴。他父亲一闻他衣服上的香气，就给他祝福，说：我儿的香气如同耶和华赐福之田地的香气一样。
27.en: So he went to him and kissed him. When Isaac caught the smell of his clothes, he blessed him and said, "Ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the Lord has blessed.

27.zh: 愿神赐你天上的甘露，地上的肥土，并许多五谷新酒。
27.en: May God give you of heaven's dew and of earth's richness- an abundance of grain and new wine.

27.zh: 愿多民事奉你，多国跪拜你。愿你作你弟兄的主；你母亲的儿子向你跪拜。凡咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅；为你祝福的，愿他蒙福。
27.en: May nations serve you and peoples bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers, and may the sons of your mother bow down to you. May those who curse you be cursed and those who bless you be blessed."

27.zh: 以撒为雅各祝福已毕，雅各从他父亲那里才出来，他哥哥以扫正打猎回来，
27.en: After Isaac finished blessing him and Jacob had scarcely left his father's presence, his brother Esau came in from hunting.

27.zh: 也做了美味，拿来给他父亲，说：请父亲起来，吃你儿子的野味，好给我祝福。
27.en: He too prepared some tasty food and brought it to his father. Then he said to him, "My father, sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may give me your blessing."

27.zh: 他父亲以撒对他说：你是谁？他说：我是你的长子以扫。
27.en: His father Isaac asked him, "Who are you?" "I am your son," he answered, "your firstborn, Esau."

27.zh: 以撒就大大地战兢，说：你未来之先，是谁得了野味拿来给我呢？我已经吃了，为他祝福；他将来也必蒙福。
27.en: Isaac trembled violently and said, "Who was it, then, that hunted game and brought it to me? I ate it just before you came and I blessed him-and indeed he will be blessed!"

27.zh: 以扫听了他父亲的话，就放声痛哭，说：我父阿，求你也为我祝福！
27.en: When Esau heard his father's words, he burst out with a loud and bitter cry and said to his father, "Bless me-me too, my father!"

27.zh: 以撒说：你兄弟已经用诡计来将你的福分夺去了。
27.en: But he said, "Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing."

27.zh: 以扫说：他名雅各，岂不是正对么？因为他欺骗了我两次：他从前夺了我长子的名分，你看，他现在又夺了我的福分。以扫又说：你没有留下为我可祝的福么？
27.en: Esau said, "Isn't he rightly named Jacob ? He has deceived me these two times: He took my birthright, and now he's taken my blessing!" Then he asked, "Haven't you reserved any blessing for me?"

27.zh: 以撒回答以扫说：我已立他为你的主，使他的弟兄都给他作仆人，并赐他五谷新酒可以养生。我儿，现在我还能为你做甚么呢？
27.en: Isaac answered Esau, "I have made him lord over you and have made all his relatives his servants, and I have sustained him with grain and new wine. So what can I possibly do for you, my son?"

27.zh: 以扫对他父亲说：父阿，你只有一样可祝的福么？我父阿，求你也为我祝福！以扫就放声而哭。
27.en: Esau said to his father, "Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me too, my father!" Then Esau wept aloud.

27.zh: 他父亲以撒说：地上的肥土必为你所住；天上的甘露必为你所得。
27.en: His father Isaac answered him, "Your dwelling will be away from the earth's richness, away from the dew of heaven above.

27.zh: 你必倚靠刀剑度日，又必事奉你的兄弟；到你强盛的时候，必从你颈项上挣开他的轭。
27.en: You will live by the sword and you will serve your brother. But when you grow restless, you will throw his yoke from off your neck."

27.zh: 以扫因他父亲给雅各祝的福，就怨恨雅各，心里说：为我父亲居丧的日子近了，到那时候，我要杀我的兄弟雅各。
27.en: Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing his father had given him. He said to himself, "The days of mourning for my father are near; then I will kill my brother Jacob."

27.zh: 有人把利百加大儿子以扫的话告诉利百加，他就打发人去，叫了他小儿子雅各来，对他说：你哥哥以扫想要杀你，报仇雪恨。
27.en: When Rebekah was told what her older son Esau had said, she sent for her younger son Jacob and said to him, "Your brother Esau is consoling himself with the thought of killing you.

27.zh: 现在，我儿，你要听我的话：起来，逃往哈兰 、 我哥哥拉班那里去，
27.en: Now then, my son, do what I say: Flee at once to my brother Laban in Haran.

27.zh: 同他住些日子，直等你哥哥的怒气消了。
27.en: Stay with him for a while until your brother's fury subsides.

27.zh: 你哥哥向你消了怒气，忘了你向他所做的事，我便打发人去把你从那里带回来。为甚么一日丧你们二人呢？
27.en: When your brother is no longer angry with you and forgets what you did to him, I'll send word for you to come back from there. Why should I lose both of you in one day?"

27.zh: 利百加对以撒说：我因这赫人的女子连性命都厌烦了；倘若雅各也娶赫人的女子为妻，像这些一样，我活著还有甚么益处呢？
27.en: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, "I'm disgusted with living because of these Hittite women. If Jacob takes a wife from among the women of this land, from Hittite women like these, my life will not be worth living."

28.zh: 以撒叫了雅各来，给他祝福，并嘱咐他说：你不要娶迦南的女子为妻。
28.en: So Isaac called for Jacob and blessed him and commanded him: "Do not marry a Canaanite woman.

28.zh: 你起身往巴旦亚兰去，到你外祖彼土利家里，在你母舅拉班的女儿中娶一女为妻。
28.en: Go at once to Paddan Aram, to the house of your mother's father Bethuel. Take a wife for yourself there, from among the daughters of Laban, your mother's brother.

28.zh: 愿全能的神赐福给你，使你生养众多，成为多族，
28.en: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and increase your numbers until you become a community of peoples.

28.zh: 将应许亚伯拉罕的福赐给你和你的后裔，使你承受你所寄居的地为业，就是神赐给亚伯拉罕的地。
28.en: May he give you and your descendants the blessing given to Abraham, so that you may take possession of the land where you now live as an alien, the land God gave to Abraham."

28.zh: 以撒打发雅各走了，他就往巴旦亚兰去，到亚兰人彼土利的儿子拉班那里。拉班是雅各 、 以扫的母舅。
28.en: Then Isaac sent Jacob on his way, and he went to Paddan Aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau.

28.zh: 以扫见以撒已经给雅各祝福，而且打发他往巴旦亚兰去，在那里娶妻，并见祝福的时候嘱咐他说：不要娶迦南的女子为妻，
28.en: Now Esau learned that Isaac had blessed Jacob and had sent him to Paddan Aram to take a wife from there, and that when he blessed him he commanded him, "Do not marry a Canaanite woman,"

28.zh: 又见雅各听从父母的话往巴旦亚兰去了，
28.en: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and mother and had gone to Paddan Aram.

28.zh: 以扫就晓得他父亲以撒看不中迦南的女子，
28.en: Esau then realized how displeasing the Canaanite women were to his father Isaac;

28.zh: 便往以实玛利那里去，在他二妻之外又娶了玛哈拉为妻。他是亚伯拉罕儿子以实玛利的女儿，尼拜约的妹子。
28.en: so he went to Ishmael and married Mahalath, the sister of Nebaioth and daughter of Ishmael son of Abraham, in addition to the wives he already had.

28.zh: 雅各出了别是巴，向哈兰走去；
28.en: Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Haran.

28.zh: 到了一个地方，因为太阳落了，就在那里住宿，便拾起那地方的一块石头枕在头下，在那里躺卧睡了，
28.en: When he reached a certain place, he stopped for the night because the sun had set. Taking one of the stones there, he put it under his head and lay down to sleep.

28.zh: 梦见一个梯子立在地上，梯子的头顶著天，有神的使者在梯子上，上去下来。
28.en: He had a dream in which he saw a stairway resting on the earth, with its top reaching to heaven, and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

28.zh: 耶和华站在梯子以上 ( 或作站在他旁边 ) ，说：我是耶和华 ─ 你祖亚伯拉罕的神，也是以撒的神；我要将你现在所躺卧之地赐给你和你的后裔。
28.en: There above it stood the Lord , and he said: "I am the Lord , the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you are lying.

28.zh: 你的后裔必像地上的尘沙那样多，必向东西南北开展；地上万族必因你和你的后裔得福。
28.en: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and to the east, to the north and to the south. All peoples on earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.

28.zh: 我也与你同在。你无论往那里去，我必保佑你，领你归回这地，总不离弃你，直到我成全了向你所应许的。
28.en: I am with you and will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you."

28.zh: 雅各睡醒了，说：耶和华真在这里，我竟不知道！
28.en: When Jacob awoke from his sleep, he thought, "Surely the Lord is in this place, and I was not aware of it."

28.zh: 就惧怕，说：这地方何等可畏！这不是别的，乃是神的殿，也是天的门。
28.en: He was afraid and said, "How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven."

28.zh: 雅各清早起来，把所枕的石头立作柱子，浇油在上面。
28.en: Early the next morning Jacob took the stone he had placed under his head and set it up as a pillar and poured oil on top of it.

28.zh: 他就给那地方起名叫伯特利 ( 就是神殿的意思 ) ；但那地方起先名叫路斯。
28.en: He called that place Bethel, though the city used to be called Luz.

28.zh: 雅各许愿说：神若与我同在，在我所行的路上保佑我，又给我食物吃，衣服穿，
28.en: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, "If God will be with me and will watch over me on this journey I am taking and will give me food to eat and clothes to wear

28.zh: 使我平平安安地回到我父亲的家，我就必以耶和华为我的神。
28.en: so that I return safely to my father's house, then the Lord will be my God

28.zh: 我所立为柱子的石头也必作神的殿，凡你所赐给我的，我必将十分之一献给你。
28.en: and this stone that I have set up as a pillar will be God's house, and of all that you give me I will give you a tenth."

29.zh: 雅各起行，到了东方人之地，
29.en: Then Jacob continued on his journey and came to the land of the eastern peoples.

29.zh: 看见田间有一口井，有三群羊卧在井旁；因为人饮羊群都是用那井里的水。井口上的石头是大的。
29.en: There he saw a well in the field, with three flocks of sheep lying near it because the flocks were watered from that well. The stone over the mouth of the well was large.

29.zh: 常有羊群在那里聚集，牧人把石头转离井口饮羊，随后又把石头放在井口的原处。
29.en: When all the flocks were gathered there, the shepherds would roll the stone away from the well's mouth and water the sheep. Then they would return the stone to its place over the mouth of the well.

29.zh: 雅各对牧人说：弟兄们，你们是那里来的？他们说：我们是哈兰来的。
29.en: Jacob asked the shepherds, "My brothers, where are you from?" "We're from Haran," they replied.

29.zh: 他问他们说：拿鹤的孙子拉班，你们认识么？他们说：我们认识。
29.en: He said to them, "Do you know Laban, Nahor's grandson?" "Yes, we know him," they answered.

29.zh: 雅各说：他平安么？他们说：平安。看哪，他女儿拉结领著羊来了。
29.en: Then Jacob asked them, "Is he well?" "Yes, he is," they said, "and here comes his daughter Rachel with the sheep."

29.zh: 雅各说：日头还高，不是羊群聚集的时候，你们不如饮羊，再去放一放。
29.en: "Look," he said, "the sun is still high; it is not time for the flocks to be gathered. Water the sheep and take them back to pasture."

29.zh: 他们说：我们不能，必等羊群聚齐，人把石头转离井口才可饮羊。
29.en: "We can't," they replied, "until all the flocks are gathered and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the well. Then we will water the sheep."

29.zh: 雅各正和他们说话的时候，拉结领著他父亲的羊来了，因为那些羊是他牧放的。
29.en: While he was still talking with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep, for she was a shepherdess.

29.zh: 雅各看见母舅拉班的女儿拉结和母舅拉班的羊群，就上前把石头转离井口，饮他母舅拉班的羊群。
29.en: When Jacob saw Rachel daughter of Laban, his mother's brother, and Laban's sheep, he went over and rolled the stone away from the mouth of the well and watered his uncle's sheep.

29.zh: 雅各与拉结亲嘴，就放声而哭。
29.en: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and began to weep aloud.

29.zh: 雅各告诉拉结，自己是他父亲的外甥，是利百加的儿子，拉结就跑去告诉他父亲。
29.en: He had told Rachel that he was a relative of her father and a son of Rebekah. So she ran and told her father.

29.zh: 拉班听见外甥雅各的信息，就跑去迎接，抱著他，与他亲嘴，领他到自己的家。雅各将一切的情由告诉拉班。
29.en: As soon as Laban heard the news about Jacob, his sister's son, he hurried to meet him. He embraced him and kissed him and brought him to his home, and there Jacob told him all these things.

29.zh: 拉班对他说：你实在是我的骨肉。雅各就和他同住了一个月。
29.en: Then Laban said to him, "You are my own flesh and blood." After Jacob had stayed with him for a whole month,

29.zh: 拉班对雅各说：你虽是我的骨肉 ( 原文作弟兄 ) ，岂可白白地服事我？请告诉我，你要甚么为工价？
29.en: Laban said to him, "Just because you are a relative of mine, should you work for me for nothing? Tell me what your wages should be."

29.zh: 拉班有两个女儿，大的名叫利亚，小的名叫拉结。
29.en: Now Laban had two daughters; the name of the older was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

29.zh: 利亚的眼睛没有神气，拉结却生得美貌俊秀。
29.en: Leah had weak eyes, but Rachel was lovely in form, and beautiful.

29.zh: 雅各爱拉结，就说：我愿为你小女儿拉结服事你七年。
29.en: Jacob was in love with Rachel and said, "I'll work for you seven years in return for your younger daughter Rachel."

29.zh: 拉班说：我把他给你，胜似给别人，你与我同住罢！
29.en: Laban said, "It's better that I give her to you than to some other man. Stay here with me."

29.zh: 雅各就为拉结服事了七年；他因为深爱拉结，就看这七年如同几天。
29.en: So Jacob served seven years to get Rachel, but they seemed like only a few days to him because of his love for her.

29.zh: 雅各对拉班说：日期已经满了，求你把我的妻子给我，我好与他同房。
29.en: Then Jacob said to Laban, "Give me my wife. My time is completed, and I want to lie with her."

29.zh: 拉班就摆设筵席，请齐了那地方的众人。
29.en: So Laban brought together all the people of the place and gave a feast.

29.zh: 到晚上，拉班将女儿利亚送来给雅各，雅各就与他同房。
29.en: But when evening came, he took his daughter Leah and gave her to Jacob, and Jacob lay with her.

29.zh: 拉班又将婢女悉帕给女儿利亚作使女。
29.en: And Laban gave his servant girl Zilpah to his daughter as her maidservant.

29.zh: 到了早晨，雅各一看是利亚，就对拉班说：你向我做的是甚么事呢？我服事你，不是为拉结么？你为甚么欺哄我呢？
29.en: When morning came, there was Leah! So Jacob said to Laban, "What is this you have done to me? I served you for Rachel, didn't I? Why have you deceived me?"

29.zh: 拉班说：大女儿还没有给人，先把小女儿给人，在我们这地方没有这规矩。
29.en: Laban replied, "It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older one.

29.zh: 你为这个满了七日，我就把那个也给你，你再为他服事我七年。
29.en: Finish this daughter's bridal week; then we will give you the younger one also, in return for another seven years of work."

29.zh: 雅各就如此行。满了利亚的七日，拉班便将女儿拉结给雅各为妻。
29.en: And Jacob did so. He finished the week with Leah, and then Laban gave him his daughter Rachel to be his wife.

29.zh: 拉班又将婢女辟拉给女儿拉结作使女。
29.en: Laban gave his servant girl Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her maidservant.

29.zh: 雅各也与拉结同房，并且爱拉结胜似爱利亚，于是又服事了拉班七年。
29.en: Jacob lay with Rachel also, and he loved Rachel more than Leah. And he worked for Laban another seven years.

29.zh: 耶和华见利亚失宠 ( 原文作被恨；下同 ) ，就使他生育，拉结却不生育。
29.en: When the Lord saw that Leah was not loved, he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.

29.zh: 利亚怀孕生子，就给他起名叫流便 ( 就是有儿子的意思 ) ，因而说：耶和华看见我的苦情，如今我的丈夫必爱我。
29.en: Leah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Reuben, for she said, "It is because the Lord has seen my misery. Surely my husband will love me now."

29.zh: 他又怀孕生子，就说：耶和华因为听见我失宠，所以又赐给我这个儿子，于是给他起名叫西缅 ( 就是听见的意思 ) 。
29.en: She conceived again, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "Because the Lord heard that I am not loved, he gave me this one too." So she named him Simeon.

29.zh: 他又怀孕生子，起名叫利未 ( 就是联合的意思 ) ，说：我给丈夫生了三个儿子，他必与我联合。
29.en: Again she conceived, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "Now at last my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons." So he was named Levi.

29.zh: 他又怀孕生子，说：这回我要赞美耶和华，因此给他起名叫犹大 ( 就是赞美的意思 ) 。这才停了生育。
29.en: She conceived again, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "This time I will praise the Lord ." So she named him Judah. Then she stopped having children.

30.zh: 拉结见自己不给雅各生子，就嫉妒他姊姊，对雅各说：你给我孩子，不然我就死了。
30.en: When Rachel saw that she was not bearing Jacob any children, she became jealous of her sister. So she said to Jacob, "Give me children, or I'll die!"

30.zh: 雅各向拉结生气，说：叫你不生育的是神，我岂能代替他作主呢？
30.en: Jacob became angry with her and said, "Am I in the place of God, who has kept you from having children?"

30.zh: 拉结说：有我的使女辟拉在这里，你可以与他同房，使他生子在我膝下，我便因他也得孩子 ( 原文作被建立 ) 。
30.en: Then she said, "Here is Bilhah, my maidservant. Sleep with her so that she can bear children for me and that through her I too can build a family."

30.zh: 拉结就把他的使女辟拉给丈夫为妾；雅各便与他同房，
30.en: So she gave him her servant Bilhah as a wife. Jacob slept with her,

30.zh: 辟拉就怀孕，给雅各生了一个儿子。
30.en: and she became pregnant and bore him a son.

30.zh: 拉结说：神伸了我的冤，也听了我的声音，赐我一个儿子，因此给他起名叫但 ( 就是伸冤的意思 ) 。
30.en: Then Rachel said, "God has vindicated me; he has listened to my plea and given me a son." Because of this she named him Dan.

30.zh: 拉结的使女辟拉又怀孕，给雅各生了第二个儿子。
30.en: Rachel's servant Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.

30.zh: 拉结说：我与我姊姊大大相争，并且得胜，于是给他起名叫拿弗他利 ( 就是相争的意思 ) 。
30.en: Then Rachel said, "I have had a great struggle with my sister, and I have won." So she named him Naphtali.

30.zh: 利亚见自己停了生育，就把使女悉帕给雅各为妾。
30.en: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children, she took her maidservant Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

30.zh: 利亚的使女悉帕给雅各生了一个儿子。
30.en: Leah's servant Zilpah bore Jacob a son.

30.zh: 利亚说：万幸！于是给他起名叫迦得 ( 就是万幸的意思 ) 。
30.en: Then Leah said, "What good fortune!" So she named him Gad.

30.zh: 利亚的使女悉帕又给雅各生了第二个儿子。
30.en: Leah's servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.

30.zh: 利亚说：我有福阿，众女子都要称我是有福的，于是给他起名叫亚设 ( 就是有福的意思 ) 。
30.en: Then Leah said, "How happy I am! The women will call me happy." So she named him Asher.

30.zh: 割麦子的时候，流便往田里去，寻见风茄，拿来给他母亲利亚。拉结对利亚说：请你把你儿子的风茄给我些。
30.en: During wheat harvest, Reuben went out into the fields and found some mandrake plants, which he brought to his mother Leah. Rachel said to Leah, "Please give me some of your son's mandrakes."

30.zh: 利亚说：你夺了我的丈夫还算小事么？你又要夺我儿子的风茄么？拉结说：为你儿子的风茄，今夜他可以与你同寝。
30.en: But she said to her, "Wasn't it enough that you took away my husband? Will you take my son's mandrakes too?" "Very well," Rachel said, "he can sleep with you tonight in return for your son's mandrakes."

30.zh: 到了晚上，雅各从田里回来，利亚出来迎接他，说：你要与我同寝，因为我实在用我儿子的风茄把你雇下了。那一夜，雅各就与他同寝。
30.en: So when Jacob came in from the fields that evening, Leah went out to meet him. "You must sleep with me," she said. "I have hired you with my son's mandrakes." So he slept with her that night.

30.zh: 神应允了利亚，他就怀孕，给雅各生了第五个儿子。
30.en: God listened to Leah, and she became pregnant and bore Jacob a fifth son.

30.zh: 利亚说：神给了我价值，因为我把使女给了我丈夫，于是给他起名叫以萨迦 ( 就是价值的意思 ) 。
30.en: Then Leah said, "God has rewarded me for giving my maidservant to my husband." So she named him Issachar.

30.zh: 利亚又怀孕，给雅各生了第六个儿子。
30.en: Leah conceived again and bore Jacob a sixth son.

30.zh: 利亚说：神赐我厚赏；我丈夫必与我同住，因我给他生了六个儿子，于是给他起名西布伦 ( 就是同住的意思 ) 。
30.en: Then Leah said, "God has presented me with a precious gift. This time my husband will treat me with honor, because I have borne him six sons." So she named him Zebulun.

30.zh: 后来又生了一个女儿，给他起名叫底拿。
30.en: Some time later she gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.

30.zh: 神顾念拉结，应允了他，使他能生育。
30.en: Then God remembered Rachel; he listened to her and opened her womb.

30.zh: 拉结怀孕生子，说：神除去了我的羞耻，
30.en: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son and said, "God has taken away my disgrace."

30.zh: 就给他起名叫约瑟 ( 就是增添的意思 ) ，意思说：愿耶和华再增添我一个儿子。
30.en: She named him Joseph, and said, "May the Lord add to me another son."

30.zh: 拉结生约瑟之后，雅各对拉班说：请打发我走，叫我回到我本乡本土去。
30.en: After Rachel gave birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, "Send me on my way so I can go back to my own homeland.

30.zh: 请你把我服事你所得的妻子和儿女给我，让我走；我怎样服事你，你都知道。
30.en: Give me my wives and children, for whom I have served you, and I will be on my way. You know how much work I've done for you."

30.zh: 拉班对他说：我若在你眼前蒙恩，请你仍与我同住，因为我已算定，耶和华赐福与我是为你的缘故；
30.en: But Laban said to him, "If I have found favor in your eyes, please stay. I have learned by divination that the Lord has blessed me because of you."

30.zh: 又说：请你定你的工价，我就给你。
30.en: He added, "Name your wages, and I will pay them."

30.zh: 雅各对他说：我怎样服事你，你的牲畜在我手里怎样，是你知道的。
30.en: Jacob said to him, "You know how I have worked for you and how your livestock has fared under my care.

30.zh: 我未来之先，你所有的很少，现今却发大众多，耶和华随我的脚步赐福与你。如今，我甚么时候才为自己兴家立业呢？
30.en: The little you had before I came has increased greatly, and the Lord has blessed you wherever I have been. But now, when may I do something for my own household?"

30.zh: 拉班说：我当给你甚么呢？雅各说：甚么你也不必给我，只有一件事，你若应承，我便仍旧牧放你的羊群。
30.en: "What shall I give you?" he asked. "Don't give me anything," Jacob replied. "But if you will do this one thing for me, I will go on tending your flocks and watching over them:

30.zh: 今天我要走遍你的羊群，把绵羊中凡有点的 、 有斑的，和黑色的，并山羊中凡有斑的 、 有点的，都挑出来；将来这一等的就算我的工价。
30.en: Let me go through all your flocks today and remove from them every speckled or spotted sheep, every dark-colored lamb and every spotted or speckled goat. They will be my wages.

30.zh: 以后你来查看我的工价，凡在我手里的山羊不是有点有斑的，绵羊不是黑色的，那就算是我偷的；这样便可证出我的公义来。
30.en: And my honesty will testify for me in the future, whenever you check on the wages you have paid me. Any goat in my possession that is not speckled or spotted, or any lamb that is not dark-colored, will be considered stolen."

30.zh: 拉班说：好阿！我情愿照著你的话行。
30.en: "Agreed," said Laban. "Let it be as you have said."

30.zh: 当日，拉班把有纹的 、 有斑的公山羊，有点的 、 有斑的 、 有杂白纹的母山羊，并黑色的绵羊，都挑出来，交在他儿子们的手下，
30.en: That same day he removed all the male goats that were streaked or spotted, and all the speckled or spotted female goats (all that had white on them) and all the dark-colored lambs, and he placed them in the care of his sons.

30.zh: 又使自己和雅各相离三天的路程。雅各就牧养拉班其余的羊。
30.en: Then he put a three-day journey between himself and Jacob, while Jacob continued to tend the rest of Laban's flocks.

30.zh: 雅各拿杨树 、 杏树 、 枫树的嫩枝，将皮剥成白纹，使枝子露出白的来，
30.en: Jacob, however, took fresh-cut branches from poplar, almond and plane trees and made white stripes on them by peeling the bark and exposing the white inner wood of the branches.

30.zh: 将剥了皮的枝子，对著羊群，插在饮羊的水沟里和水槽里，羊来喝的时候，牝牡配合。
30.en: Then he placed the peeled branches in all the watering troughs, so that they would be directly in front of the flocks when they came to drink. When the flocks were in heat and came to drink,

30.zh: 羊对著枝子配合，就生下有纹的 、 有点的 、 有斑的来。
30.en: they mated in front of the branches. And they bore young that were streaked or speckled or spotted.

30.zh: 雅各把羊羔分出来，使拉班的羊与这有纹和黑色的羊相对，把自己的羊另放一处，不叫他和拉班的羊混杂。
30.en: Jacob set apart the young of the flock by themselves, but made the rest face the streaked and dark-colored animals that belonged to Laban. Thus he made separate flocks for himself and did not put them with Laban's animals.

30.zh: 到羊群肥壮配合的时候，雅各就把枝子插在水沟里，使羊对著枝子配合。
30.en: Whenever the stronger females were in heat, Jacob would place the branches in the troughs in front of the animals so they would mate near the branches,

30.zh: 只是到羊瘦弱配合的时候就不插枝子。这样，瘦弱的就归拉班，肥壮的就归雅各。
30.en: but if the animals were weak, he would not place them there. So the weak animals went to Laban and the strong ones to Jacob.

30.zh: 于是雅各极其发大，得了许多的羊群 、 仆婢 、 骆驼，和驴。
30.en: In this way the man grew exceedingly prosperous and came to own large flocks, and maidservants and menservants, and camels and donkeys.

31.zh: 雅各听见拉班的儿子们有话说：雅各把我们父亲所有的都夺了去，并藉著我们父亲的，得了这一切的荣耀 ( 或作财 ) 。
31.en: Jacob heard that Laban's sons were saying, "Jacob has taken everything our father owned and has gained all this wealth from what belonged to our father."

31.zh: 雅各见拉班的气色向他不如从前了。
31.en: And Jacob noticed that Laban's attitude toward him was not what it had been.

31.zh: 耶和华对雅各说：你要回你祖 、 你父之地，到你亲族那里去，我必与你同在。
31.en: Then the Lord said to Jacob, "Go back to the land of your fathers and to your relatives, and I will be with you."

31.zh: 雅各就打发人，叫拉结和利亚到田野羊群那里来，
31.en: So Jacob sent word to Rachel and Leah to come out to the fields where his flocks were.

31.zh: 对他们说：我看你们父亲的气色向我不如从前了；但我父亲的神向来与我同在。
31.en: He said to them, "I see that your father's attitude toward me is not what it was before, but the God of my father has been with me.

31.zh: 你们也知道，我尽了我的力量服事你们的父亲。
31.en: You know that I've worked for your father with all my strength,

31.zh: 你们的父亲欺哄我，十次改了我的工价；然而神不容他害我。
31.en: yet your father has cheated me by changing my wages ten times. However, God has not allowed him to harm me.

31.zh: 他若说：有点的归你作工价，羊群所生的都有点；他若说：有纹的归你作工价，羊群所生的都有纹。
31.en: If he said, 'The speckled ones will be your wages,' then all the flocks gave birth to speckled young; and if he said, 'The streaked ones will be your wages,' then all the flocks bore streaked young.

31.zh: 这样，神把你们父亲的牲畜夺来赐给我了。
31.en: So God has taken away your father's livestock and has given them to me.

31.zh: 羊配合的时候，我梦中举目一看，见跳母羊的公羊都是有纹的 、 有点的 、 有花斑的。
31.en: "In breeding season I once had a dream in which I looked up and saw that the male goats mating with the flock were streaked, speckled or spotted.

31.zh: 神的使者在那梦中呼叫我说：雅各。我说：我在这里。
31.en: The angel of God said to me in the dream, 'Jacob.' I answered, 'Here I am.'

31.zh: 他说：你举目观看，跳母羊的公羊都是有纹的 、 有点的 、 有花斑的；凡拉班向你所做的，我都看见了。
31.en: And he said, 'Look up and see that all the male goats mating with the flock are streaked, speckled or spotted, for I have seen all that Laban has been doing to you.

31.zh: 我是伯特利的神；你在那里用油浇过柱子，向我许过愿。现今你起来，离开这地，回你本地去罢！
31.en: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar and where you made a vow to me. Now leave this land at once and go back to your native land.' "

31.zh: 拉结和利亚回答雅各说：在我们父亲的家里还有我们可得的分么？还有我们的产业么？
31.en: Then Rachel and Leah replied, "Do we still have any share in the inheritance of our father's estate?

31.zh: 我们不是被他当作外人么？因为他卖了我们，吞了我们的价值。
31.en: Does he not regard us as foreigners? Not only has he sold us, but he has used up what was paid for us.

31.zh: 神从我们父亲所夺出来的一切财物，那就是我们和我们孩子们的。现今凡神所吩咐你的，你只管去行罢！
31.en: Surely all the wealth that God took away from our father belongs to us and our children. So do whatever God has told you."

31.zh: 雅各起来，使他的儿子和妻子都骑上骆驼，
31.en: Then Jacob put his children and his wives on camels,

31.zh: 又带著他在巴旦亚兰所得的一切牲畜和财物，往迦南地 、 他父亲以撒那里去了。
31.en: and he drove all his livestock ahead of him, along with all the goods he had accumulated in Paddan Aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land of Canaan.

31.zh: 当时拉班剪羊毛去了，拉结偷了他父亲家中的神像。
31.en: When Laban had gone to shear his sheep, Rachel stole her father's household gods.

31.zh: 雅各背著亚兰人拉班偷走了，并不告诉他，
31.en: Moreover, Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not telling him he was running away.

31.zh: 就带著所有的逃跑。他起身过大河，面向基列山行去。
31.en: So he fled with all he had, and crossing the River, he headed for the hill country of Gilead.

31.zh: 到第三日，有人告诉拉班，雅各逃跑了。
31.en: On the third day Laban was told that Jacob had fled.

31.zh: 拉班带领他的众弟兄去追赶，追了七日，在基列山就追上了。
31.en: Taking his relatives with him, he pursued Jacob for seven days and caught up with him in the hill country of Gilead.

31.zh: 夜间，神到亚兰人拉班那里，在梦中对他说：你要小心，不可与雅各说好说歹。
31.en: Then God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream at night and said to him, "Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad."

31.zh: 拉班追上雅各。雅各在山上支搭帐棚；拉班和他的众弟兄也在基列山上支搭帐棚。
31.en: Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of Gilead when Laban overtook him, and Laban and his relatives camped there too.

31.zh: 拉班对雅各说：你做的是甚么事呢？你背著我偷走了，又把我的女儿们带了去，如同用刀剑掳去的一般。
31.en: Then Laban said to Jacob, "What have you done? You've deceived me, and you've carried off my daughters like captives in war.

31.zh: 你为甚么暗暗地逃跑，偷著走，并不告诉我，叫我可以欢乐 、 唱歌 、 击鼓 、 弹琴的送你回去？
31.en: Why did you run off secretly and deceive me? Why didn't you tell me, so I could send you away with joy and singing to the music of tambourines and harps?

31.zh: 又不容我与外孙和女儿亲嘴？你所行的真是愚昧！
31.en: You didn't even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters good-by. You have done a foolish thing.

31.zh: 我手中原有能力害你，只是你父亲的神昨夜对我说：你要小心，不可与雅各说好说歹。
31.en: I have the power to harm you; but last night the God of your father said to me, 'Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.'

31.zh: 现在你虽然想你父家，不得不去，为甚么又偷了我的神像呢？
31.en: Now you have gone off because you longed to return to your father's house. But why did you steal my gods?"

31.zh: 雅各回答拉班说：恐怕你把你的女儿从我夺去，所以我逃跑。
31.en: Jacob answered Laban, "I was afraid, because I thought you would take your daughters away from me by force.

31.zh: 至于你的神像，你在谁那里搜出来，就不容谁存活。当著我们的众弟兄，你认一认，在我这里有甚么东西是你的，就拿去。原来雅各不知道拉结偷了那些神像。
31.en: But if you find anyone who has your gods, he shall not live. In the presence of our relatives, see for yourself whether there is anything of yours here with me; and if so, take it." Now Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen the gods.

31.zh: 拉班进了雅各 、 利亚，并两个使女的帐棚，都没有搜出来，就从利亚的帐棚出来，进了拉结的帐棚。
31.en: So Laban went into Jacob's tent and into Leah's tent and into the tent of the two maidservants, but he found nothing. After he came out of Leah's tent, he entered Rachel's tent.

31.zh: 拉结已经把神像藏在骆驼的驮篓里，便坐在上头。拉班摸遍了那帐棚，并没有摸著。
31.en: Now Rachel had taken the household gods and put them inside her camel's saddle and was sitting on them. Laban searched through everything in the tent but found nothing.

31.zh: 拉结对他父亲说：现在我身上不便，不能在你面前起来，求我主不要生气。这样，拉班搜寻神像，竟没有搜出来。
31.en: Rachel said to her father, "Don't be angry, my lord, that I cannot stand up in your presence; I'm having my period." So he searched but could not find the household gods.

31.zh: 雅各就发怒斥责拉班说：我有甚么过犯，有甚么罪恶，你竟这样火速的追我？
31.en: Jacob was angry and took Laban to task. "What is my crime?" he asked Laban. "What sin have I committed that you hunt me down?

31.zh: 你摸遍了我一切的家具，你搜出甚么来呢？可以放在你我弟兄面前，叫他们在你我中间辨别辨别。
31.en: Now that you have searched through all my goods, what have you found that belongs to your household? Put it here in front of your relatives and mine, and let them judge between the two of us.

31.zh: 我在你家这二十年，你的母绵羊 、 母山羊没有掉过胎。你群中的公羊，我没有吃过；
31.en: "I have been with you for twenty years now. Your sheep and goats have not miscarried, nor have I eaten rams from your flocks.

31.zh: 被野兽撕裂的，我没有带来给你，是我自己赔上。无论是白日，是黑夜，被偷去的，你都向我索要。
31.en: I did not bring you animals torn by wild beasts; I bore the loss myself. And you demanded payment from me for whatever was stolen by day or night.

31.zh: 我白日受尽干热，黑夜受尽寒霜，不得合眼睡著，我常是这样。
31.en: This was my situation: The heat consumed me in the daytime and the cold at night, and sleep fled from my eyes.

31.zh: 我这二十年在你家里，为你的两个女儿服事你十四年，为你的羊群服事你六年，你又十次改了我的工价。
31.en: It was like this for the twenty years I was in your household. I worked for you fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for your flocks, and you changed my wages ten times.

31.zh: 若不是我父亲以撒所敬畏的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神与我同在，你如今必定打发我空手而去。神看见我的苦情和我的劳碌，就在昨夜责备你。
31.en: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, you would surely have sent me away empty-handed. But God has seen my hardship and the toil of my hands, and last night he rebuked you."

31.zh: 拉班回答雅各说：这女儿是我的女儿，这些孩子是我的孩子，这些羊群也是我的羊群；凡在你眼前的都是我的。我的女儿并他们所生的孩子，我今日能向他们做甚么呢？
31.en: Laban answered Jacob, "The women are my daughters, the children are my children, and the flocks are my flocks. All you see is mine. Yet what can I do today about these daughters of mine, or about the children they have borne?

31.zh: 来罢！你我二人可以立约，作你我中间的证据。
31.en: Come now, let's make a covenant, you and I, and let it serve as a witness between us."

31.zh: 雅各就拿一块石头立作柱子，
31.en: So Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.

31.zh: 又对众弟兄说：你们堆聚石头。他们就拿石头来堆成一堆，大家便在旁边吃喝。
31.en: He said to his relatives, "Gather some stones." So they took stones and piled them in a heap, and they ate there by the heap.

31.zh: 拉班称那石堆为伊迦尔撒哈杜他，雅各却称那石堆为迦累得 ( 都是以石堆为证的意思 ) 。
31.en: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed.

31.zh: 拉班说：今日这石堆作你我中间的证据。因此这地方名叫迦累得，
31.en: Laban said, "This heap is a witness between you and me today." That is why it was called Galeed.

31.zh: 又叫米斯巴，意思说：我们彼此离别以后，愿耶和华在你我中间鉴察。
31.en: It was also called Mizpah, because he said, "May the Lord keep watch between you and me when we are away from each other.

31.zh: 你若苦待我的女儿，又在我的女儿以外另娶妻，虽没有人知道，却有神在你我中间作见证。
31.en: If you mistreat my daughters or if you take any wives besides my daughters, even though no one is with us, remember that God is a witness between you and me."

31.zh: 拉班又说：你看我在你我中间所立的这石堆和柱子。
31.en: Laban also said to Jacob, "Here is this heap, and here is this pillar I have set up between you and me.

31.zh: 这石堆作证据，这柱子也作证据。我必不过这石堆去害你；你也不可过这石堆和柱子来害我。
31.en: This heap is a witness, and this pillar is a witness, that I will not go past this heap to your side to harm you and that you will not go past this heap and pillar to my side to harm me.

31.zh: 但愿亚伯拉罕的神和拿鹤的神，就是他们父亲的神，在你我中间判断。雅各就指著他父亲以撒所敬畏的神起誓，
31.en: May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us." So Jacob took an oath in the name of the Fear of his father Isaac.

31.zh: 又在山上献祭，请众弟兄来吃饭。他们吃了饭，便在山上住宿。
31.en: He offered a sacrifice there in the hill country and invited his relatives to a meal. After they had eaten, they spent the night there.

31.zh: 拉班清早起来，与他外孙和女儿亲嘴，给他们祝福，回往自己的地方去了。
31.en: Early the next morning Laban kissed his grandchildren and his daughters and blessed them. Then he left and returned home.

32.zh: 雅各仍旧行路，神的使者遇见他。
32.en: Jacob also went on his way, andthe angels of God met him.

32.zh: 雅各看见他们就说：这是神的军兵，于是给那地方起名叫玛哈念 ( 就是二军兵的意思 ) 。
32.en: When Jacob saw them, he said, "This is the camp of God!" So he named that place Mahanaim.

32.zh: 雅各打发人先往西珥地去，就是以东地，见他哥哥以扫，
32.en: Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

32.zh: 吩咐他们说：你们对我主以扫说：你的仆人雅各这样说：我在拉班那里寄居，直到如今。
32.en: He instructed them: "This is what you are to say to my master Esau: 'Your servant Jacob says, I have been staying with Laban and have remained there till now.

32.zh: 我有牛 、 驴 、 羊群 、 仆婢，现在打发人来报告我主，为要在你眼前蒙恩。
32.en: I have cattle and donkeys, sheep and goats, menservants and maidservants. Now I am sending this message to my lord, that I may find favor in your eyes.' "

32.zh: 所打发的人回到雅各那里，说：我们到了你哥哥以扫那里，他带著四百人，正迎著你来。
32.en: When the messengers returned to Jacob, they said, "We went to your brother Esau, and now he is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him."

32.zh: 雅各就甚惧怕，而且愁烦，便把那与他同在的人口和羊群 、 牛群 、 骆驼分做两队，
32.en: In great fear and distress Jacob divided the people who were with him into two groups, and the flocks and herds and camels as well.

32.zh: 说：以扫若来击杀这一队，剩下的那一队还可以逃避。
32.en: He thought, "If Esau comes and attacks one group, the group that is left may escape."

32.zh: 雅各说：耶和华 ─ 我祖亚伯拉罕的神，我父亲以撒的神阿，你曾对我说：回你本地本族去，我要厚待你。
32.en: Then Jacob prayed, "O God of my father Abraham, God of my father Isaac, O Lord , who said to me, 'Go back to your country and your relatives, and I will make you prosper,'

32.zh: 你向仆人所施的一切慈爱和诚实，我一点也不配得；我先前只拿著我的杖过这约但河，如今我却成了两队了。
32.en: I am unworthy of all the kindness and faithfulness you have shown your servant. I had only my staff when I crossed this Jordan, but now I have become two groups.

32.zh: 求你救我脱离我哥哥以扫的手；因为我怕他来杀我，连妻子带儿女一同杀了。
32.en: Save me, I pray, from the hand of my brother Esau, for I am afraid he will come and attack me, and also the mothers with their children.

32.zh: 你曾说：我必定厚待你，使你的后裔如同海边的沙，多得不可胜数。
32.en: But you have said, 'I will surely make you prosper and will make your descendants like the sand of the sea, which cannot be counted.' "

32.zh: 当夜，雅各在那里住宿，就从他所有的物中拿礼物要送给他哥哥以扫：
32.en: He spent the night there, and from what he had with him he selected a gift for his brother Esau:

32.zh: 母山羊二百只，公山羊二十只，母绵羊二百只，公绵羊二十只，
32.en: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,

32.zh: 奶崽子的骆驼三十只 ─ 各带著崽子，母牛四十只，公牛十只，母驴二十匹，驴驹十匹；
32.en: thirty female camels with their young, forty cows and ten bulls, and twenty female donkeys and ten male donkeys.

32.zh: 每样各分一群，交在仆人手下，就对仆人说：你们要在我前头过去，使群群相离，有空闲的地方；
32.en: He put them in the care of his servants, each herd by itself, and said to his servants, "Go ahead of me, and keep some space between the herds."

32.zh: 又吩咐尽先走的说：我哥哥以扫遇见你的时候，问你说：你是那家的人？要往那里去？你前头？这些是谁的？
32.en: He instructed the one in the lead: "When my brother Esau meets you and asks, 'To whom do you belong, and where are you going, and who owns all these animals in front of you?'

32.zh: 你就说：是你仆人雅各的，是送给我主以扫的礼物；他自己也在我们后边？。
32.en: then you are to say, 'They belong to your servant Jacob. They are a gift sent to my lord Esau, and he is coming behind us.' "

32.zh: 又吩咐第二 、 第三，和一切赶群畜的人说：你们遇见以扫的时候也要这样对他说；
32.en: He also instructed the second, the third and all the others who followed the herds: "You are to say the same thing to Esau when you meet him.

32.zh: 并且你们要说：你仆人雅各在我们后边。因雅各心里说：我藉著在我前头去的礼物解他的恨，然后再见他的面，或者他容纳我。
32.en: And be sure to say, 'Your servant Jacob is coming behind us.' " For he thought, "I will pacify him with these gifts I am sending on ahead; later, when I see him, perhaps he will receive me."

32.zh: 于是礼物先过去了；那夜，雅各在队中住宿。
32.en: So Jacob's gifts went on ahead of him, but he himself spent the night in the camp.

32.zh: 他夜间起来，带著两个妻子，两个使女，并十一个儿子，都过了雅博渡口，
32.en: That night Jacob got up and took his two wives, his two maidservants and his eleven sons and crossed the ford of the Jabbok.

32.zh: 先打发他们过河，又打发所有的都过去，
32.en: After he had sent them across the stream, he sent over all his possessions.

32.zh: 只剩下雅各一人。有一个人来和他摔跤，直到黎明。
32.en: So Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him till daybreak.

32.zh: 那人见自己胜不过他，就将他的大腿窝摸了一把，雅各的大腿窝正在摔跤的时候就扭了。
32.en: When the man saw that he could not overpower him, he touched the socket of Jacob's hip so that his hip was wrenched as he wrestled with the man.

32.zh: 那人说：天黎明了，容我去罢！雅各说：你不给我祝福，我就不容你去。
32.en: Then the man said, "Let me go, for it is daybreak." But Jacob replied, "I will not let you go unless you bless me."

32.zh: 那人说：你名叫甚么？他说：我名叫雅各。
32.en: The man asked him, "What is your name?" "Jacob," he answered.

32.zh: 那人说：你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列；因为你与神与人较力，都得了胜。
32.en: Then the man said, "Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with men and have overcome."

32.zh: 雅各问他说：请将你的名告诉我。那人说：何必问我的名？于是在那里给雅各祝福。
32.en: Jacob said, "Please tell me your name." But he replied, "Why do you ask my name?" Then he blessed him there.

32.zh: 雅各便给那地方起名叫毘努伊勒 ( 就是神之面的意思 ) ，意思说：我面对面见了神，我的性命仍得保全。
32.en: So Jacob called the place Peniel, saying, "It is because I saw God face to face, and yet my life was spared."

32.zh: 日头刚出来的时候，雅各经过毘努伊勒，他的大腿就瘸了。
32.en: The sun rose above him as he passed Peniel, and he was limping because of his hip.

32.zh: 故此，以色列人不吃大腿窝的筋，直到今日，因为那人摸了雅各大腿窝的筋。
32.en: Therefore to this day the Israelites do not eat the tendon attached to the socket of the hip, because the socket of Jacob's hip was touched near the tendon.

33.zh: 雅各举目观看，见以扫来了，后头跟著四百人，他就把孩子们分开交给利亚 、 拉结，和两个使女，
33.en: Jacob looked up and there wasEsau, coming with his four hundred men; so he divided the children among Leah, Rachel and the two maidservants.

33.zh: 并且叫两个使女和他们的孩子在前头，利亚和他的孩子在后头，拉结和约瑟在尽后头。
33.en: He put the maidservants and their children in front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph in the rear.

33.zh: 他自己在他们前头过去，一连七次俯伏在地才就近他哥哥。
33.en: He himself went on ahead and bowed down to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.

33.zh: 以扫跑来迎接他，将他抱住，又搂著他的颈项，与他亲嘴，两个人就哭了。
33.en: But Esau ran to meet Jacob and embraced him; he threw his arms around his neck and kissed him. And they wept.

33.zh: 以扫举目看见妇人孩子，就说：这些？和你同行的是谁呢？雅各说：这些孩子是神施恩给你的仆人的。
33.en: Then Esau looked up and saw the women and children. "Who are these with you?" he asked. Jacob answered, "They are the children God has graciously given your servant."

33.zh: 于是两个使女和他们的孩子前来下拜；
33.en: Then the maidservants and their children approached and bowed down.

33.zh: 利亚和他的孩子也前来下拜；随后约瑟和拉结也前来下拜。
33.en: Next, Leah and her children came and bowed down. Last of all came Joseph and Rachel, and they too bowed down.

33.zh: 以扫说：我所遇见的这些群畜是甚么意思呢？雅各说：是要在我主面前蒙恩的。
33.en: Esau asked, "What do you mean by all these droves I met?" "To find favor in your eyes, my lord," he said.

33.zh: 以扫说：兄弟阿，我的已经够了，你的仍归你罢！
33.en: But Esau said, "I already have plenty, my brother. Keep what you have for yourself."

33.zh: 雅各说：不然，我若在你眼前蒙恩，就求你从我手里收下这礼物；因为我见了你的面，如同见了神的面，并且你容纳了我。
33.en: "No, please!" said Jacob. "If I have found favor in your eyes, accept this gift from me. For to see your face is like seeing the face of God, now that you have received me favorably.

33.zh: 求你收下我带来给你的礼物；因为神恩待我，使我充足。雅各再三地求他，他才收下了。
33.en: Please accept the present that was brought to you, for God has been gracious to me and I have all I need." And because Jacob insisted, Esau accepted it.

33.zh: 以扫说：我们可以起身前往，我在你前头走。
33.en: Then Esau said, "Let us be on our way; I'll accompany you."

33.zh: 雅各对他说：我主知道孩子们年幼娇嫩，牛羊也正在乳养的时候，若是催赶一天，群畜都必死了。
33.en: But Jacob said to him, "My lord knows that the children are tender and that I must care for the ewes and cows that are nursing their young. If they are driven hard just one day, all the animals will die.

33.zh: 求我主在仆人前头走，我要量著在我面前群畜和孩子的力量慢慢地前行，直走到西珥我主那里。
33.en: So let my lord go on ahead of his servant, while I move along slowly at the pace of the droves before me and that of the children, until I come to my lord in Seir."

33.zh: 以扫说：容我把跟随我的人留几个在你这里。雅各说：何必呢？只要在我主眼前蒙恩就是了。
33.en: Esau said, "Then let me leave some of my men with you." "But why do that?" Jacob asked. "Just let me find favor in the eyes of my lord."

33.zh: 于是，以扫当日起行，回往西珥去了。
33.en: So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir.

33.zh: 雅各就往疏割去，在那里为自己盖造房屋，又为牲畜搭棚；因此那地方名叫疏割 ( 就是棚的意思 ) 。
33.en: Jacob, however, went to Succoth, where he built a place for himself and made shelters for his livestock. That is why the place is called Succoth.

33.zh: 雅各从巴旦亚兰回来的时候，平平安安地到了迦南地的示剑城，在城东支搭帐棚，
33.en: After Jacob came from Paddan Aram, he arrived safely at the city of Shechem in Canaan and camped within sight of the city.

33.zh: 就用一百块银子向示剑的父亲 、 哈抹的子孙买了支帐棚的那块地，
33.en: For a hundred pieces of silver, he bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, the plot of ground where he pitched his tent.

33.zh: 在那里筑了一座坛，起名叫伊利伊罗伊以色列 ( 就是神 、 以色列神的意思 ) 。
33.en: There he set up an altar and called it El Elohe Israel.

34.zh: 利亚给雅各所生的女儿底拿出去，要见那地的女子们。
34.en: Now Dinah, the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to visit the women of the land.

34.zh: 那地的主 ─ 希未人 、 哈抹的儿子示剑看见他，就拉住他，与他行淫，玷辱他。
34.en: When Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, the ruler of that area, saw her, he took her and violated her.

34.zh: 示剑的心系恋雅各的女儿底拿，喜爱这女子，甜言蜜语地安慰他。
34.en: His heart was drawn to Dinah daughter of Jacob, and he loved the girl and spoke tenderly to her.

34.zh: 示剑对他父亲哈抹说：求你为我聘这女子为妻。
34.en: And Shechem said to his father Hamor, "Get me this girl as my wife."

34.zh: 雅各听见示剑玷污了他的女儿底拿。那时他的儿子们正和群畜在田野，雅各就闭口不言，等他们回来。
34.en: When Jacob heard that his daughter Dinah had been defiled, his sons were in the fields with his livestock; so he kept quiet about it until they came home.

34.zh: 示剑的父亲哈抹出来见雅各，要和他商议。
34.en: Then Shechem's father Hamor went out to talk with Jacob.

34.zh: 雅各的儿子们听见这事，就从田野回来，人人忿恨，十分恼怒；因示剑在以色列家作了丑事，与雅各的女儿行淫，这本是不该做的事。
34.en: Now Jacob's sons had come in from the fields as soon as they heard what had happened. They were filled with grief and fury, because Shechem had done a disgraceful thing in Israel by lying with Jacob's daughter-a thing that should not be done.

34.zh: 哈抹和他们商议说：我儿子示剑的心恋慕这女子，求你们将他给我的儿子为妻。
34.en: But Hamor said to them, "My son Shechem has his heart set on your daughter. Please give her to him as his wife.

34.zh: 你们与我们彼此结亲；你们可以把女儿给我们，也可以娶我们的女儿。
34.en: Intermarry with us; give us your daughters and take our daughters for yourselves.

34.zh: 你们与我们同住罢！这地都在你们面前，只管在此居住，做买卖，置产业。
34.en: You can settle among us; the land is open to you. Live in it, trade in it, and acquire property in it."

34.zh: 示剑对女儿的父亲和弟兄们说：但愿我在你们眼前蒙恩，你们向我要甚么，我必给你们。
34.en: Then Shechem said to Dinah's father and brothers, "Let me find favor in your eyes, and I will give you whatever you ask.

34.zh: 任凭向我要多重的聘金和礼物，我必照你们所说的给你们；只要把女子给我为妻。
34.en: Make the price for the bride and the gift I am to bring as great as you like, and I'll pay whatever you ask me. Only give me the girl as my wife."

34.zh: 雅各的儿子们因为示剑玷污了他们的妹子底拿，就用诡诈的话回答示剑和他父亲哈抹，
34.en: Because their sister Dinah had been defiled, Jacob's sons replied deceitfully as they spoke to Shechem and his father Hamor.

34.zh: 对他们说：我们不能把我们的妹子给没有受割礼的人为妻，因为那是我们的羞辱。
34.en: They said to them, "We can't do such a thing; we can't give our sister to a man who is not circumcised. That would be a disgrace to us.

34.zh: 惟有一件才可以应允：若你们所有的男丁都受割礼，和我们一样，
34.en: We will give our consent to you on one condition only: that you become like us by circumcising all your males.

34.zh: 我们就把女儿给你们，也娶你们的女儿；我们便与你们同住，两下成为一样的人民。
34.en: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves. We'll settle among you and become one people with you.

34.zh: 倘若你们不听从我们受割礼，我们就带著妹子走了。
34.en: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, we'll take our sister and go."

34.zh: 哈抹和他的儿子示剑喜欢这话。
34.en: Their proposal seemed good to Hamor and his son Shechem.

34.zh: 那少年人做这事并不迟延，因为他喜爱雅各的女儿；他在他父亲家中也是人最尊重的。
34.en: The young man, who was the most honored of all his father's household, lost no time in doing what they said, because he was delighted with Jacob's daughter.

34.zh: 哈抹和他儿子示剑到本城的门口，对本城的人说：
34.en: So Hamor and his son Shechem went to the gate of their city to speak to their fellow townsmen.

34.zh: 这些人与我们和睦，不如许他们在这地居住，做买卖；这地也宽阔，足可容下他们。我们可以娶他们的女儿为妻，也可以把我们的女儿嫁给他们。
34.en: "These men are friendly toward us," they said. "Let them live in our land and trade in it; the land has plenty of room for them. We can marry their daughters and they can marry ours.

34.zh: 惟有一件事我们必须做，他们才肯应允和我们同住，成为一样的人民：就是我们中间所有的男丁都要受割礼，和他们一样。
34.en: But the men will consent to live with us as one people only on the condition that our males be circumcised, as they themselves are.

34.zh: 他们的群畜 、 货财，和一切的牲口岂不都归我们么？只要依从他们，他们就与我们同住。
34.en: Won't their livestock, their property and all their other animals become ours? So let us give our consent to them, and they will settle among us."

34.zh: 凡从城门出入的人就都听从哈抹和他儿子示剑的话；于是凡从城门出入的男丁都受了割礼。
34.en: All the men who went out of the city gate agreed with Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male in the city was circumcised.

34.zh: 到第三天，众人正在疼痛的时候，雅各的两个儿子，就是底拿的哥哥西缅和利未，各拿刀剑，趁著众人想不到的时候来到城中，把一切男丁都杀了，
34.en: Three days later, while all of them were still in pain, two of Jacob's sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, took their swords and attacked the unsuspecting city, killing every male.

34.zh: 又用刀杀了哈抹和他儿子示剑，把底拿从示剑家里带出来就走了。
34.en: They put Hamor and his son Shechem to the sword and took Dinah from Shechem's house and left.

34.zh: 雅各的儿子们因为他们的妹子受了玷污，就来到被杀的人那里，掳掠那城，
34.en: The sons of Jacob came upon the dead bodies and looted the city where their sister had been defiled.

34.zh: 夺了他们的羊群 、 牛群，和驴，并城里田间所有的；
34.en: They seized their flocks and herds and donkeys and everything else of theirs in the city and out in the fields.

34.zh: 又把他们一切货财 、 孩子 、 妇女，并各房中所有的，都掳掠去了。
34.en: They carried off all their wealth and all their women and children, taking as plunder everything in the houses.

34.zh: 雅各对西缅和利未说：你们连累我，使我在这地的居民中，就是在迦南人和比利洗人中，有了臭名。我的人丁既然稀少，他们必聚集来击杀我，我和全家的人都必灭绝。
