34.en: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have brought trouble on me by making me a stench to the Canaanites and Perizzites, the people living in this land. We are few in number, and if they join forces against me and attack me, I and my household will be destroyed."

34.zh: 他们说：他岂可待我们的妹子如同妓女么？
34.en: But they replied, "Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?"

35.zh: 神对雅各说：起来！上伯特利去，住在那里；要在那里筑一座坛给神，就是你逃避你哥哥以扫的时候向你显现的那位。
35.en: Then God said to Jacob, "Go up to Bethel and settle there, and build an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you were fleeing from your brother Esau."

35.zh: 雅各就对他家中的人并一切与他同在的人说：你们要除掉你们中间的外邦神，也要自洁，更换衣裳。
35.en: So Jacob said to his household and to all who were with him, "Get rid of the foreign gods you have with you, and purify yourselves and change your clothes.

35.zh: 我们要起来，上伯特利去，在那里我要筑一座坛给神，就是在我遭难的日子应允我的祷告 、 在我行的路上保佑我的那位。
35.en: Then come, let us go up to Bethel, where I will build an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress and who has been with me wherever I have gone."

35.zh: 他们就把外邦人的神像和他们耳朵上的环子交给雅各；雅各都藏在示剑那里的橡树底下。
35.en: So they gave Jacob all the foreign gods they had and the rings in their ears, and Jacob buried them under the oak at Shechem.

35.zh: 他们便起行前往。神使那周围城邑的人都甚惊惧，就不追赶雅各的众子了。
35.en: Then they set out, and the terror of God fell upon the towns all around them so that no one pursued them.

35.zh: 于是雅各和一切与他同在的人到了迦南地的路斯，就是伯特利。
35.en: Jacob and all the people with him came to Luz (that is, Bethel) in the land of Canaan.

35.zh: 他在那里筑了一座坛，就给那地方起名叫伊勒伯特利 ( 就是伯特利之神的意思 ) ；因为他逃避他哥哥的时候，神在那里向他显现。
35.en: There he built an altar, and he called the place El Bethel, because it was there that God revealed himself to him when he was fleeing from his brother.

35.zh: 利百加的奶母底波拉死了，就葬在伯特利下边橡树底下；那棵树名叫亚伦巴古。
35.en: Now Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died and was buried under the oak below Bethel. So it was named Allon Bacuth.

35.zh: 雅各从巴旦亚兰回来，神又向他显现，赐福与他，
35.en: After Jacob returned from Paddan Aram, God appeared to him again and blessed him.

35.zh: 且对他说：你的名原是雅各，从今以后不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列。这样，他就改名叫以色列。
35.en: God said to him, "Your name is Jacob, but you will no longer be called Jacob; your name will be Israel. " So he named him Israel.

35.zh: 神又对他说：我是全能的神；你要生养众多，将来有一族和多国的民从你而生，又有君王从你而出。
35.en: And God said to him, "I am God Almighty ; be fruitful and increase in number. A nation and a community of nations will come from you, and kings will come from your body.

35.zh: 我所赐给亚伯拉罕和以撒的地，我要赐给你与你的后裔。
35.en: The land I gave to Abraham and Isaac I also give to you, and I will give this land to your descendants after you."

35.zh: 神就从那与雅各说话的地方升上去了。
35.en: Then God went up from him at the place where he had talked with him.

35.zh: 雅各便在那里立了一根石柱，在柱子上奠酒，浇油。
35.en: Jacob set up a stone pillar at the place where God had talked with him, and he poured out a drink offering on it; he also poured oil on it.

35.zh: 雅各就给那地方起名叫伯特利。
35.en: Jacob called the place where God had talked with him Bethel.

35.zh: 他们从伯特利起行，离以法他还有一段路程，拉结临产甚是艰难。
35.en: Then they moved on from Bethel. While they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel began to give birth and had great difficulty.

35.zh: 正在艰难的时候，收生婆对他说：不要怕，你又要得一个儿子了。
35.en: And as she was having great difficulty in childbirth, the midwife said to her, "Don't be afraid, for you have another son."

35.zh: 他将近于死，灵魂要走的时候，就给他儿子起名叫便俄尼；他父亲却给他起名叫便雅悯。
35.en: As she breathed her last-for she was dying-she named her son Ben-Oni. But his father named him Benjamin.

35.zh: 拉结死了，葬在以法他的路旁；以法他就是伯利恒。
35.en: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).

35.zh: 雅各在他的坟上立了一统碑，就是拉结的墓碑，到今日还在。
35.en: Over her tomb Jacob set up a pillar, and to this day that pillar marks Rachel's tomb.

35.zh: 以色列起行前往，在以得台那边支搭帐棚。
35.en: Israel moved on again and pitched his tent beyond Migdal Eder.

35.zh: 以色列住在那地的时候，流便去与他父亲的妾辟拉同寝，以色列也听见了。雅各共有十二个儿子。
35.en: While Israel was living in that region, Reuben went in and slept with his father's concubine Bilhah, and Israel heard of it. Jacob had twelve sons:

35.zh: 利亚所生的是雅各的长子流便，还有西缅 、 利未 、 犹大 、 以萨迦 、 西布伦。
35.en: The sons of Leah: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar and Zebulun.

35.zh: 拉结所生的是约瑟 、 便雅悯。
35.en: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

35.zh: 拉结的使女辟拉所生的是但 、 拿弗他利。
35.en: The sons of Rachel's maidservant Bilhah: Dan and Naphtali.

35.zh: 利亚的使女悉帕所生的是迦得 、 亚设。这是雅各在巴旦亚兰所生的儿子。
35.en: The sons of Leah's maidservant Zilpah: Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

35.zh: 雅各来到他父亲以撒那里，到了基列亚巴的幔利，乃是亚伯拉罕和以撒寄居的地方；基列亚巴就是希伯仑。
35.en: Jacob came home to his father Isaac in Mamre, near Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had stayed.

35.zh: 以撒共活了一百八十岁。
35.en: Isaac lived a hundred and eighty years.

35.zh: 以撒年纪老迈，日子满足，气绝而死，归到他列祖 ( 原文作本民 ) 那里。他两个儿子以扫 、 雅各把他埋葬了。
35.en: Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people, old and full of years. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

36.zh: 以扫就是以东，他的后代记在下面。
36.en: This is the account of Esau (that is,Edom).

36.zh: 以扫娶迦南的女子为妻，就是赫人以伦的女儿亚大和希未人祭便的孙女 、 亚拿的女儿阿何利巴玛，
36.en: Esau took his wives from the women of Canaan: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite-

36.zh: 又娶了以实玛利的女儿 、 尼拜约的妹子巴实抹。
36.en: also Basemath daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.

36.zh: 亚大给以扫生了以利法；巴实抹生了流珥；
36.en: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath bore Reuel,

36.zh: 阿何利巴玛生了耶乌施 、 雅兰 、 可拉。这都是以扫的儿子，是在迦南地生的。
36.en: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in Canaan.

36.zh: 以扫带著他的妻子 、 儿女，与家中一切的人口，并他的牛羊 、 牲畜，和一切货财，就是他在迦南地所得的，往别处去，离了他兄弟雅各。
36.en: Esau took his wives and sons and daughters and all the members of his household, as well as his livestock and all his other animals and all the goods he had acquired in Canaan, and moved to a land some distance from his brother Jacob.

36.zh: 因为二人的财物群畜甚多，寄居的地方容不下他们，所以不能同居。
36.en: Their possessions were too great for them to remain together; the land where they were staying could not support them both because of their livestock.

36.zh: 于是以扫住在西珥山里；以扫就是以东。
36.en: So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the hill country of Seir.

36.zh: 以扫是西珥山里以东人的始祖，他的后代记在下面。
36.en: This is the account of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir.

36.zh: 以扫众子的名字如下。以扫的妻子亚大生以利法；以扫的妻子巴实抹生流珥。
36.en: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau's wife Adah, and Reuel, the son of Esau's wife Basemath.

36.zh: 以利法的儿子是提幔 、 阿抹 、 洗玻 、 迦坦 、 基纳斯。
36.en: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam and Kenaz.

36.zh: 亭纳是以扫儿子以利法的妾；他给以利法生了亚玛力。这是以扫的妻子亚大的子孙。
36.en: Esau's son Eliphaz also had a concubine named Timna, who bore him Amalek. These were grandsons of Esau's wife Adah.

36.zh: 流珥的儿子是拿哈 、 谢拉 、 沙玛 、 米撒。这是以扫妻子巴实抹的子孙。
36.en: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were grandsons of Esau's wife Basemath.

36.zh: 以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛是祭便的孙女，亚拿的女儿；他给以扫生了耶乌施 、 雅兰 、 可拉。
36.en: The sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon, whom she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jalam and Korah.

36.zh: 以扫子孙中作族长的记在下面。以扫的长子以利法的子孙中，有提幔族长 、 阿抹族长 、 洗玻族长，基纳斯族长 、
36.en: These were the chiefs among Esau's descendants: The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: Chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,

36.zh: 可拉族长 、 迦坦族长 、 亚玛力族长。这是在以东地从以利法所出的族长，都是亚大的子孙。
36.en: Korah, Gatam and Amalek. These were the chiefs descended from Eliphaz in Edom; they were grandsons of Adah.

36.zh: 以扫的儿子流珥的子孙中，有拿哈族长 、 谢拉族长 、 沙玛族长 、 米撒族长。这是在以东地从流珥所出的族长，都是以扫妻子巴实抹的子孙。
36.en: The sons of Esau's son Reuel: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were the chiefs descended from Reuel in Edom; they were grandsons of Esau's wife Basemath.

36.zh: 以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛的子孙中，有耶乌施族长 、 雅兰族长 、 可拉族长。这是从以扫妻子，亚拿的女儿，阿何利巴玛子孙中所出的族长。
36.en: The sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah: Chiefs Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the chiefs descended from Esau's wife Oholibamah daughter of Anah.

36.zh: 以上的族长都是以扫的子孙；以扫就是以东。
36.en: These were the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these were their chiefs.

36.zh: 那地原有的居民 ─ 何利人西珥的子孙记在下面：就是罗坍 、 朔巴 、 祭便 、 亚拿 、
36.en: These were the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the region: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

36.zh: 底顺 、 以察 、 底珊。这是从以东地的何利人西珥子孙中所出的族长。
36.en: Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These sons of Seir in Edom were Horite chiefs.

36.zh: 罗坍的儿子是何利 、 希幔；罗坍的妹子是亭纳。
36.en: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan's sister.

36.zh: 朔巴的儿子是亚勒文 、 玛拿辖 、 以巴录 、 示玻 、 阿南。
36.en: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam.

36.zh: 祭便的儿子是亚雅 、 亚拿 〈 当时在旷野放他父亲祭便的驴，遇著温泉的，就是这亚拿 〉 。
36.en: The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is the Anah who discovered the hot springs in the desert while he was grazing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.

36.zh: 亚拿的儿子是底顺；亚拿的女儿是阿何利巴玛。
36.en: The children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.

36.zh: 底顺的儿子是欣但 、 伊是班 、 益兰 、 基兰。
36.en: The sons of Dishon : Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.

36.zh: 以察的儿子是辟罕 、 撒番 、 亚干。
36.en: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan.

36.zh: 底珊的儿子是乌斯 、 亚兰。
36.en: The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

36.zh: 从何利人所出的族长记在下面：就是罗坍族长 、 朔巴族长 、 祭便族长 、 亚拿族长 、
36.en: These were the Horite chiefs: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

36.zh: 底顺族长 、 以察族长 、 底珊族长。这是从何利人所出的族长，都在西珥地，按著宗族作族长。
36.en: Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These were the Horite chiefs, according to their divisions, in the land of Seir.

36.zh: 以色列人未有君王治理以先，在以东地作王的记在下面。
36.en: These were the kings who reigned in Edom before any Israelite king reigned :

36.zh: 比珥的儿子比拉在以东作王，他的京城名叫亭哈巴。
36.en: Bela son of Beor became king of Edom. His city was named Dinhabah.

36.zh: 比拉死了，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接续他作王。
36.en: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah succeeded him as king.

36.zh: 约巴死了，提幔地的人户珊接续他作王。
36.en: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.

36.zh: 户珊死了，比达的儿子哈达接续他作王；这哈达就是在摩押地杀败米甸人的，他的京城名叫亚未得。
36.en: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him as king. His city was named Avith.

36.zh: 哈达死了，玛士利加人桑拉接续他作王。
36.en: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him as king.

36.zh: 桑拉死了，大河边的利河伯人扫罗接续他作王。
36.en: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him as king.

36.zh: 扫罗死了，亚革波的儿子巴勒哈南接续他作王。
36.en: When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Acbor succeeded him as king.

36.zh: 亚革波的儿子巴勒哈南死了，哈达接续他作王，他的京城名叫巴乌；他的妻子名叫米希他别，是米萨合的孙女，玛特列的女儿。
36.en: When Baal-Hanan son of Acbor died, Hadad succeeded him as king. His city was named Pau, and his wife's name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab.

36.zh: 从以扫所出的族长，按著他们的宗族 、 住处 、 名字记在下面：就是亭纳族长 、 亚勒瓦族长 、 耶帖族长 、
36.en: These were the chiefs descended from Esau, by name, according to their clans and regions: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,

36.zh: 阿何利巴玛族长 、 以拉族长 、 比嫩族长 、
36.en: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,

36.zh: 基纳斯族长 、 提幔族长 、 米比萨族长 、
36.en: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,

36.zh: 玛基叠族长 、 以兰族长。这是以东人在所得为业的地上，按著他们的住处。 〈 所有的族长都是以东人的始祖以扫的后代。 〉
36.en: Magdiel and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their settlements in the land they occupied. This was Esau the father of the Edomites.

37.zh: 雅各住在迦南地，就是他父亲寄居的地。
37.en: Jacob lived in the land where hisfather had stayed, the land of Canaan.

37.zh: 雅各的记略如下。约瑟十七岁与他哥哥们一同牧羊。他是个童子，与他父亲的妾辟拉 、 悉帕的儿子们常在一处。约瑟将他哥哥们的恶行报给他们的父亲。
37.en: This is the account of Jacob. Joseph, a young man of seventeen, was tending the flocks with his brothers, the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives, and he brought their father a bad report about them.

37.zh: 以色列原来爱约瑟过于爱他的众子，因为约瑟是他年老生的；他给约瑟做了一件彩衣。
37.en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than any of his other sons, because he had been born to him in his old age; and he made a richly ornamented robe for him.

37.zh: 约瑟的哥哥们见父亲爱约瑟过于爱他们，就恨约瑟，不与他说和睦的话。
37.en: When his brothers saw that their father loved him more than any of them, they hated him and could not speak a kind word to him.

37.zh: 约瑟做了一梦，告诉他哥哥们，他们就越发恨他。
37.en: Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him all the more.

37.zh: 约瑟对他们说：请听我所做的梦：
37.en: He said to them, "Listen to this dream I had:

37.zh: 我们在田里捆禾稼，我的捆起来站著，你们的捆来围著我的捆下拜。
37.en: We were binding sheaves of grain out in the field when suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around mine and bowed down to it."

37.zh: 他的哥哥们回答说：难道你真要作我们的王么？难道你真要管辖我们么？他们就因为他的梦和他的话越发恨他。
37.en: His brothers said to him, "Do you intend to reign over us? Will you actually rule us?" And they hated him all the more because of his dream and what he had said.

37.zh: 后来他又做了一梦，也告诉他的哥哥们说：看哪，我又做了一梦，梦见太阳 、 月亮，与十一个星向我下拜。
37.en: Then he had another dream, and he told it to his brothers. "Listen," he said, "I had another dream, and this time the sun and moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me."

37.zh: 约瑟将这梦告诉他父亲和他哥哥们，他父亲就责备他说：你做的这是甚么梦！难道我和你母亲 、 你弟兄果然要来俯伏在地，向你下拜么？
37.en: When he told his father as well as his brothers, his father rebuked him and said, "What is this dream you had? Will your mother and I and your brothers actually come and bow down to the ground before you?"

37.zh: 他哥哥们都嫉妒他，他父亲却把这话存在心里。
37.en: His brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept the matter in mind.

37.zh: 约瑟的哥哥们往示剑去放他们父亲的羊。
37.en: Now his brothers had gone to graze their father's flocks near Shechem,

37.zh: 以色列对约瑟说：你哥哥们不是在示剑放羊么？你来，我要打发你往他们那里去。约瑟说：我在这里。
37.en: and Israel said to Joseph, "As you know, your brothers are grazing the flocks near Shechem. Come, I am going to send you to them." "Very well," he replied.

37.zh: 以色列说：你去看看你哥哥们平安不平安，群羊平安不平安，就回来报信给我；于是打发他出希伯仑谷，他就往示剑去了。
37.en: So he said to him, "Go and see if all is well with your brothers and with the flocks, and bring word back to me." Then he sent him off from the Valley of Hebron. When Joseph arrived at Shechem,

37.zh: 有人遇见他在田野走迷了路，就问他说：你找甚么？
37.en: a man found him wandering around in the fields and asked him, "What are you looking for?"

37.zh: 他说：我找我的哥哥们，求你告诉我，他们在何处放羊。
37.en: He replied, "I'm looking for my brothers. Can you tell me where they are grazing their flocks?"

37.zh: 那人说：他们已经走了，我听见他们说要往多坍去。约瑟就去追赶他哥哥们，遇见他们在多坍。
37.en: "They have moved on from here," the man answered. "I heard them say, 'Let's go to Dothan.' " So Joseph went after his brothers and found them near Dothan.

37.zh: 他们远远地看见他，趁他还没有走到跟前，大家就同谋要害死他，
37.en: But they saw him in the distance, and before he reached them, they plotted to kill him.

37.zh: 彼此说：你看！那做梦的来了。
37.en: "Here comes that dreamer!" they said to each other.

37.zh: 来罢！我们将他杀了，丢在一个坑里，就说有恶兽把他吃了。我们且看他的梦将来怎么样。
37.en: "Come now, let's kill him and throw him into one of these cisterns and say that a ferocious animal devoured him. Then we'll see what comes of his dreams."

37.zh: 流便听见了，要救他脱离他们的手，说：我们不可害他的性命；
37.en: When Reuben heard this, he tried to rescue him from their hands. "Let's not take his life," he said.

37.zh: 又说：不可流他的血，可以把他丢在这野地的坑里，不可下手害他。流便的意思是要救他脱离他们的手，把他归还他的父亲。
37.en: "Don't shed any blood. Throw him into this cistern here in the desert, but don't lay a hand on him." Reuben said this to rescue him from them and take him back to his father.

37.zh: 约瑟到了他哥哥们那里，他们就剥了他的外衣，就是他穿的那件彩衣，
37.en: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his robe-the richly ornamented robe he was wearing-

37.zh: 把他丢在坑里；那坑是空的，里头没有水。
37.en: and they took him and threw him into the cistern. Now the cistern was empty; there was no water in it.

37.zh: 他们坐下吃饭，举目观看，见有一伙米甸的以实玛利人从基列来，用骆驼驮著香料 、 乳香 、 没药，要带下埃及去。
37.en: As they sat down to eat their meal, they looked up and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead. Their camels were loaded with spices, balm and myrrh, and they were on their way to take them down to Egypt.

37.zh: 犹大对众弟兄说：我们杀我们的兄弟，藏了他的血有甚么益处呢？
37.en: Judah said to his brothers, "What will we gain if we kill our brother and cover up his blood?

37.zh: 我们不如将他卖给以实玛利人，不可下手害他；因为他是我们的兄弟，我们的骨肉。众弟兄就听从了他。
37.en: Come, let's sell him to the Ishmaelites and not lay our hands on him; after all, he is our brother, our own flesh and blood." His brothers agreed.

37.zh: 有些米甸的商人从那里经过，哥哥们就把约瑟从坑里拉上来，讲定二十舍客勒银子，把约瑟卖给以实玛利人。他们就把约瑟带到埃及去了。
37.en: So when the Midianite merchants came by, his brothers pulled Joseph up out of the cistern and sold him for twenty shekels of silver to the Ishmaelites, who took him to Egypt.

37.zh: 流便回到坑边，见约瑟不在坑里，就撕裂衣服，
37.en: When Reuben returned to the cistern and saw that Joseph was not there, he tore his clothes.

37.zh: 回到兄弟们那里，说：童子没有了。我往那里去才好呢？
37.en: He went back to his brothers and said, "The boy isn't there! Where can I turn now?"

37.zh: 他们宰了一只公山羊，把约瑟的那件彩衣染了血，
37.en: Then they got Joseph's robe, slaughtered a goat and dipped the robe in the blood.

37.zh: 打发人送到他们的父亲那里，说：我们捡了这个；请认一认是你儿子的外衣不是？
37.en: They took the ornamented robe back to their father and said, "We found this. Examine it to see whether it is your son's robe."

37.zh: 他认得，就说：这是我儿子的外衣。有恶兽把他吃了，约瑟被撕碎了！撕碎了！
37.en: He recognized it and said, "It is my son's robe! Some ferocious animal has devoured him. Joseph has surely been torn to pieces."

37.zh: 雅各便撕裂衣服，腰间围上麻布，为他儿子悲哀了多日。
37.en: Then Jacob tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and mourned for his son many days.

37.zh: 他的儿女都起来安慰他，他却不肯受安慰，说：我必悲哀著下阴间，到我儿子那里。约瑟的父亲就为他哀哭。
37.en: All his sons and daughters came to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. "No," he said, "in mourning will I go down to the grave to my son." So his father wept for him.

37.zh: 米甸人带约瑟到埃及，把他卖给法老的内臣 ─ 护卫长波提乏。
37.en: Meanwhile, the Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar, one of Pharaoh's officials, the captain of the guard.

38.zh: 那时，犹大离开他弟兄下去，到一个亚杜兰人名叫希拉的家里去。
38.en: At that time, Judah left his brothers and went down to stay with a man of Adullam named Hirah.

38.zh: 犹大在那里看见一个迦南人名叫书亚的女儿，就娶他为妻，与他同房，
38.en: There Judah met the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua. He married her and lay with her;

38.zh: 他就怀孕生了儿子，犹大给他起名叫珥。
38.en: she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, who was named Er.

38.zh: 他又怀孕生了儿子，母亲给他起名叫俄南。
38.en: She conceived again and gave birth to a son and named him Onan.

38.zh: 他复又生了儿子，给他起名叫示拉。他生示拉的时候，犹大正在基悉。
38.en: She gave birth to still another son and named him Shelah. It was at Kezib that she gave birth to him.

38.zh: 犹大为长子珥娶妻，名叫他玛。
38.en: Judah got a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

38.zh: 犹大的长子珥在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华就叫他死了。
38.en: But Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the Lord 's sight; so the Lord put him to death.

38.zh: 犹大对俄南说：你当与你哥哥的妻子同房，向他尽你为弟的本分，为你哥哥生子立后。
38.en: Then Judah said to Onan, "Lie with your brother's wife and fulfill your duty to her as a brother-in-law to produce offspring for your brother."

38.zh: 俄南知道生子不归自己，所以同房的时候便遗在地，免得给他哥哥留后。
38.en: But Onan knew that the offspring would not be his; so whenever he lay with his brother's wife, he spilled his semen on the ground to keep from producing offspring for his brother.

38.zh: 俄南所做的在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华也就叫他死了。
38.en: What he did was wicked in the Lord 's sight; so he put him to death also.

38.zh: 犹大心里说：恐怕示拉也死，像他两个哥哥一样，就对他儿妇他玛说：你去，在你父亲家里守寡，等我儿子示拉长大。他玛就回去，住在他父亲家里。
38.en: Judah then said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, "Live as a widow in your father's house until my son Shelah grows up." For he thought, "He may die too, just like his brothers." So Tamar went to live in her father's house.

38.zh: 过了许久，犹大的妻子书亚的女儿死了。犹大得了安慰，就和他朋友亚杜兰人希拉上亭拿去，到他剪羊毛的人那里。
38.en: After a long time Judah's wife, the daughter of Shua, died. When Judah had recovered from his grief, he went up to Timnah, to the men who were shearing his sheep, and his friend Hirah the Adullamite went with him.

38.zh: 有人告诉他玛说：你的公公上亭拿剪羊毛去了。
38.en: When Tamar was told, "Your father-in-law is on his way to Timnah to shear his sheep,"

38.zh: 他玛见示拉已经长大，还没有娶他为妻，就脱了他作寡妇的衣裳，用帕子蒙著脸，又遮住身体，坐在亭拿路上的伊拿印城门口。
38.en: she took off her widow's clothes, covered herself with a veil to disguise herself, and then sat down at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the road to Timnah. For she saw that, though Shelah had now grown up, she had not been given to him as his wife.

38.zh: 犹大看见他，以为是妓女，因为他蒙著脸。
38.en: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

38.zh: 犹大就转到他那里去，说：来罢！让我与你同寝。他原不知道是他的儿妇。他玛说：你要与我同寝，把甚么给我呢？
38.en: Not realizing that she was his daughter-in-law, he went over to her by the roadside and said, "Come now, let me sleep with you." "And what will you give me to sleep with you?" she asked.

38.zh: 犹大说：我从羊群里取一只山羊羔，打发人送来给你。他玛说：在未送以先，你愿意给我一个当头么？
38.en: "I'll send you a young goat from my flock," he said. "Will you give me something as a pledge until you send it?" she asked.

38.zh: 他说：我给你甚么当头呢？他玛说：你的印 、 你的带子，和你手里的杖。犹大就给了他，与他同寝，他就从犹大怀了孕。
38.en: He said, "What pledge should I give you?" "Your seal and its cord, and the staff in your hand," she answered. So he gave them to her and slept with her, and she became pregnant by him.

38.zh: 他玛起来走了，除去帕子，仍旧穿上作寡妇的衣裳。
38.en: After she left, she took off her veil and put on her widow's clothes again.

38.zh: 犹大托他朋友亚杜兰人送一只山羊羔去，要从那女人手里取回当头来，却找不著他，
38.en: Meanwhile Judah sent the young goat by his friend the Adullamite in order to get his pledge back from the woman, but he did not find her.

38.zh: 就问那地方的人说：伊拿印路旁的妓女在那里？他们说：这里并没有妓女。
38.en: He asked the men who lived there, "Where is the shrine prostitute who was beside the road at Enaim?" "There hasn't been any shrine prostitute here," they said.

38.zh: 他回去见犹大说：我没有找著他，并且那地方的人说：这里没有妓女。
38.en: So he went back to Judah and said, "I didn't find her. Besides, the men who lived there said, 'There hasn't been any shrine prostitute here.' "

38.zh: 犹大说：我把这山羊羔送去了，你竟找不著他。任凭他拿去罢，免得我们被羞辱。
38.en: Then Judah said, "Let her keep what she has, or we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you didn't find her."

38.zh: 约过了三个月，有人告诉犹大说：你的儿妇他玛作了妓女，且因行淫有了身孕。犹大说：拉出他来，把他烧了！
38.en: About three months later Judah was told, "Your daughter-in-law Tamar is guilty of prostitution, and as a result she is now pregnant." Judah said, "Bring her out and have her burned to death!"

38.zh: 他玛被拉出来的时候便打发人去见他公公，对他说：这些东西是谁的，我就是从谁怀的孕。请你认一认，这印和带子并杖都是谁的？
38.en: As she was being brought out, she sent a message to her father-in-law. "I am pregnant by the man who owns these," she said. And she added, "See if you recognize whose seal and cord and staff these are."

38.zh: 犹大承认说：他比我更有义，因为我没有将他给我的儿子示拉。从此犹大不再与他同寝了。
38.en: Judah recognized them and said, "She is more righteous than I, since I wouldn't give her to my son Shelah." And he did not sleep with her again.

38.zh: 他玛将要生产，不料他腹里是一对双生。
38.en: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.

38.zh: 到生产的时候，一个孩子伸出一只手来；收生婆拿红线拴在他手上，说：这是头生的。
38.en: As she was giving birth, one of them put out his hand; so the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it on his wrist and said, "This one came out first."

38.zh: 随后这孩子把手收回去，他哥哥生出来了；收生婆说：你为甚么抢著来呢？因此给他起名叫法勒斯。
38.en: But when he drew back his hand, his brother came out, and she said, "So this is how you have broken out!" And he was named Perez.

38.zh: 后来，他兄弟那手上有红线的也生出来，就给他起名叫谢拉。
38.en: Then his brother, who had the scarlet thread on his wrist, came out and he was given the name Zerah.

39.zh: 约瑟被带下埃及去。有一个埃及人，是法老的内臣 ─ 护卫长波提乏，从那些带下他来的以实玛利人手下买了他去。
39.en: Now Joseph had been taken down to Egypt. Potiphar, an Egyptian who was one of Pharaoh's officials, the captain of the guard, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him there.

39.zh: 约瑟住在他主人埃及人的家中，耶和华与他同在，他就百事顺利。
39.en: The Lord was with Joseph and he prospered, and he lived in the house of his Egyptian master.

39.zh: 他主人见耶和华与他同在，又见耶和华使他手里所办的尽都顺利，
39.en: When his master saw that the Lord was with him and that the Lord gave him success in everything he did,

39.zh: 约瑟就在主人眼前蒙恩，伺候他主人，并且主人派他管理家务，把一切所有的都交在他手里。
39.en: Joseph found favor in his eyes and became his attendant. Potiphar put him in charge of his household, and he entrusted to his care everything he owned.

39.zh: 自从主人派约瑟管理家务和他一切所有的，耶和华就因约瑟的缘故赐福与那埃及人的家；凡家里和田间一切所有的都蒙耶和华赐福。
39.en: From the time he put him in charge of his household and of all that he owned, the Lord blessed the household of the Egyptian because of Joseph. The blessing of the Lord was on everything Potiphar had, both in the house and in the field.

39.zh: 波提乏将一切所有的都交在约瑟的手中，除了自己所吃的饭，别的事一概不知。约瑟原来秀雅俊美。
39.en: So he left in Joseph's care everything he had; with Joseph in charge, he did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate. Now Joseph was well-built and handsome,

39.zh: 这事以后，约瑟主人的妻以目送情给约瑟，说：你与我同寝罢！
39.en: and after a while his master's wife took notice of Joseph and said, "Come to bed with me!"

39.zh: 约瑟不从，对他主人的妻说：看哪，一切家务，我主人都不知道；他把所有的都交在我手里。
39.en: But he refused. "With me in charge," he told her, "my master does not concern himself with anything in the house; everything he owns he has entrusted to my care.

39.zh: 在这家里没有比我大的；并且他没有留下一样不交给我，只留下了你，因为你是他的妻子。我怎能作这大恶，得罪神呢？
39.en: No one is greater in this house than I am. My master has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. How then could I do such a wicked thing and sin against God?"

39.zh: 后来他天天和约瑟说，约瑟却不听从他，不与他同寝，也不和他在一处。
39.en: And though she spoke to Joseph day after day, he refused to go to bed with her or even be with her.

39.zh: 有一天，约瑟进屋里去办事，家中人没有一个在那屋里，
39.en: One day he went into the house to attend to his duties, and none of the household servants was inside.

39.zh: 妇人就拉住他的衣裳，说：你与我同寝罢！约瑟把衣裳丢在妇人手里，跑到外边去了。
39.en: She caught him by his cloak and said, "Come to bed with me!" But he left his cloak in her hand and ran out of the house.

39.zh: 妇人看见约瑟把衣裳丢在他手里跑出去了，
39.en: When she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out of the house,

39.zh: 就叫了家里的人来，对他们说：你们看！他带了一个希伯来人进入我们家里，要戏弄我们。他到我这里来，要与我同寝，我就大声喊叫。
39.en: she called her household servants. "Look," she said to them, "this Hebrew has been brought to us to make sport of us! He came in here to sleep with me, but I screamed.

39.zh: 他听见我放声喊起来，就把衣裳丢在我这里，跑到外边去了。
39.en: When he heard me scream for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house."

39.zh: 妇人把约瑟的衣裳放在自己那里，等著他主人回家，
39.en: She kept his cloak beside her until his master came home.

39.zh: 就对他如此如此说：你所带到我们这里的那希伯来仆人进来要戏弄我，
39.en: Then she told him this story: "That Hebrew slave you brought us came to me to make sport of me.

39.zh: 我放声喊起来，他就把衣裳丢在我这里，跑出去了。
39.en: But as soon as I screamed for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house."

39.zh: 约瑟的主人听见他妻子对他所说的话，说：你的仆人如此如此待我，他就生气，
39.en: When his master heard the story his wife told him, saying, "This is how your slave treated me," he burned with anger.

39.zh: 把约瑟下在监里，就是王的囚犯被囚的地方。于是约瑟在那里坐监。
39.en: Joseph's master took him and put him in prison, the place where the king's prisoners were confined. But while Joseph was there in the prison,

39.zh: 但耶和华与约瑟同在，向他施恩，使他在司狱的眼前蒙恩。
39.en: the Lord was with him; he showed him kindness and granted him favor in the eyes of the prison warden.

39.zh: 司狱就把监里所有的囚犯都交在约瑟手下；他们在那里所办的事都是经他的手。
39.en: So the warden put Joseph in charge of all those held in the prison, and he was made responsible for all that was done there.

39.zh: 凡在约瑟手下的事，司狱一概不察，因为耶和华与约瑟同在；耶和华使他所做的尽都顺利。
39.en: The warden paid no attention to anything under Joseph's care, because the Lord was with Joseph and gave him success in whatever he did.

40.zh: 这事以后，埃及王的酒政和膳长得罪了他们的主 ─ 埃及王，
40.en: Some time later, the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt offended their master, the king of Egypt.

40.zh: 法老就恼怒酒政和膳长这二臣，
40.en: Pharaoh was angry with his two officials, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker,

40.zh: 把他们下在护卫长府内的监里，就是约瑟被囚的地方。
40.en: and put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, in the same prison where Joseph was confined.

40.zh: 护卫长把他们交给约瑟，约瑟便伺候他们；他们有些日子在监里。
40.en: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he attended them. After they had been in custody for some time,

40.zh: 被囚在监之埃及王的酒政和膳长二人同夜各做一梦，各梦都有讲解。
40.en: each of the two men-the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were being held in prison-had a dream the same night, and each dream had a meaning of its own.

40.zh: 到了早晨，约瑟进到他们那里，见他们有愁闷的样子。
40.en: When Joseph came to them the next morning, he saw that they were dejected.

40.zh: 他便问法老的二臣，就是与他同囚在他主人府里的，说：他们今日为甚么面带愁容呢？
40.en: So he asked Pharaoh's officials who were in custody with him in his master's house, "Why are your faces so sad today?"

40.zh: 他们对他说：我们各人做了一梦，没有人能解。约瑟说：解梦不是出于神么？请你们将梦告诉我。
40.en: "We both had dreams," they answered, "but there is no one to interpret them." Then Joseph said to them, "Do not interpretations belong to God? Tell me your dreams."

40.zh: 酒政便将他的梦告诉约瑟说：我梦见在我面前有一棵葡萄树，
40.en: So the chief cupbearer told Joseph his dream. He said to him, "In my dream I saw a vine in front of me,

40.zh: 树上有三根枝子，好像发了芽，开了花，上头的葡萄都成熟了。
40.en: and on the vine were three branches. As soon as it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters ripened into grapes.

40.zh: 法老的杯在我手中，我就拿葡萄挤在法老的杯里，将杯递在他手中。
40.en: Pharaoh's cup was in my hand, and I took the grapes, squeezed them into Pharaoh's cup and put the cup in his hand."

40.zh: 约瑟对他说：他所做的梦是这样解：三根枝子就是三天；
40.en: "This is what it means," Joseph said to him. "The three branches are three days.

40.zh: 三天之内，法老必提你出监，叫你官复原职，你仍要递杯在法老的手中，和先前作他的酒政一样。
40.en: Within three days Pharaoh will lift up your head and restore you to your position, and you will put Pharaoh's cup in his hand, just as you used to do when you were his cupbearer.

40.zh: 但你得好处的时候，求你记念我，施恩与我，在法老面前题说我，救我出这监牢。
40.en: But when all goes well with you, remember me and show me kindness; mention me to Pharaoh and get me out of this prison.

40.zh: 我实在是从希伯来人之地被拐来的；我在这里也没有做过甚么，叫他们把我下在监里。
40.en: For I was forcibly carried off from the land of the Hebrews, and even here I have done nothing to deserve being put in a dungeon."

40.zh: 膳长见梦解得好，就对约瑟说：我在梦中见我头上顶著三筐白饼；
40.en: When the chief baker saw that Joseph had given a favorable interpretation, he said to Joseph, "I too had a dream: On my head were three baskets of bread.

40.zh: 极上的筐子里有为法老烤的各样食物，有飞鸟来吃我头上筐子里的食物。
40.en: In the top basket were all kinds of baked goods for Pharaoh, but the birds were eating them out of the basket on my head."

40.zh: 约瑟说：你的梦是这样解：三个筐子就是三天；
40.en: "This is what it means," Joseph said. "The three baskets are three days.

40.zh: 三天之内，法老必斩断你的头，把你挂在木头上，必有飞鸟来吃你身上的肉。
40.en: Within three days Pharaoh will lift off your head and hang you on a tree. And the birds will eat away your flesh."

40.zh: 到了第三天，是法老的生日，他为众臣仆设摆筵席，把酒政和膳长提出监来，
40.en: Now the third day was Pharaoh's birthday, and he gave a feast for all his officials. He lifted up the heads of the chief cupbearer and the chief baker in the presence of his officials:

40.zh: 使酒政官复原职，他仍旧递杯在法老手中；
40.en: He restored the chief cupbearer to his position, so that he once again put the cup into Pharaoh's hand,

40.zh: 但把膳长挂起来，正如约瑟向他们所解的话。
40.en: but he hanged the chief baker, just as Joseph had said to them in his interpretation.

40.zh: 酒政却不记念约瑟，竟忘了他。
40.en: The chief cupbearer, however, did not remember Joseph; he forgot him.

41.zh: 过了两年，法老做梦，梦见自己站在河边，
41.en: When two full years had passed, Pharaoh had a dream: He was standing by the Nile,

41.zh: 有七只母牛从河里上来，又美好又肥壮，在芦荻中吃草。
41.en: when out of the river there came up seven cows, sleek and fat, and they grazed among the reeds.

41.zh: 随后又有七只母牛从河里上来，又丑陋又干瘦，与那七只母牛一同站在河边。
41.en: After them, seven other cows, ugly and gaunt, came up out of the Nile and stood beside those on the riverbank.

41.zh: 这又丑陋又干瘦的七只母牛吃尽了那又美好又肥壮的七只母牛。法老就醒了。
41.en: And the cows that were ugly and gaunt ate up the seven sleek, fat cows. Then Pharaoh woke up.

41.zh: 他又睡著，第二回做梦，梦见一棵麦子长了七个穗子，又肥大又佳美，
41.en: He fell asleep again and had a second dream: Seven heads of grain, healthy and good, were growing on a single stalk.

41.zh: 随后又长了七个穗子，又细弱又被东风吹焦了。
41.en: After them, seven other heads of grain sprouted-thin and scorched by the east wind.

41.zh: 这细弱的穗子吞了那七个又肥大又饱满的穗子。法老醒了，不料是个梦。
41.en: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy, full heads. Then Pharaoh woke up; it had been a dream.

41.zh: 到了早晨，法老心里不安，就差人召了埃及所有的术士和博士来；法老就把所做的梦告诉他们，却没有人能给法老圆解。
41.en: In the morning his mind was troubled, so he sent for all the magicians and wise men of Egypt. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but no one could interpret them for him.

41.zh: 那时酒政对法老说：我今日想起我的罪来。
41.en: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, "Today I am reminded of my shortcomings.

41.zh: 从前法老恼怒臣仆，把我和膳长下在护卫长府内的监里。
41.en: Pharaoh was once angry with his servants, and he imprisoned me and the chief baker in the house of the captain of the guard.

41.zh: 我们二人同夜各做一梦，各梦都有讲解。
41.en: Each of us had a dream the same night, and each dream had a meaning of its own.

41.zh: 在那里同著我们有一个希伯来的少年人，是护卫长的仆人，我们告诉他，他就把我们的梦圆解，是按著各人的梦圆解的。
41.en: Now a young Hebrew was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. We told him our dreams, and he interpreted them for us, giving each man the interpretation of his dream.

41.zh: 后来正如他给我们圆解的成就了；我官复原职，膳长被挂起来了。
41.en: And things turned out exactly as he interpreted them to us: I was restored to my position, and the other man was hanged. "

41.zh: 法老遂即差人去召约瑟，他们便急忙带他出监，他就剃头，刮脸，换衣裳，进到法老面前。
41.en: So Pharaoh sent for Joseph, and he was quickly brought from the dungeon. When he had shaved and changed his clothes, he came before Pharaoh.

41.zh: 法老对约瑟说：我做了一梦，没有人能解；我听见人说，你听了梦就能解。
41.en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I had a dream, and no one can interpret it. But I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it."

41.zh: 约瑟回答法老说：这不在乎我，神必将平安的话回答法老。
41.en: "I cannot do it," Joseph replied to Pharaoh, "but God will give Pharaoh the answer he desires."

41.zh: 法老对约瑟说：我梦见我站在河边，
41.en: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "In my dream I was standing on the bank of the Nile,

41.zh: 有七只母牛从河里上来，又肥壮又美好，在芦荻中吃草。
41.en: when out of the river there came up seven cows, fat and sleek, and they grazed among the reeds.

41.zh: 随后又有七只母牛上来，又软弱又丑陋又干瘦，在埃及遍地，我没有见过这样不好的。
41.en: After them, seven other cows came up-scrawny and very ugly and lean. I had never seen such ugly cows in all the land of Egypt.

41.zh: 这又干瘦又丑陋的母牛吃尽了那以先的七只肥母牛，
41.en: The lean, ugly cows ate up the seven fat cows that came up first.

41.zh: 吃了以后却看不出是吃了，那丑陋的样子仍旧和先前一样。我就醒了。
41.en: But even after they ate them, no one could tell that they had done so; they looked just as ugly as before. Then I woke up.

41.zh: 我又梦见一棵麦子，长了七个穗子，又饱满又佳美，
41.en: "In my dreams I also saw seven heads of grain, full and good, growing on a single stalk.

41.zh: 随后又长了七个穗子，枯槁细弱，被东风吹焦了。
41.en: After them, seven other heads sprouted-withered and thin and scorched by the east wind.

41.zh: 这些细弱的穗子吞了那七个佳美的穗子。我将这梦告诉了术士，却没有人能给我解说。
41.en: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads. I told this to the magicians, but none could explain it to me."

41.zh: 约瑟对法老说：法老的梦乃是一个。神已将所要做的事指示法老了。
41.en: Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, "The dreams of Pharaoh are one and the same. God has revealed to Pharaoh what he is about to do.

41.zh: 七只好母牛是七年，七个好穗子也是七年；这梦乃是一个。
41.en: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good heads of grain are seven years; it is one and the same dream.

41.zh: 那随后上来的七只又干瘦又丑陋的母牛是七年，那七个虚空 、 被东风吹焦的穗子也是七年，都是七个荒年。
41.en: The seven lean, ugly cows that came up afterward are seven years, and so are the seven worthless heads of grain scorched by the east wind: They are seven years of famine.

41.zh: 这就是我对法老所说，神已将所要做的事显明给法老了。
41.en: "It is just as I said to Pharaoh: God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.

41.zh: 埃及遍地必来七个大丰年，
41.en: Seven years of great abundance are coming throughout the land of Egypt,

41.zh: 随后又要来七个荒年，甚至埃及地都忘了先前的丰收，全地必被饥荒所灭。
41.en: but seven years of famine will follow them. Then all the abundance in Egypt will be forgotten, and the famine will ravage the land.

41.zh: 因那以后的饥荒甚大，便不觉得先前的丰收了。
41.en: The abundance in the land will not be remembered, because the famine that follows it will be so severe.

41.zh: 至于法老两回做梦，是因神命定这事，而且必速速成就。
41.en: The reason the dream was given to Pharaoh in two forms is that the matter has been firmly decided by God, and God will do it soon.

41.zh: 所以，法老当拣选一个有聪明有智慧的人，派他治理埃及地。
41.en: "And now let Pharaoh look for a discerning and wise man and put him in charge of the land of Egypt.

41.zh: 法老当这样行，又派官员管理这地。当七个丰年的时候，征收埃及地的五分之一，
41.en: Let Pharaoh appoint commissioners over the land to take a fifth of the harvest of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.

41.zh: 叫他们把将来丰年一切的粮食聚敛起来，积蓄五谷，收存在各城里做食物，归于法老的手下。
41.en: They should collect all the food of these good years that are coming and store up the grain under the authority of Pharaoh, to be kept in the cities for food.

41.zh: 所积蓄的粮食可以防备埃及地将来的七个荒年，免得这地被饥荒所灭。
41.en: This food should be held in reserve for the country, to be used during the seven years of famine that will come upon Egypt, so that the country may not be ruined by the famine."

41.zh: 法老和他一切臣仆都以这事为妙。
41.en: The plan seemed good to Pharaoh and to all his officials.

41.zh: 法老对臣仆说：像这样的人，有神的灵在他里头，我们岂能找得著呢？
41.en: So Pharaoh asked them, "Can we find anyone like this man, one in whom is the spirit of God ?"

41.zh: 法老对约瑟说：神既将这事都指示你，可见没有人像你这样有聪明有智慧。
41.en: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Since God has made all this known to you, there is no one so discerning and wise as you.

41.zh: 你可以掌管我的家；我的民都必听从你的话。惟独在宝座上我比你大。
41.en: You shall be in charge of my palace, and all my people are to submit to your orders. Only with respect to the throne will I be greater than you."

41.zh: 法老又对约瑟说：我派你治理埃及全地。
41.en: So Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I hereby put you in charge of the whole land of Egypt."

41.zh: 法老就摘下手上打印的戒指，戴在约瑟的手上，给他穿上细麻衣，把金炼戴在他的颈项上，
41.en: Then Pharaoh took his signet ring from his finger and put it on Joseph's finger. He dressed him in robes of fine linen and put a gold chain around his neck.

41.zh: 又叫约瑟坐他的副车，喝道的在前呼叫说：跪下。这样 、 法老派他治理埃及全地。
41.en: He had him ride in a chariot as his second-in-command, and men shouted before him, "Make way !" Thus he put him in charge of the whole land of Egypt.

41.zh: 法老对约瑟说：我是法老，在埃及全地，若没有你的命令，不许人擅自办事 ( 原文作动手动脚 ) 。
41.en: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I am Pharaoh, but without your word no one will lift hand or foot in all Egypt."

41.zh: 法老赐名给约瑟，叫撒发那忒巴内亚，又将安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给他为妻。约瑟就出去巡行埃及地。
41.en: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name Zaphenath-Paneah and gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, to be his wife. And Joseph went throughout the land of Egypt.

41.zh: 约瑟见埃及王法老的时候年三十岁。他从法老面前出去，遍行埃及全地。
41.en: Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from Pharaoh's presence and traveled throughout Egypt.

41.zh: 七个丰年之内，地的出产极丰极盛 ( 原文作一把一把的 ) ，
41.en: During the seven years of abundance the land produced plentifully.

41.zh: 约瑟聚敛埃及地七个丰年一切的粮食，把粮食积存在各城里；各城周围田地的粮食都积存在本城里。
41.en: Joseph collected all the food produced in those seven years of abundance in Egypt and stored it in the cities. In each city he put the food grown in the fields surrounding it.

41.zh: 约瑟积蓄五谷甚多，如同海边的沙，无法计算，因为谷不可胜数。
41.en: Joseph stored up huge quantities of grain, like the sand of the sea; it was so much that he stopped keeping records because it was beyond measure.

41.zh: 荒年未到以前，安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给约瑟生了两个儿子。
41.en: Before the years of famine came, two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.

41.zh: 约瑟给长子起名叫玛拿西 ( 就是使之忘了的意思 ) ，因为他说：神使我忘了一切的困苦和我父的全家。
41.en: Joseph named his firstborn Manasseh and said, "It is because God has made me forget all my trouble and all my father's household."

41.zh: 他给次子起名叫以法莲 ( 就是使之昌盛的意思 ) ，因为他说：神使我在受苦的地方昌盛。
41.en: The second son he named Ephraim and said, "It is because God has made me fruitful in the land of my suffering."

41.zh: 埃及地的七个丰年一完，
41.en: The seven years of abundance in Egypt came to an end,

41.zh: 七个荒年就来了。正如约瑟所说的，各地都有饥荒；惟独埃及全地有粮食。
41.en: and the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all the other lands, but in the whole land of Egypt there was food.

41.zh: 及至埃及全地有了饥荒，众民向法老哀求粮食，法老对他们说：你们往约瑟那里去，凡他所说的，你们都要做。
41.en: When all Egypt began to feel the famine, the people cried to Pharaoh for food. Then Pharaoh told all the Egyptians, "Go to Joseph and do what he tells you."

41.zh: 当时饥荒遍满天下，约瑟开了各处的仓，粜粮给埃及人；在埃及地饥荒甚大。
41.en: When the famine had spread over the whole country, Joseph opened the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians, for the famine was severe throughout Egypt.

41.zh: 各地的人都往埃及去，到约瑟那里籴粮，因为天下的饥荒甚大。
41.en: And all the countries came to Egypt to buy grain from Joseph, because the famine was severe in all the world.

42.zh: 雅各见埃及有粮，就对儿子们说：你们为甚么彼此观望呢？
42.en: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, "Why do you just keep looking at each other?"

42.zh: 我听见埃及有粮，你们可以下去，从那里为我们籴些来，使我们可以存活，不至于死。
42.en: He continued, "I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy some for us, so that we may live and not die."

42.zh: 于是，约瑟的十个哥哥都下埃及籴粮去了。
42.en: Then ten of Joseph's brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

42.zh: 但约瑟的兄弟便雅悯，雅各没有打发他和哥哥们同去，因为雅各说：恐怕他遭害。
42.en: But Jacob did not send Benjamin, Joseph's brother, with the others, because he was afraid that harm might come to him.

42.zh: 来籴粮的人中有以色列的儿子们，因为迦南地也有饥荒。
42.en: So Israel's sons were among those who went to buy grain, for the famine was in the land of Canaan also.

42.zh: 当时治理埃及地的是约瑟；粜粮给那地众民的就是他。约瑟的哥哥们来了，脸伏于地，向他下拜。
42.en: Now Joseph was the governor of the land, the one who sold grain to all its people. So when Joseph's brothers arrived, they bowed down to him with their faces to the ground.

42.zh: 约瑟看见他哥哥们，就认得他们，却装作生人，向他们说些严厉话，问他们说：你们从那里来？他们说：我们从迦南地来籴粮。
42.en: As soon as Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he pretended to be a stranger and spoke harshly to them. "Where do you come from?" he asked. "From the land of Canaan," they replied, "to buy food."

42.zh: 约瑟认得他哥哥们，他们却不认得他。
42.en: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.

42.zh: 约瑟想起从前所做的那两个梦，就对他们说：你们是奸细，来窥探这地的虚实。
42.en: Then he remembered his dreams about them and said to them, "You are spies! You have come to see where our land is unprotected."

42.zh: 他们对他说：我主阿，不是的。仆人们是籴粮来的。
42.en: "No, my lord," they answered. "Your servants have come to buy food.

42.zh: 我们都是一个人的儿子，是诚实人；仆人们并不是奸细。
42.en: We are all the sons of one man. Your servants are honest men, not spies."

42.zh: 约瑟说：不然，你们必是窥探这地的虚实来的。
42.en: "No!" he said to them. "You have come to see where our land is unprotected."

42.zh: 他们说：仆人们本是弟兄十二人，是迦南地一个人的儿子，顶小的现今在我们的父亲那里，有一个没有了。
42.en: But they replied, "Your servants were twelve brothers, the sons of one man, who lives in the land of Canaan. The youngest is now with our father, and one is no more."

42.zh: 约瑟说：我才说你们是奸细，这话实在不错。
42.en: Joseph said to them, "It is just as I told you: You are spies!

42.zh: 我指著法老的性命起誓，若是你们的小兄弟不到这里，你们就不得出这地方，从此就可以把你们证验出来了。
42.en: And this is how you will be tested: As surely as Pharaoh lives, you will not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.

42.zh: 须要打发你们中间一个人去，把你们的兄弟带来。至于你们，都要囚在这里，好证验你们的话真不真，若不真，我指著法老的性命起誓，你们一定是奸细。
42.en: Send one of your number to get your brother; the rest of you will be kept in prison, so that your words may be tested to see if you are telling the truth. If you are not, then as surely as Pharaoh lives, you are spies!"

42.zh: 于是约瑟把他们都下在监里三天。
42.en: And he put them all in custody for three days.

42.zh: 到了第三天，约瑟对他们说：我是敬畏神的；你们照我的话行就可以存活。
42.en: On the third day, Joseph said to them, "Do this and you will live, for I fear God:

42.zh: 你们如果是诚实人，可以留你们中间的一个人囚在监里，但你们可以带著粮食回去，救你们家里的饥荒。
42.en: If you are honest men, let one of your brothers stay here in prison, while the rest of you go and take grain back for your starving households.

42.zh: 把你们的小兄弟带到我这里来，如此，你们的话便有证据，你们也不至于死。他们就照样而行。
42.en: But you must bring your youngest brother to me, so that your words may be verified and that you may not die." This they proceeded to do.

42.zh: 他们彼此说：我们在兄弟身上实在有罪。他哀求我们的时候，我们见他心里的愁苦，却不肯听，所以这场苦难临到我们身上。
42.en: They said to one another, "Surely we are being punished because of our brother. We saw how distressed he was when he pleaded with us for his life, but we would not listen; that's why this distress has come upon us."

42.zh: 流便说：我岂不是对你们说过，不可伤害那孩子么？只是你们不肯听，所以流他血的罪向我们追讨。
42.en: Reuben replied, "Didn't I tell you not to sin against the boy? But you wouldn't listen! Now we must give an accounting for his blood."

42.zh: 他们不知道约瑟听得出来，因为在他们中间用通事传话。
42.en: They did not realize that Joseph could understand them, since he was using an interpreter.

42.zh: 约瑟转身退去，哭了一场，又回来对他们说话，就从他们中间挑出西缅来，在他们眼前把他捆绑。
42.en: He turned away from them and began to weep, but then turned back and spoke to them again. He had Simeon taken from them and bound before their eyes.

42.zh: 约瑟吩咐人把粮食装满他们的器具，把各人的银子归还在各人的口袋里，又给他们路上用的食物，人就照他的话办了。
42.en: Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, to put each man's silver back in his sack, and to give them provisions for their journey. After this was done for them,

42.zh: 他们就把粮食驮在驴上，离开那里去了。
42.en: they loaded their grain on their donkeys and left.

42.zh: 到了住宿的地方，他们中间有一个人打开口袋，要拿料喂驴，才看见自己的银子仍在口袋里，
42.en: At the place where they stopped for the night one of them opened his sack to get feed for his donkey, and he saw his silver in the mouth of his sack.

42.zh: 就对弟兄们说：我的银子归还了，看哪，仍在我口袋里！他们就提心吊胆，战战兢兢的彼此说：这是神向我们做甚么呢？
42.en: "My silver has been returned," he said to his brothers. "Here it is in my sack." Their hearts sank and they turned to each other trembling and said, "What is this that God has done to us?"

42.zh: 他们来到迦南地 、 他们的父亲雅各那里，将所遭遇的事都告诉他，说：
42.en: When they came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan, they told him all that had happened to them. They said,

42.zh: 那地的主对我们说严厉的话，把我们当作窥探那地的奸细。
42.en: "The man who is lord over the land spoke harshly to us and treated us as though we were spying on the land.

42.zh: 我们对他说：我们是诚实人，并不是奸细。
42.en: But we said to him, 'We are honest men; we are not spies.

42.zh: 我们本是弟兄十二人，都是一个父亲的儿子，有一个没有了，顶小的如今同我们的父亲在迦南地。
42.en: We were twelve brothers, sons of one father. One is no more, and the youngest is now with our father in Canaan.'

42.zh: 那地的主对我们说：若要我知道你们是诚实人，可以留下你们中间的一个人在我这里，你们可以带著粮食回去，救你们家里的饥荒。
42.en: "Then the man who is lord over the land said to us, 'This is how I will know whether you are honest men: Leave one of your brothers here with me, and take food for your starving households and go.

42.zh: 把你们的小兄弟带到我这里来，我便知道你们不是奸细，乃是诚实人。这样，我就把你们的弟兄交给你们，你们也可以在这地做买卖。
42.en: But bring your youngest brother to me so I will know that you are not spies but honest men. Then I will give your brother back to you, and you can trade in the land.' "

42.zh: 后来他们倒口袋，不料，各人的银包都在口袋里；他们和父亲看见银包就都害怕。
42.en: As they were emptying their sacks, there in each man's sack was his pouch of silver! When they and their father saw the money pouches, they were frightened.

42.zh: 他们的父亲雅各对他们说：你们使我丧失我的儿子：约瑟没有了，西缅也没有了，你们又要将便雅悯带去；这些事都归到我身上了。
42.en: Their father Jacob said to them, "You have deprived me of my children. Joseph is no more and Simeon is no more, and now you want to take Benjamin. Everything is against me!"

42.zh: 流便对他父亲说：我若不带他回来交给你，你可以杀我的两个儿子。只管把他交在我手里，我必带他回来交给你。
42.en: Then Reuben said to his father, "You may put both of my sons to death if I do not bring him back to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him back."

42.zh: 雅各说：我的儿子不可与你们一同下去；他哥哥死了，只剩下他，他若在你们所行的路上遭害，那便是你们使我白发苍苍 、 悲悲惨惨的下阴间去了。
42.en: But Jacob said, "My son will not go down there with you; his brother is dead and he is the only one left. If harm comes to him on the journey you are taking, you will bring my gray head down to the grave in sorrow."

43.zh: 那地的饥荒甚大。
43.en: Now the famine was still severe inthe land.

43.zh: 他们从埃及带来的粮食吃尽了，他们的父亲就对他们说：‘你们再去给我籴些粮来。’
43.en: So when they had eaten all the grain they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, "Go back and buy us a little more food."

43.zh: 犹大对他说：‘那人谆谆地告诫我们说：“你们的兄弟若不与你们同来，你们就不得见我的面。”
43.en: But Judah said to him, "The man warned us solemnly, 'You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.'

43.zh: 你若打发我们的兄弟与我们同去，我们就下去给你籴粮；
43.en: If you will send our brother along with us, we will go down and buy food for you.

43.zh: 你若不打发他去，我们就不下去，因为那人对我们说：“你们的兄弟若不与你们同来，你们就不得见我的面。”’
43.en: But if you will not send him, we will not go down, because the man said to us, 'You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.' "

43.zh: 以色列说：‘你们为什么这样害我，告诉那人你们还有兄弟呢？’
43.en: Israel asked, "Why did you bring this trouble on me by telling the man you had another brother?"

43.zh: 他们回答说：‘那人详细问到我们和我们的亲属，说：“你们的父亲还在吗？你们还有兄弟吗？”我们就按著他所问的告诉他，焉能知道他要说“必须把你们的兄弟带下来”呢？’
43.en: They replied, "The man questioned us closely about ourselves and our family. 'Is your father still living?' he asked us. 'Do you have another brother?' We simply answered his questions. How were we to know he would say, 'Bring your brother down here'?"

43.zh: 犹大又对他父亲以色列说：‘你打发童子与我同去，我们就起身下去，好叫我们和你，并我们的妇人孩子，都得存活，不至于死。
43.en: Then Judah said to Israel his father, "Send the boy along with me and we will go at once, so that we and you and our children may live and not die.

43.zh: 我为他作保；你可以从我手中追讨，我若不带他回来交在你面前，我情愿永远担罪。
43.en: I myself will guarantee his safety; you can hold me personally responsible for him. If I do not bring him back to you and set him here before you, I will bear the blame before you all my life.

43.zh: 我们若没有耽搁，如今第二次都回来了。’
43.en: As it is, if we had not delayed, we could have gone and returned twice."

43.zh: 他们的父亲以色列说：‘若必须如此，你们就当这样行：可以将这地土产中最好的乳香 、 蜂蜜 、 香料 、 没药 、 榧子 、 杏仁都取一点，收在器具里，带下去送给那人作礼物，
43.en: Then their father Israel said to them, "If it must be, then do this: Put some of the best products of the land in your bags and take them down to the man as a gift-a little balm and a little honey, some spices and myrrh, some pistachio nuts and almonds.

43.zh: 又要手里加倍地带银子，并将归还在你们口袋内的银子仍带在手里；那或者是错了。
43.en: Take double the amount of silver with you, for you must return the silver that was put back into the mouths of your sacks. Perhaps it was a mistake.

43.zh: 也带著你们的兄弟，起身去见那人。
43.en: Take your brother also and go back to the man at once.

43.zh: 但愿全能的神使你们在那人面前蒙怜悯，释放你们的那弟兄和便雅悯回来。我若丧了儿子，就丧了吧 ! ’
43.en: And may God Almighty grant you mercy before the man so that he will let your other brother and Benjamin come back with you. As for me, if I am bereaved, I am bereaved."

43.zh: 于是，他们拿著那礼物，又手里加倍地带银子，并且带著便雅悯，起身下到埃及，站在约瑟面前。
43.en: So the men took the gifts and double the amount of silver, and Benjamin also. They hurried down to Egypt and presented themselves to Joseph.

43.zh: 约瑟见便雅悯和他们同来，就对家宰说：‘将这些人领到屋里。要宰杀牲畜，预备筵席，因为晌午这些人同我吃饭。’
43.en: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, "Take these men to my house, slaughter an animal and prepare dinner; they are to eat with me at noon."

43.zh: 家宰就遵著约瑟的命去行，领他们进约瑟的屋里。
43.en: The man did as Joseph told him and took the men to Joseph's house.

43.zh: 他们因为被领到约瑟的屋里，就害怕，说：‘领我们到这里来，必是因为头次归还在我们口袋里的银子，找我们的错缝，下手害我们，强取我们为奴仆，抢夺我们的驴。’
43.en: Now the men were frightened when they were taken to his house. They thought, "We were brought here because of the silver that was put back into our sacks the first time. He wants to attack us and overpower us and seize us as slaves and take our donkeys."

43.zh: 他们就挨近约瑟的家宰，在屋门口和他说话，
43.en: So they went up to Joseph's steward and spoke to him at the entrance to the house.

43.zh: 说：‘我主啊，我们头次下来实在是要籴粮。
43.en: "Please, sir," they said, "we came down here the first time to buy food.

43.zh: 后来到了住宿的地方，我们打开口袋，不料，各人的银子，分量足数，仍在各人的口袋内，现在我们手里又带回来了。
43.en: But at the place where we stopped for the night we opened our sacks and each of us found his silver-the exact weight-in the mouth of his sack. So we have brought it back with us.

43.zh: 另外又带下银子来籴粮。不知道先前谁把银子放在我们的口袋里。’
43.en: We have also brought additional silver with us to buy food. We don't know who put our silver in our sacks."

43.zh: 家宰说：‘你们可以放心，不要害怕，是你们的神和你们父亲的神赐给你们财宝在你们的口袋里；你们的银子，我早已收了。’他就把西缅带出来，交给他们。
43.en: "It's all right," he said. "Don't be afraid. Your God, the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks; I received your silver." Then he brought Simeon out to them.

43.zh: 家宰就领他们进约瑟的屋里，给他们水洗脚，又给他们草料喂驴。
43.en: The steward took the men into Joseph's house, gave them water to wash their feet and provided fodder for their donkeys.

43.zh: 他们就预备那礼物，等候约瑟晌午来，因为他们听见要在那里吃饭。
43.en: They prepared their gifts for Joseph's arrival at noon, because they had heard that they were to eat there.

43.zh: 约瑟来到家里，他们就把手中的礼物拿进屋去给他，又俯伏在地，向他下拜。
43.en: When Joseph came home, they presented to him the gifts they had brought into the house, and they bowed down before him to the ground.

43.zh: 约瑟问他们好，又问：‘你们的父亲 ─ 就是你们所说的那老人家平安吗？他还在吗？’
43.en: He asked them how they were, and then he said, "How is your aged father you told me about? Is he still living?"

43.zh: 他们回答说：‘你仆人 ─ 我们的父亲平安；他还在。’于是他们低头下拜。
43.en: They replied, "Your servant our father is still alive and well." And they bowed low to pay him honor.

43.zh: 约瑟举目看见他同母的兄弟便雅悯，就说：‘你们向我所说那顶小的兄弟就是这位吗？’又说：‘小儿啊，愿神赐恩给你 ! ’
43.en: As he looked about and saw his brother Benjamin, his own mother's son, he asked, "Is this your youngest brother, the one you told me about?" And he said, "God be gracious to you, my son."

43.zh: 约瑟爱弟之情发动，就急忙寻找可哭之地，进入自己的屋里，哭了一场。
43.en: Deeply moved at the sight of his brother, Joseph hurried out and looked for a place to weep. He went into his private room and wept there.

43.zh: 他洗了脸出来，勉强隐忍，吩咐人摆饭。
43.en: After he had washed his face, he came out and, controlling himself, said, "Serve the food."

43.zh: 他们就为约瑟单摆了一席，为那些人又摆了一席，也为和约瑟同吃饭的埃及人另摆了一席，因为埃及人不可和希伯来人一同吃饭；那原是埃及人所厌恶的。
43.en: They served him by himself, the brothers by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because Egyptians could not eat with Hebrews, for that is detestable to Egyptians.

43.zh: 约瑟使众弟兄在他面前排列坐席，都按著长幼的次序，众弟兄就彼此诧异。
43.en: The men had been seated before him in the order of their ages, from the firstborn to the youngest; and they looked at each other in astonishment.

43.zh: 约瑟把他面前的食物分出来，送给他们；但便雅悯所得的比别人多五倍。他们就饮酒，和约瑟一同宴乐。
43.en: When portions were served to them from Joseph's table, Benjamin's portion was five times as much as anyone else's. So they feasted and drank freely with him.

44.zh: 约瑟吩咐家宰说：‘把粮食装满这些人的口袋，尽著他们的驴所能驮的，又把各人的银子放在各人的口袋里，
44.en: Now Joseph gave these instructions to the steward of his house: "Fill the men's sacks with as much food as they can carry, and put each man's silver in the mouth of his sack.

44.zh: 并将我的银杯和那少年人籴粮的银子一同装在他的口袋里。’家宰就照约瑟所说的话行了；
44.en: Then put my cup, the silver one, in the mouth of the youngest one's sack, along with the silver for his grain." And he did as Joseph said.

44.zh: 天一亮就打发那些人带著驴走了。
44.en: As morning dawned, the men were sent on their way with their donkeys.

44.zh: 他们出城走了不远，约瑟对家宰说：‘起来，追那些人去，追上了就对他们说：“你们为甚么以恶报善呢？
44.en: They had not gone far from the city when Joseph said to his steward, "Go after those men at once, and when you catch up with them, say to them, 'Why have you repaid good with evil?

44.zh: 这不是我主人饮酒的杯吗？岂不是他占卜用的吗？你们这样行是作恶了。”’
44.en: Isn't this the cup my master drinks from and also uses for divination? This is a wicked thing you have done.' "

44.zh: 家宰追上他们，将这些话对他们说了。
44.en: When he caught up with them, he repeated these words to them.

44.zh: 他们回答说：‘我主为甚么说这样的话呢？你仆人断不能作这样的事。
44.en: But they said to him, "Why does my lord say such things? Far be it from your servants to do anything like that!

44.zh: 你看，我们从前在口袋里所见的银子，尚且从迦南地带来还你，我们怎能从你主人家里偷窃金银呢？
44.en: We even brought back to you from the land of Canaan the silver we found inside the mouths of our sacks. So why would we steal silver or gold from your master's house?

44.zh: 你仆人中无论在谁那里搜出来，就叫他死，我们也作我主的奴仆。’
44.en: If any of your servants is found to have it, he will die; and the rest of us will become my lord's slaves."

44.zh: 家宰说：‘现在就照你们的话行吧 ! 在谁那里搜出来，谁就作我的奴仆；其余的都没有罪。’
44.en: "Very well, then," he said, "let it be as you say. Whoever is found to have it will become my slave; the rest of you will be free from blame."

44.zh: 于是他们各人急忙把口袋卸在地下，各人打开口袋。
44.en: Each of them quickly lowered his sack to the ground and opened it.

44.zh: 家宰就搜查，从年长的起到年幼的为止，那杯竟在便雅悯的口袋里搜出来。
44.en: Then the steward proceeded to search, beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest. And the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

44.zh: 他们就撕裂衣服，各人把驮子抬在驴上，回城去了。
44.en: At this, they tore their clothes. Then they all loaded their donkeys and returned to the city.

44.zh: 犹大和他弟兄们来到约瑟的屋中，约瑟还在那里，他们就在他面前俯伏于地。
44.en: Joseph was still in the house when Judah and his brothers came in, and they threw themselves to the ground before him.

44.zh: 约瑟对他们说：‘你们作的是甚么事呢？你们岂不知像我这样的人必能占卜吗？’
44.en: Joseph said to them, "What is this you have done? Don't you know that a man like me can find things out by divination?"

44.zh: 犹大说：‘我们对我主说甚么呢？还有甚么话可说呢？我们怎能自己表白出来呢？神已经查出仆人的罪孽了。我们与那在他手中搜出杯来的都是我主的奴仆。
44.en: "What can we say to my lord?" Judah replied. "What can we say? How can we prove our innocence? God has uncovered your servants' guilt. We are now my lord's slaves-we ourselves and the one who was found to have the cup."

44.zh: 约瑟说：‘我断不能这样行 ! 在谁的手中搜出杯来，谁就作我的奴仆；至于你们，可以平平安安地上你们父亲那里去。’
44.en: But Joseph said, "Far be it from me to do such a thing! Only the man who was found to have the cup will become my slave. The rest of you, go back to your father in peace."

44.zh: 犹大挨近他，说：‘我主啊，求你容仆人说一句话给我主听，不要向仆人发烈怒，因为你如同法老一样。
44.en: Then Judah went up to him and said: "Please, my lord, let your servant speak a word to my lord. Do not be angry with your servant, though you are equal to Pharaoh himself.

44.zh: 我主曾问仆人们说：“你们有父亲有兄弟没有？”
44.en: My lord asked his servants, 'Do you have a father or a brother?'

44.zh: 我们对我主说：“我们有父亲，已经年老，还有他老年所生的一个小孩子。他哥哥死了，他母亲只撇下他一人，他父亲疼爱他。”
44.en: And we answered, 'We have an aged father, and there is a young son born to him in his old age. His brother is dead, and he is the only one of his mother's sons left, and his father loves him.'

44.zh: 你对仆人说：“把他带到我这里来，叫我亲眼看看他。”
44.en: "Then you said to your servants, 'Bring him down to me so I can see him for myself.'

44.zh: 我们对我主说：童子不能离开他父亲，若是离开，他父亲必死。
44.en: And we said to my lord, 'The boy cannot leave his father; if he leaves him, his father will die.'

44.zh: 你对仆人说：你们的小兄弟若不与你们一同下来，你们就不得再见我的面。
44.en: But you told your servants, 'Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will not see my face again.'

44.zh: 我们上到你仆人 ─ 我们父亲那里，就把我主的话告诉了他。
44.en: When we went back to your servant my father, we told him what my lord had said.

44.zh: 我们的父亲说：你们再去给我籴些粮来。
44.en: "Then our father said, 'Go back and buy a little more food.'

44.zh: 我们就说：我们不能下去。我们的小兄弟若和我们同往，我们就可以下去。因为，小兄弟若不与我们同往，我们必不得见那人的面。
44.en: But we said, 'We cannot go down. Only if our youngest brother is with us will we go. We cannot see the man's face unless our youngest brother is with us.'

44.zh: 你仆人 ─ 我父亲对我们说：你们知道我的妻子给我生了两个儿子。
44.en: "Your servant my father said to us, 'You know that my wife bore me two sons.

44.zh: 一个离开我出去了；我说他必是被撕碎了，直到如今我也没有见他。
44.en: One of them went away from me, and I said, "He has surely been torn to pieces." And I have not seen him since.

44.zh: 现在你们又要把这个带去离开我，倘若他遭害，那便是你们使我白发苍苍 、 悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。
44.en: If you take this one from me too and harm comes to him, you will bring my gray head down to the grave in misery.'

44.zh: 我父亲的命与这童子的命相连。如今我回到你仆人 ─ 我父亲那里，若没有童子与我们同在，
44.en: "So now, if the boy is not with us when I go back to your servant my father and if my father, whose life is closely bound up with the boy's life,

44.zh: 我们的父亲见没有童子，他就必死。这便是我们使你仆人 ─ 我们的父亲白发苍苍 、 悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。
44.en: sees that the boy isn't there, he will die. Your servants will bring the gray head of our father down to the grave in sorrow.

44.zh: 因为仆人曾向我父亲为这童子作保，说：我若不带他回来交给父亲，我便在父亲面前永远担罪。
44.en: Your servant guaranteed the boy's safety to my father. I said, 'If I do not bring him back to you, I will bear the blame before you, my father, all my life!'

44.zh: 现在求你容仆人住下，替这童子作我主的奴仆，叫童子和他哥哥们一同上去。
44.en: "Now then, please let your servant remain here as my lord's slave in place of the boy, and let the boy return with his brothers.

44.zh: 若童子不和我同去，我怎能上去见我父亲呢？恐怕我看见灾祸临到我父亲身上。
44.en: How can I go back to my father if the boy is not with me? No! Do not let me see the misery that would come upon my father."

45.zh: 约瑟在左右站著的人面前情不自禁，吩咐一声说：人都要离开我出去！约瑟和弟兄相认的时候并没有一人站在他面前。
45.en: Then Joseph could no longer control himself before all his attendants, and he cried out, "Have everyone leave my presence!" So there was no one with Joseph when he made himself known to his brothers.

45.zh: 他就放声大哭，埃及人和法老家中的人都听见了。
45.en: And he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard him, and Pharaoh's household heard about it.

45.zh: 约瑟对他弟兄们说：我是约瑟。我的父亲还在么？他弟兄不能回答，因为在他面前都惊惶。
45.en: Joseph said to his brothers, "I am Joseph! Is my father still living?" But his brothers were not able to answer him, because they were terrified at his presence.

45.zh: 约瑟又对他弟兄们说：请你们近前来。他们就近前来。他说：我是你们的兄弟约瑟，就是你们所卖到埃及的。
45.en: Then Joseph said to his brothers, "Come close to me." When they had done so, he said, "I am your brother Joseph, the one you sold into Egypt!

45.zh: 现在，不要因为把我卖到这里自忧自恨。这是神差我在你们以先来，为要保全生命。
45.en: And now, do not be distressed and do not be angry with yourselves for selling me here, because it was to save lives that God sent me ahead of you.

45.zh: 现在这地的饥荒已经二年了，还有五年不能耕种，不能收成。
45.en: For two years now there has been famine in the land, and for the next five years there will not be plowing and reaping.

45.zh: 神差我在你们以先来，为要给你们存留余种在世上，又要大施拯救，保全你们的生命。
45.en: But God sent me ahead of you to preserve for you a remnant on earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

45.zh: 这样看来，差我到这里来的不是你们，乃是神。他又使我如法老的父，作他全家的主，并埃及全地的宰相。
45.en: "So then, it was not you who sent me here, but God. He made me father to Pharaoh, lord of his entire household and ruler of all Egypt.

45.zh: 你们要赶紧上到我父亲那里。对他说：你儿子约瑟这样说：神使我作全埃及的主，请你下到我这里来，不要耽延。
45.en: Now hurry back to my father and say to him, 'This is what your son Joseph says: God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me; don't delay.

45.zh: 你和你我儿子孙子，连牛群羊群，并一切所有的，都可以住在歌珊地，与我相近。
45.en: You shall live in the region of Goshen and be near me-you, your children and grandchildren, your flocks and herds, and all you have.

45.zh: 我要在那里奉养你；因为还有五年的饥荒，免得你和你的眷属，并一切所有的，都败落了。
45.en: I will provide for you there, because five years of famine are still to come. Otherwise you and your household and all who belong to you will become destitute.'

45.zh: 况且你们的眼和我兄弟便雅悯的眼都看见是我亲口对你们说话。
45.en: "You can see for yourselves, and so can my brother Benjamin, that it is really I who am speaking to you.

45.zh: 你们也要将我在埃及一切的荣耀和你们所看见的事都告诉我父亲，又要赶紧的将我父亲搬到我这里来。
45.en: Tell my father about all the honor accorded me in Egypt and about everything you have seen. And bring my father down here quickly."

45.zh: 于是约瑟伏在他兄弟便雅悯的颈项上哭，便雅悯也在他的颈项上哭。
45.en: Then he threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin embraced him, weeping.

45.zh: 他又与众弟兄亲嘴，抱著他们哭，随后他弟兄就和他说话。
45.en: And he kissed all his brothers and wept over them. Afterward his brothers talked with him.

45.zh: 这风声传到法老的宫里，说：约瑟的弟兄们来了。法老和他的臣仆都很喜欢。
45.en: When the news reached Pharaoh's palace that Joseph's brothers had come, Pharaoh and all his officials were pleased.

45.zh: 法老对约瑟说：你吩咐你的弟兄们说：你们要这样行：把驮子抬在牲口上，起身往迦南地去。
45.en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Tell your brothers, 'Do this: Load your animals and return to the land of Canaan,

45.zh: 将你们的父亲和你们的眷属都搬到我这里来，我要把埃及地的美物赐给你们，你们也要吃这地肥美的出产。
45.en: and bring your father and your families back to me. I will give you the best of the land of Egypt and you can enjoy the fat of the land.'

45.zh: 现在我吩咐你们要这样行：从埃及地带著车辆去，把你们的孩子和妻子，并你们的父亲都搬来。
45.en: "You are also directed to tell them, 'Do this: Take some carts from Egypt for your children and your wives, and get your father and come.

45.zh: 你们眼中不要爱惜你们的家具，因为埃及全地的美物都是你们的。
45.en: Never mind about your belongings, because the best of all Egypt will be yours.' "

45.zh: 以色列的儿子们就如此行。约瑟照著法老的吩咐给他们车辆和路上用的食物，
45.en: So the sons of Israel did this. Joseph gave them carts, as Pharaoh had commanded, and he also gave them provisions for their journey.

45.zh: 又给他们各人一套衣服，惟独给便雅悯三百银子，五套衣服；
45.en: To each of them he gave new clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.

45.zh: 送给他父亲公驴十匹，驮著埃及的美物，母驴十匹，驮著粮食与饼和菜，为他父亲路上用。
45.en: And this is what he sent to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the best things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and other provisions for his journey.

45.zh: 于是约瑟打发他弟兄们回去，又对他们说：你们不要在路上相争。
45.en: Then he sent his brothers away, and as they were leaving he said to them, "Don't quarrel on the way!"

45.zh: 他们从埃及上去，来到迦南地 、 他们的父亲雅各那里，
45.en: So they went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.

45.zh: 告诉他说：约瑟还在，并且作埃及全地的宰相。雅各心里冰凉，因为不信他们。
45.en: They told him, "Joseph is still alive! In fact, he is ruler of all Egypt." Jacob was stunned; he did not believe them.

45.zh: 他们便将约瑟对他们说的一切话都告诉了他。他们父亲雅各又看见约瑟打发来接他的车辆，心就苏醒了。
45.en: But when they told him everything Joseph had said to them, and when he saw the carts Joseph had sent to carry him back, the spirit of their father Jacob revived.

45.zh: 以色列说：罢了！罢了！我的儿子约瑟还在，趁我未死以先，我要去见他一面。
45.en: And Israel said, "I'm convinced! My son Joseph is still alive. I will go and see him before I die."

46.zh: 以色列带著一切所有的，起身来到别是巴，就献祭给他父亲以撒的神。
46.en: So Israel set out with all that was his, and when he reached Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.

46.zh: 夜间，神在异象中对以色列说：雅各！雅各！他说：我在这里。
46.en: And God spoke to Israel in a vision at night and said, "Jacob! Jacob!" "Here I am," he replied.

46.zh: 神说：我是神，就是你父亲的神。你下埃及去不要害怕，因为我必使你在那里成为大族。
46.en: "I am God, the God of your father," he said. "Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there.

46.zh: 我要和你同下埃及去，也必定带你上来；约瑟必给你送终 ( 原文作将手按在你的眼睛上 ) 。
46.en: I will go down to Egypt with you, and I will surely bring you back again. And Joseph's own hand will close your eyes."

46.zh: 雅各就从别是巴起行。以色列的儿子们使他们的父亲雅各和他们的妻子 、 儿女都坐在法老为雅各送来的车上。
46.en: Then Jacob left Beersheba, and Israel's sons took their father Jacob and their children and their wives in the carts that Pharaoh had sent to transport him.

46.zh: 他们又带著迦南地所得的牲畜 、 货财来到埃及。雅各和他的一切子孙都一同来了，
46.en: They also took with them their livestock and the possessions they had acquired in Canaan, and Jacob and all his offspring went to Egypt.

46.zh: 雅各把他的儿子 、 孙子 、 女儿 、 孙女，并他的子子孙孙，一同带到埃及。
46.en: He took with him to Egypt his sons and grandsons and his daughters and granddaughters-all his offspring.

46.zh: 来到埃及的以色列人名字记在下面。雅各和他的儿孙：雅各的长子是流便。
46.en: These are the names of the sons of Israel (Jacob and his descendants) who went to Egypt: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob.

46.zh: 流便的儿子是哈诺 、 法路 、 希斯伦 、 迦米。
46.en: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron and Carmi.

46.zh: 西缅的儿子是耶母利 、 雅悯 、 阿辖 、 雅斤 、 琐辖，还有迦南女子所生的扫罗。
46.en: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

46.zh: 利未的儿子是革顺 、 哥辖 、 米拉利。
46.en: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

46.zh: 犹大的儿子是珥 、 俄南 、 示拉 、 法勒斯 、 谢拉；惟有珥与俄南死在迦南地。法勒斯的儿子是希斯伦 、 哈母勒。
46.en: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez and Zerah (but Er and Onan had died in the land of Canaan). The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

46.zh: 以萨迦的儿子是陀拉 、 普瓦 、 约伯 、 伸仑。
46.en: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron.

46.zh: 西布伦的儿子是西烈 、 以伦 、 雅利。
46.en: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon and Jahleel.

46.zh: 这是利亚在巴旦亚兰给雅各所生的儿子，还在女儿底拿。儿孙共三十三人。
46.en: These were the sons Leah bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, besides his daughter Dinah. These sons and daughters of his were thirty-three in all.

46.zh: 迦得的儿子是洗非芸 、 哈基 、 书尼 、 以斯本 、 以利 、 亚罗底 、 亚列利。
46.en: The sons of Gad: Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi and Areli.

46.zh: 亚设的儿子是音拿 、 亦施瓦 、 亦施韦 、 比利亚，还有他们的妹子西拉。比利亚的儿子是希别 、 玛结。
46.en: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi and Beriah. Their sister was Serah. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malkiel.

46.zh: 这是拉班给他女儿利亚的婢女悉帕从雅各所生的儿孙，共有十六人。
46.en: These were the children born to Jacob by Zilpah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Leah-sixteen in all.

46.zh: 雅各之妻拉结的儿子是约瑟和便雅悯。
46.en: The sons of Jacob's wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

46.zh: 约瑟在埃及地生了玛拿西和以法莲，就是安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给约瑟生的。
46.en: In Egypt, Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.

46.zh: 便雅悯的儿子是比拉 、 比结 、 亚实别 、 基拉 、 乃幔 、 以希 、 罗实 、 母平 、 户平 、 亚勒。
46.en: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim and Ard.

46.zh: 这是拉结给雅各所生的儿孙，共有十四人。
46.en: These were the sons of Rachel who were born to Jacob-fourteen in all.

46.zh: 但的儿子是户伸。
46.en: The son of Dan: Hushim.

46.zh: 拿弗他利的儿子是雅薛 、 沽尼 、 耶色 、 示冷。
46.en: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem.

46.zh: 这是拉班给他女儿拉结的婢女辟拉从雅各所生的儿孙，共有七人。
46.en: These were the sons born to Jacob by Bilhah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Rachel-seven in all.

46.zh: 那与雅各同到埃及的，除了他儿妇之外，凡从他所生的，共有六十六人。
46.en: All those who went to Egypt with Jacob-those who were his direct descendants, not counting his sons' wives-numbered sixty-six persons.

46.zh: 还有约瑟在埃及所生的两个儿子。雅各家来到埃及的共有七十人。
46.en: With the two sons who had been born to Joseph in Egypt, the members of Jacob's family, which went to Egypt, were seventy in all.

46.zh: 雅各打发犹大先去见约瑟，请派人引路往歌珊去；于是他们来到歌珊地。
46.en: Now Jacob sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to get directions to Goshen. When they arrived in the region of Goshen,

46.zh: 约瑟套车往歌珊去，迎接他父亲以色列，及至见了面，就伏在父亲的颈项，哭了许久。
46.en: Joseph had his chariot made ready and went to Goshen to meet his father Israel. As soon as Joseph appeared before him, he threw his arms around his father and wept for a long time.

46.zh: 以色列对约瑟说：我既得见你的面，知道你还在，就是死我也甘心。
46.en: Israel said to Joseph, "Now I am ready to die, since I have seen for myself that you are still alive."

46.zh: 约瑟对他的弟兄和他父的全家说：我要上去告诉法老，对他说：我的弟兄和我父的全家从前在迦南地，现今都到我这里来了。
46.en: Then Joseph said to his brothers and to his father's household, "I will go up and speak to Pharaoh and will say to him, 'My brothers and my father's household, who were living in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

46.zh: 他们本是牧羊的人，以养牲畜为业；他们把羊群牛群和一切所有的都带来了。
46.en: The men are shepherds; they tend livestock, and they have brought along their flocks and herds and everything they own.'

46.zh: 等法老召你们的时候，问你们说：你们以何事为业？
46.en: When Pharaoh calls you in and asks, 'What is your occupation?'

46.zh: 你们要说：你的仆人，从幼年直到如今，都以养牲畜为业，连我们的祖宗也都以此为业。这样，你们可以住在歌珊地，因为凡牧羊的都被埃及人所厌恶。
46.en: you should answer, 'Your servants have tended livestock from our boyhood on, just as our fathers did.' Then you will be allowed to settle in the region of Goshen, for all shepherds are detestable to the Egyptians."

47.zh: 约瑟进去告诉法老说：我的父亲和我的弟兄带著羊群牛群，并一切所有的，从迦南地来了，如今在歌珊地。
47.en: Joseph went and told Pharaoh, "My father and brothers, with their flocks and herds and everything they own, have come from the land of Canaan and are now in Goshen."

47.zh: 约瑟从他弟兄中挑出五个人来，引他们去见法老。
47.en: He chose five of his brothers and presented them before Pharaoh.

47.zh: 法老问约瑟的弟兄说：你们以可事为业？他们对法老说：你仆人是牧羊的，连我们的祖宗也是牧羊的。
47.en: Pharaoh asked the brothers, "What is your occupation?" "Your servants are shepherds," they replied to Pharaoh, "just as our fathers were."

47.zh: 他们又对法老说：迦南地的饥荒甚大，仆人的羊群没有草吃，所以我们来到这地寄居。现在求你容仆人住在歌珊地。
47.en: They also said to him, "We have come to live here awhile, because the famine is severe in Canaan and your servants' flocks have no pasture. So now, please let your servants settle in Goshen."

47.zh: 法老对约瑟说：你父亲和你弟兄到你这里来了，
47.en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Your father and your brothers have come to you,

47.zh: 埃及地都在你面前，只管叫你父亲和你弟兄住在国中最好的地；他们可以住在歌珊地。你若知道他们中间有甚么能人，就派他们看管我的牲畜。
47.en: and the land of Egypt is before you; settle your father and your brothers in the best part of the land. Let them live in Goshen. And if you know of any among them with special ability, put them in charge of my own livestock."

47.zh: 约瑟领他父亲雅各进到法老面前，雅各就给法老祝福。
47.en: Then Joseph brought his father Jacob in and presented him before Pharaoh. After Jacob blessed Pharaoh,

47.zh: 法老问雅各说：你平生的年日是多少呢？
47.en: Pharaoh asked him, "How old are you?"

47.zh: 雅各对法老说：我寄居在世的年日是一百三十岁，我平生的年日又少又苦，不及我列祖早在世寄居的年日。
47.en: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, "The years of my pilgrimage are a hundred and thirty. My years have been few and difficult, and they do not equal the years of the pilgrimage of my fathers."

47.zh: 雅各又给法老祝福，就从法老面前出去了。
47.en: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh and went out from his presence.

47.zh: 约瑟遵著法老的命，把埃及国最好的地，就是兰塞境内的地，给他父亲和弟兄居住，作为产业。
47.en: So Joseph settled his father and his brothers in Egypt and gave them property in the best part of the land, the district of Rameses, as Pharaoh directed.

47.zh: 约瑟用粮食奉养他父亲和他弟兄，并他父亲全家的眷属，都是照各家的人口奉养他们。
47.en: Joseph also provided his father and his brothers and all his father's household with food, according to the number of their children.

47.zh: 饥荒甚大，全地都绝了粮，甚至埃及地和迦南地的人因那饥荒的缘故都饿昏了。
47.en: There was no food, however, in the whole region because the famine was severe; both Egypt and Canaan wasted away because of the famine.

47.zh: 约瑟收聚了埃及地和迦南地所有的银子，就是众人籴粮的银子，约瑟就把那银子带到法老的宫里。
47.en: Joseph collected all the money that was to be found in Egypt and Canaan in payment for the grain they were buying, and he brought it to Pharaoh's palace.

47.zh: 埃及地和迦南地的银子都花尽了，埃及众人都来见约瑟，说：我们的银子都用尽了，求你给我们粮食，我们为甚么死在你面前呢？
47.en: When the money of the people of Egypt and Canaan was gone, all Egypt came to Joseph and said, "Give us food. Why should we die before your eyes? Our money is used up."

47.zh: 约瑟说：若是银子用尽了，可以把你们的牲畜给我，我就为你们的牲畜给你们粮食。
47.en: "Then bring your livestock," said Joseph. "I will sell you food in exchange for your livestock, since your money is gone."

47.zh: 于是他们把牲畜赶到约瑟那里，约瑟就拿粮食换了他们的牛 、 羊 、 驴 、 马；那一年因换他们一切的牲畜，就用粮食养活他们。
47.en: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and he gave them food in exchange for their horses, their sheep and goats, their cattle and donkeys. And he brought them through that year with food in exchange for all their livestock.

47.zh: 那一年过去，第二年他们又来见约瑟，说：我们不瞒我主，我们的银子都花尽了，牲畜也都归了我主。我们在我主眼前，除了我们的身体和田地之外，一无所剩。
47.en: When that year was over, they came to him the following year and said, "We cannot hide from our lord the fact that since our money is gone and our livestock belongs to you, there is nothing left for our lord except our bodies and our land.

47.zh: 你何忍见我们人死地荒呢？求你用粮食买我们的我们的地，我们和我们的地就要给法老效力。又求你给我们种子，使我们得以存活，不至死亡，地土也不至荒凉。
47.en: Why should we perish before your eyes-we and our land as well? Buy us and our land in exchange for food, and we with our land will be in bondage to Pharaoh. Give us seed so that we may live and not die, and that the land may not become desolate."

47.zh: 于是，约瑟为法老买了埃及所有的地，埃及人因被饥荒所迫，各都卖了自己的田地；那地就都归了法老。
47.en: So Joseph bought all the land in Egypt for Pharaoh. The Egyptians, one and all, sold their fields, because the famine was too severe for them. The land became Pharaoh's,

47.zh: 至于百姓，约瑟叫他们，从埃及这边直到埃及那边，都各归各城。
47.en: and Joseph reduced the people to servitude, from one end of Egypt to the other.

47.zh: 惟有祭司的地，约瑟没有买，因为祭司有从法老所得的常俸。他们吃法老所给的常俸，所以他们不卖自己的地。
47.en: However, he did not buy the land of the priests, because they received a regular allotment from Pharaoh and had food enough from the allotment Pharaoh gave them. That is why they did not sell their land.

47.zh: 约瑟对百姓说：我今日为法老买了你们和你们的地，看哪，这里有种子给你们，你们可以种地。
47.en: Joseph said to the people, "Now that I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh, here is seed for you so you can plant the ground.

47.zh: 后来打粮食的时候，你们要把五分之一纳给法老，四分可以归你们做地里的种子，也做你们和你们家口孩童的食物。
47.en: But when the crop comes in, give a fifth of it to Pharaoh. The other four-fifths you may keep as seed for the fields and as food for yourselves and your households and your children."

47.zh: 他们说：你救了我们的性命。但愿我们在我主眼前蒙恩，我们就作法老的仆人。
47.en: "You have saved our lives," they said. "May we find favor in the eyes of our lord; we will be in bondage to Pharaoh."

47.zh: 于是约瑟为埃及地定下常例，直到今日：法老必得五分之一，惟独祭司的地不归法老。
47.en: So Joseph established it as a law concerning land in Egypt-still in force today-that a fifth of the produce belongs to Pharaoh. It was only the land of the priests that did not become Pharaoh's.

47.zh: 以色列人住在埃及的歌珊地。他们在那里置了产业，并且生育甚多。
47.en: Now the Israelites settled in Egypt in the region of Goshen. They acquired property there and were fruitful and increased greatly in number.

47.zh: 雅各住在埃及地十七年，雅各平生的年日是一百四十七岁。
47.en: Jacob lived in Egypt seventeen years, and the years of his life were a hundred and forty-seven.

47.zh: 以色列的死期临近了，他就叫了他儿子约瑟来，说：我若在你眼前蒙恩，请你把手放在我大腿底下，用慈爱和诚实待我，请你不要将我葬在埃及。
47.en: When the time drew near for Israel to die, he called for his son Joseph and said to him, "If I have found favor in your eyes, put your hand under my thigh and promise that you will show me kindness and faithfulness. Do not bury me in Egypt,

47.zh: 我与我祖我父同睡的时候，你要将我带出埃及，葬在他们所葬的地方。约瑟说：我必遵著你的命而行。
47.en: but when I rest with my fathers, carry me out of Egypt and bury me where they are buried." "I will do as you say," he said.

47.zh: 雅各说：你要向我起誓。约瑟就向他起了誓，于是以色列在床头上 ( 或作扶著杖头 ) 敬拜神。
47.en: "Swear to me," he said. Then Joseph swore to him, and Israel worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.

48.zh: 这事以后，有人告诉约瑟说：你的父亲病了。他就带著两个儿子玛拿西和以法莲同去。
48.en: Some time later Joseph was told, "Your father is ill." So he took his two sons Manasseh and Ephraim along with him.

48.zh: 有人告诉雅各说：请看，你儿子约瑟到你这里来了。以色列就勉强在床上坐起来。
48.en: When Jacob was told, "Your son Joseph has come to you," Israel rallied his strength and sat up on the bed.

48.zh: 雅各对约瑟说：全能的神曾在迦南地的路斯向我显现，赐福与我，
48.en: Jacob said to Joseph, "God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and there he blessed me

48.zh: 对我说：我必使你生养众多，成为多民，又要把这地赐给你的后裔，永远为业。
48.en: and said to me, 'I am going to make you fruitful and will increase your numbers. I will make you a community of peoples, and I will give this land as an everlasting possession to your descendants after you.'

48.zh: 未到埃及见你之先，你在埃及地所生的以法莲和玛拿西这两个儿子是我的，正如流便和西缅是我的一样。
48.en: "Now then, your two sons born to you in Egypt before I came to you here will be reckoned as mine; Ephraim and Manasseh will be mine, just as Reuben and Simeon are mine.

48.zh: 你在他们以后所生的就是你的，他们可以归于他们弟兄的名下得产业。
48.en: Any children born to you after them will be yours; in the territory they inherit they will be reckoned under the names of their brothers.

48.zh: 至于我，我从巴旦来的时候，拉结死在我眼前，在迦南地的路上，离以法他还有一段路程，我就把他葬在以法他的路上 〈 以法他就是伯利恒 〉 。
48.en: As I was returning from Paddan, to my sorrow Rachel died in the land of Canaan while we were still on the way, a little distance from Ephrath. So I buried her there beside the road to Ephrath" (that is, Bethlehem).

48.zh: 以色列看见约瑟的两个儿子，就说：这是谁？
48.en: When Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he asked, "Who are these?"

48.zh: 约瑟对他父亲说：这是神在这里赐给我的儿子。以色列说：请你领他们到我跟前，我要给他们祝福。
48.en: "They are the sons God has given me here," Joseph said to his father. Then Israel said, "Bring them to me so I may bless them."

48.zh: 以色列年纪老迈，眼睛昏花，不能看见。约瑟领他们到他跟前，他就和他们亲嘴，抱著他们。
48.en: Now Israel's eyes were failing because of old age, and he could hardly see. So Joseph brought his sons close to him, and his father kissed them and embraced them.

48.zh: 以色列对约瑟说：我想不到得见你的面，不料，神又使我得见你的儿子。
48.en: Israel said to Joseph, "I never expected to see your face again, and now God has allowed me to see your children too."

48.zh: 约瑟把两个儿子从以色列两膝中领出来，自己就脸伏于地下拜。
48.en: Then Joseph removed them from Israel's knees and bowed down with his face to the ground.

48.zh: 随后，约瑟又拉著他们两个，以法莲在他的右手里，对著以色列的左手，玛拿西在他的左手里，对著以色列的右手，领他们到以色列的跟前。
48.en: And Joseph took both of them, Ephraim on his right toward Israel's left hand and Manasseh on his left toward Israel's right hand, and brought them close to him.

48.zh: 以色列伸出右手来，按在以法莲的头上 〈 以法莲乃是次子 〉 ，又剪搭过左手来，按在玛拿西的头上 〈 玛拿西原是长子 〉 。
48.en: But Israel reached out his right hand and put it on Ephraim's head, though he was the younger, and crossing his arms, he put his left hand on Manasseh's head, even though Manasseh was the firstborn.

48.zh: 他就给约瑟祝福说：愿我祖亚伯拉罕和我父以撒所事奉的神，就是一生牧养我直到今日的神，
48.en: Then he blessed Joseph and said, "May the God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has been my shepherd all my life to this day,

48.zh: 救赎我脱离一切患难的那使者，赐福与这两个童子。愿他们归在我的名下和我祖亚伯拉罕 、 我父以撒的名下。又愿他们在世界中生养众多。
48.en: the Angel who has delivered me from all harm -may he bless these boys. May they be called by my name and the names of my fathers Abraham and Isaac, and may they increase greatly upon the earth."
