48.zh: 约瑟见他父亲把右手按在以法莲的头上，就不喜悦，便提起他父亲的手，要从以法莲的头上挪到玛拿西的头上。
48.en: When Joseph saw his father placing his right hand on Ephraim's head he was displeased; so he took hold of his father's hand to move it from Ephraim's head to Manasseh's head.

48.zh: 约瑟对他父亲说：我父，不是这样。这本是长子，求你把右手按在他的头上。
48.en: Joseph said to him, "No, my father, this one is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head."

48.zh: 他父亲不从，说：我知道，我儿，我知道。他也必成为一族，也必昌大。只是他的兄弟将来比他还大；他兄弟的后裔要成为多族。
48.en: But his father refused and said, "I know, my son, I know. He too will become a people, and he too will become great. Nevertheless, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his descendants will become a group of nations."

48.zh: 当日就给他们祝福说：以色列人要指著你们祝福说：愿神使你如以法莲 、 玛拿西一样。于是立以法莲在玛拿西以上。
48.en: He blessed them that day and said, "In your name will Israel pronounce this blessing: 'May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh.' " So he put Ephraim ahead of Manasseh.

48.zh: 以色列又对约瑟说：我要死了，但神必与你们同在，领你们回到你们列祖之地。
48.en: Then Israel said to Joseph, "I am about to die, but God will be with you and take you back to the land of your fathers.

48.zh: 并且我从前用弓用刀从亚摩利人手下夺的那块地，我都赐给你，使你比众弟兄多得一分。
48.en: And to you, as one who is over your brothers, I give the ridge of land I took from the Amorites with my sword and my bow."

49.zh: 雅各叫了他的儿子们来，说：你们都来聚集，我好把你们日后必遇的事告诉你们。
49.en: Then Jacob called for his sons and said: "Gather around so I can tell you what will happen to you in days to come.

49.zh: 雅各的儿子们，你们要聚集而听，要听你们父亲以色列的话。
49.en: "Assemble and listen, sons of Jacob; listen to your father Israel.

49.zh: 流便哪，你是我的长子，是我力量强壮的时候生的，本当大有尊荣，权力超众。
49.en: "Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, the first sign of my strength, excelling in honor, excelling in power.

49.zh: 但你放纵情欲，滚沸如水，必不得居首位；因为你上了你父亲的床，污秽了我的榻。
49.en: Turbulent as the waters, you will no longer excel, for you went up onto your father's bed, onto my couch and defiled it.

49.zh: 西缅和利未是弟兄；他们的刀剑是残忍的器具。
49.en: "Simeon and Levi are brothers- their swords are weapons of violence.

49.zh: 我的灵阿，不要与他们同谋；我的心哪，不要与他们联络；因为他们趁怒杀害人命，任意砍断牛腿大筋。
49.en: Let me not enter their council, let me not join their assembly, for they have killed men in their anger and hamstrung oxen as they pleased.

49.zh: 他们的怒气暴烈可咒；他们的忿恨残忍可诅。我要使他们分居在雅各家里，散住在以色列地中。
49.en: Cursed be their anger, so fierce, and their fury, so cruel! I will scatter them in Jacob and disperse them in Israel.

49.zh: 犹大阿，你弟兄们必赞美你；你手必掐住仇敌的颈项；你父亲的儿子们必向你下拜。
49.en: "Judah, your brothers will praise you; your hand will be on the neck of your enemies; your father's sons will bow down to you.

49.zh: 犹大是个小狮子；我儿阿，你抓了食便上去。你屈下身去，卧如公狮，蹲如母狮，谁敢惹你？
49.en: You are a lion's cub, O Judah; you return from the prey, my son. Like a lion he crouches and lies down, like a lioness-who dares to rouse him?

49.zh: 圭必不离犹大，杖必不离他两脚之间，直等细罗 ( 就是赐平安者 ) 来到，万民都必归顺。
49.en: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler's staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs and the obedience of the nations is his.

49.zh: 犹大把小驴拴在葡萄树上，把驴驹拴在美好的葡萄树上。他在葡萄酒中洗了衣服，在葡萄汁中洗了袍褂。
49.en: He will tether his donkey to a vine, his colt to the choicest branch; he will wash his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

49.zh: 他的眼睛必因酒红润；他的牙齿必因奶白亮。
49.en: His eyes will be darker than wine, his teeth whiter than milk.

49.zh: 西布伦必住在海口，必成为停船的海口；他的境界必延到西顿。
49.en: "Zebulun will live by the seashore and become a haven for ships; his border will extend toward Sidon.

49.zh: 以萨迦是个强壮的驴，卧在羊圈之中。
49.en: "Issachar is a rawboned donkey lying down between two saddlebags.

49.zh: 他以安静为佳，以肥地为美，便低肩背重，成为服苦的仆人。
49.en: When he sees how good is his resting place and how pleasant is his land, he will bend his shoulder to the burden and submit to forced labor.

49.zh: 但必判断他的民，作以色列支派之一。
49.en: "Dan will provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel.

49.zh: 但必作道上的蛇，路中的虺，咬伤马蹄，使骑马的坠落于后。
49.en: Dan will be a serpent by the roadside, a viper along the path, that bites the horse's heels so that its rider tumbles backward.

49.zh: 耶和华阿，我向来等候你的救恩。
49.en: "I look for your deliverance, O Lord .

49.zh: 迦得必被敌军追逼，他却要追逼他们的脚跟。
49.en: "Gad will be attacked by a band of raiders, but he will attack them at their heels.

49.zh: 亚设之地必出肥美的粮食，且出君王的美味。
49.en: "Asher's food will be rich; he will provide delicacies fit for a king.

49.zh: 拿弗他利是被释放的母鹿；他出嘉美的言语。
49.en: "Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.

49.zh: 约瑟是多结果子的树枝，是泉旁多结果的枝子；他的枝条探出墙外。
49.en: "Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine near a spring, whose branches climb over a wall.

49.zh: 弓箭手将他苦害，向他射箭，逼迫他。
49.en: With bitterness archers attacked him; they shot at him with hostility.

49.zh: 但他的弓仍旧坚硬；他的手健壮敏捷。这是因以色列的牧者，以色列的磐石 ─ 就是雅各的大能者。
49.en: But his bow remained steady, his strong arms stayed limber, because of the hand of the Mighty One of Jacob, because of the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel,

49.zh: 你父亲的神必帮助你；那全能者必将天上所有的福，地里所藏的福，以及生产乳养的福，都赐给你。
49.en: because of your father's God, who helps you, because of the Almighty, who blesses you with blessings of the heavens above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breast and womb.

49.zh: 你父亲所祝的福，胜过我祖先所祝的福，如永世的山岭，至极的边界；这些福必降在约瑟的头上，临到那与弟兄迥别之人的顶上。
49.en: Your father's blessings are greater than the blessings of the ancient mountains, than the bounty of the age-old hills. Let all these rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince among his brothers.

49.zh: 便雅悯是个撕掠的狼，早晨要吃他所抓的，晚上要分他所夺的。
49.en: "Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; in the morning he devours the prey, in the evening he divides the plunder."

49.zh: 这一切是以色列的十二支派；这也是他们的父亲对他们所说的话，为他们所祝的福，都是按著各人的福分为他们祝福。
49.en: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father said to them when he blessed them, giving each the blessing appropriate to him.

49.zh: 他又嘱咐他们说：我将要归到我列祖 ( 原文作本民 ) 那里，你们要将我葬在赫人以弗仑田间的洞里，与我祖我父在一处，
49.en: Then he gave them these instructions: "I am about to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

49.zh: 就是在迦南地幔利前 、 麦比拉田间的洞；那洞和田是亚伯拉罕向赫人以弗仑买来为业，作坟地的。
49.en: the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre in Canaan, which Abraham bought as a burial place from Ephron the Hittite, along with the field.

49.zh: 他们在那里葬了亚伯拉罕和他妻撒拉，又在那里葬了以撒和他的妻子利百加；我也在那里葬了利亚。
49.en: There Abraham and his wife Sarah were buried, there Isaac and his wife Rebekah were buried, and there I buried Leah.

49.zh: 那块田和田间的洞原是向赫人买的。
49.en: The field and the cave in it were bought from the Hittites. "

49.zh: 雅各嘱咐众子已毕，就把脚收在床上，气绝而死，归到列祖 ( 原文作本民 ) 那里去了。
49.en: When Jacob had finished giving instructions to his sons, he drew his feet up into the bed, breathed his last and was gathered to his people.

50.zh: 约瑟伏在他父亲的面上哀哭，与他亲嘴。
50.en: Joseph threw himself upon hisfather and wept over him and kissed him.

50.zh: 约瑟吩咐伺候他的医生用香料薰他父亲，医生就用香料薰了以色列。
50.en: Then Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel. So the physicians embalmed him,

50.zh: 薰尸的常例是四十天；那四十天满了，埃及人为他哀哭了七十天。
50.en: taking a full forty days, for that was the time required for embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.

50.zh: 为他哀哭的日子过了，约瑟对法老家中的人说：我若在你们眼前蒙恩，请你们报告法老说：
50.en: When the days of mourning had passed, Joseph said to Pharaoh's court, "If I have found favor in your eyes, speak to Pharaoh for me. Tell him,

50.zh: 我父亲要死的时候叫我起誓说：你要将我葬在迦南地，在我为自己所掘的坟墓里。现在求你让我上去葬我父亲，以后我必回来。
50.en: 'My father made me swear an oath and said, "I am about to die; bury me in the tomb I dug for myself in the land of Canaan." Now let me go up and bury my father; then I will return.' "

50.zh: 法老说：你可以上去，照著你父亲叫你起的誓，将他葬埋。
50.en: Pharaoh said, "Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear to do."

50.zh: 于是约瑟上去葬他父亲。与他一同上去的，有法老的臣仆和法老家中的长老，并埃及国的长老，
50.en: So Joseph went up to bury his father. All Pharaoh's officials accompanied him-the dignitaries of his court and all the dignitaries of Egypt-

50.zh: 还有约瑟的全家和他的弟兄们，并他父亲的眷属；只有他们的妇人孩子，和羊群牛群，都留在歌珊地。
50.en: besides all the members of Joseph's household and his brothers and those belonging to his father's household. Only their children and their flocks and herds were left in Goshen.

50.zh: 又有车辆马兵，和他一同上去；那一帮人甚多。
50.en: Chariots and horsemen also went up with him. It was a very large company.

50.zh: 他们到了约但河外 、 亚达的禾场，就在那里大大地号咷痛哭。约瑟为他父亲哀哭了七天。
50.en: When they reached the threshing floor of Atad, near the Jordan, they lamented loudly and bitterly; and there Joseph observed a seven-day period of mourning for his father.

50.zh: 迦南的居民见亚达禾场上的哀哭，就说：这是埃及人一场大的哀哭。因此那地方名叫亚伯麦西，是在约但河东。
50.en: When the Canaanites who lived there saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad, they said, "The Egyptians are holding a solemn ceremony of mourning." That is why that place near the Jordan is called Abel Mizraim.

50.zh: 雅各的儿子们就遵著他父亲所吩咐的办了，
50.en: So Jacob's sons did as he had commanded them:

50.zh: 把他搬到迦南地，葬在幔利前 、 麦比拉田间的洞里；那洞和田是亚伯拉罕向赫人以弗仑买来为业，作坟地的。
50.en: They carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre, which Abraham had bought as a burial place from Ephron the Hittite, along with the field.

50.zh: 约瑟葬了他父亲以后，就和众弟兄，并一切同他上去葬他父亲的人，都回埃及去了。
50.en: After burying his father, Joseph returned to Egypt, together with his brothers and all the others who had gone with him to bury his father.

50.zh: 约瑟的哥哥们见父亲死了，就说：或者约瑟怀恨我们，照著我们从前待他一切的恶足足的报复我们。
50.en: When Joseph's brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, "What if Joseph holds a grudge against us and pays us back for all the wrongs we did to him?"

50.zh: 他们就打发人去见约瑟，说：你父亲未死以先吩咐说：
50.en: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, "Your father left these instructions before he died:

50.zh: 你们要对约瑟这样说：从前你哥哥们恶待你，求你饶恕他们的过犯和罪恶。如今求你饶恕你父亲神之仆人的过犯。他们对约瑟说这话，约瑟就哭了。
50.en: 'This is what you are to say to Joseph: I ask you to forgive your brothers the sins and the wrongs they committed in treating you so badly.' Now please forgive the sins of the servants of the God of your father." When their message came to him, Joseph wept.

50.zh: 他的哥哥们又来俯伏在他面前，说：我们是你的仆人。
50.en: His brothers then came and threw themselves down before him. "We are your slaves," they said.

50.zh: 约瑟对他们说：不要害怕，我岂能代替神呢？
50.en: But Joseph said to them, "Don't be afraid. Am I in the place of God?

50.zh: 从前你们的意思是要害我，但神的意思原是好的，要保全许多人的性命，成就今日的光景。
50.en: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to accomplish what is now being done, the saving of many lives.

50.zh: 现在你们不要害怕，我必养活你们和你们的妇人孩子。于是约瑟用亲爱的话安慰他们。
50.en: So then, don't be afraid. I will provide for you and your children." And he reassured them and spoke kindly to them.

50.zh: 约瑟和他父亲的眷属都住在埃及。约瑟活了一百一十岁。
50.en: Joseph stayed in Egypt, along with all his father's family. He lived a hundred and ten years

50.zh: 约瑟得见以法莲第三代的子孙。玛拿西的孙子 、 玛吉的儿子也养在约瑟的膝上。
50.en: and saw the third generation of Ephraim's children. Also the children of Makir son of Manasseh were placed at birth on Joseph's knees.

50.zh: 约瑟对他弟兄们说：我要死了，但神必定看顾你们，领你们从这地上去，到他起誓所应许给亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 雅各之地。
50.en: Then Joseph said to his brothers, "I am about to die. But God will surely come to your aid and take you up out of this land to the land he promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob."

50.zh: 约瑟叫以色列的子孙起誓说：神必定看顾你们；你们要把我的骸骨从这里搬上去。
50.en: And Joseph made the sons of Israel swear an oath and said, "God will surely come to your aid, and then you must carry my bones up from this place."

50.zh: 约瑟死了，正一百一十岁。人用香料将他薰了，把他收殓在棺材里，停在埃及。
50.en: So Joseph died at the age of a hundred and ten.
